question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’eky’okubanza agyenda kutandika omutwe ogurikukwata aha mugasho gw’ebicweka by’obwire oburikugarukamu aha bintu ebiriho n’obusingye. Ekiha ky’ebibuuzo eky’aha hansi nikyikiriza omwegyesa kutandika omutwe ogu arikukoraho n’abanyeshuri?
answer_a: Enki ekiita oba kyabaire nikirengwa omumaiso gw'akasheeshe?
answer_b: Ahabwaki ebiro birikutyoora omu bwire bw'obutiti?
answer_c: Ahabantu ahabuurizi ki nibakuratira embeera ezi bamanyire omu bwiire?
answer_d: Ahabwaki orikureeba abantu abarikwingana barara omu kasheeshe?

question: Omuhwezi w’ebyomubiri na sayansi, omugabe akateekateeka ekigyendererwa eki aha banaishomero abari omu mwaka gw’okubanza: “Kworeka ekirikukira kubaho aha miti y’ebibala omu bwire bw’ebiro.” Ni kikugu ki ekirikukira kuhikira kwongyera kumanya obwengye bw’abanaishomero?
answer_a: Ha omuhanda oguri busha, reero abeeshuri bashuube omuti gwabo gw'ebibala ogu bakunda omu bwire bubiri obw'omwaka.
answer_b: Ha abeeshuri abarikushoma, mutwarire ebishushani by'emiti etari emwe n'emwe, reero mubagambire bagyete gyete omu miti erikuba neyemera ebijuma n'etarikuyemera ebijuma.
answer_c: Ha omuhanda gw'ebishushani by'emiti y'ebibala, ahu ebiro by'omwaka oguri omuri gyo byorekwa, reero obagambire kubirangira amarangi.
answer_d: Ha omuhanda ogurimu ebimera by'emiti etari emwe n'emwe n'ogundi ogurimu ebijuma, reero ohingure abeeshuri bashobore kukwatanisa omuti n'ekijuma ekikugwana.

question: Omwegyesereza ari kukora aha mutwe gw'omubiri gw'omuntu omu kiraasi ey'abana, kandi nayegyesa ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza omukoro gw'omutima. Obu arikubuuza abeeshuri ebi barikumanya, naamanya ngu abamwe baine enshobyo aha mutwe ogwo. Omu bintu ebi birikukurataho, niki ekirikwohereza enshobyo aha mutima?
answer_a: Omutima gukomera kurabira omu mizano.
answer_b: Omutima gw'omuntu guringana n'enkumu ye.
answer_c: Omutima nigwija kureetera eshagama kutwara omwaka omu mubiri.
answer_d: Omutima nigwo gukora eshagazi erikugenda omu mubiri gwona.

question: Abana bato omu myaka ya kare bagamba ngu hariho ebishushani n'amabara g'ebimera by'omutaano omu lugya. Omwegyesa akoresa obwega bwabo obu, yaabarikiriza kukora okucungura aha nshonga egi kuraba omu ntambwe zino: 1. Bakusanya amakooko g'ebimera agagwa omu lugya. 2. Bagyerengyereza ebishushani n'amabara g'amakooko agaakusanyirizibwe. 3. Bashubamu ekibuuzo ky'omwegyesa: "Kiki ekirikubaaho twabiteeka omu maizi?" 4. Bateeka amakooko omu kabatiine erimu amaizi. Obureezi ki bw'okuteekateeka obw'obwomeezi omwegyesa arikukoresa n'ekibuuzo eki arikubuza abaana omu bwire bw'omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Kugyezaho
answer_b: Okureeberera kurabira omu ndagiriro
answer_c: Okutebeekanisa ebiragiro
answer_d: Okugyeragyeranisa ebimanyiso

question: Shoma omwegyesa naayeta abaana abato kukora okucweekereza. Omu cuupa, naashukamu amaizi, amafuta, na giriseriini. Reero, naahugura ecuupa, yaayoreka oku amafuta na giriseriini birikwambuka, amaizi gaashigara ahansi. Omwegyesa naayoreka ki aha mbeera y'ebintu omu by'arikuorekya?
answer_a: Obungi bw'ekintu
answer_b: Okushaanuuka
answer_c: Amaisho
answer_d: Okugabura

question: Omwegyesa ariyo nashoborra abaana enkyukakyuka eziraba omu mbeera y'amaizi. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikubaasa kworeka eky'okurugaanira hamwe (condensation)?
answer_a: Okugwa kw'omuzinga gw'omushana omu maizi g'omugyera
answer_b: Okuhindura omunyinya gukahinduka omwika kuraba omu maani g'eizooba
answer_c: Okutahoza amaizi g'enyanja n'okugihindura omu barafu
answer_d: Okutohaaza amabaare agarikworekwa omwoyo gw'ekyanga ky'amaizi g'omuriro

question: Omwegyesa orikwegyesa nayoreka abana ekishushani eky'omumbeera y'ekintu erikuhinduka kuruga omu gasi omukaka. Ni iriiha iziina ry'omuhinduko gw'omumbeera ogu omwegyesa arikwenda kukoraho?
answer_a: Okuhinduka omuyonga
answer_b: Okuhinduka kuruga omu kikaro ekikumanyire nka ekikukuumu omu mwika
answer_c: Okuhinduka omwika
answer_d: Okuhungaanisa

question: Omuhendiki w’omwanya ashemereire kushoboorora abaana ebintu ebiri omu biteera obwire oburikwenda kukyuka, ni bintu ki ebimwe aha bintu ebi ashemereire kwetegyereza omu kushoboorora kwe?
answer_a: Obwire, omuheeru, hamu n'ebiro by'omwaka
answer_b: Omuyaga, ebiro by'omwaka, n'obushuushu
answer_c: Emburu, omuyaga, hamu n'oburimbo
answer_d: Obwire, omuyaga, hamu n'enkuba

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omwegyesa n’aba nayegyesa ebikwaata aha nyanja omu mutwe gw’ebintu ebiriho n’obusingye bwabyo. N’ahabwekyo, ayoreka vidiyo erikwoleka enyanja omu izooba ry’omuyaga. Omwe aha baana abuuza ahabw’enki omuyaga guriyo. Omu bintu ebi omwegyesa ashemereire kwatura nk’ensonga enkuru erikureeta omuyaga n’enki?
answer_a: Omuyaga
answer_b: Amaani g'amahe ga gravity y'Omwezi
answer_c: Enshuranisho omu bwokukama bw'obushuushu omu bwengyerero
answer_d: Empinduka omu bwokushushu bw'amaizi g'enyanja

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu bareetsi abanaaba bato vidiyo erikwoleka ekintu ekireetwa okutengaana kw'omutwe gw'ensi. Okutengaana oku kureetera ebicweka by'aha muhemisfera y'obukiizi n'oburaaya kutamurikwa omusana omu muringo oguringanire obwire obu ensi erikugyenda negyenda okurikurunga izooba. Ni kintu ki ky'ensi omwegyesa orikugeza kworekyera abanaaba n'obuyambi bw'ekikoreso eki?
answer_a: Emigyerero y'omu nyanja
answer_b: Ebiseera by'omwaka
answer_c: Eizooba n'ekiro
answer_d: Emigano

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Omu kibiina ky'abaana abato, Ignacio ariyo nashoborra aha by'enyanja eziitwa clownfish kandi nashoborra abanywani be omukibiina ngu ekika eki kigira oburinzi kuruga omu itungo erya sea anemone okurwanya enyamaishwa, haine anemone nayo erinzirwe ahabw'okuba ekyenyanja eki kiginga enyanja endiijo ezirigirya. Omwegyesa ayingiramu kushoborra eiziina ly'omutindo gw'omukago gw'ebiramu ogurikushoborrwa omwana. Mutindo ki gw'omukago gw'ebiramu ogu omwegyesa ashemereire kugarukamu omu kushoborra kwe?
answer_a: Okurya hamwe
answer_b: Amensalizimu
answer_c: Obutari kwegaita n'eri.
answer_d: Omukago

question: Omugyesa ashemereire kwetegyereza abegi be amakuru ki, kubaasa kwetegyereza amakuru g'obwolekyezi bw'obusaale omu nsingye z'eby'okurya?
answer_a: Emiramidi z'omubaro gw'abantu omu by'obuhangwa
answer_b: Enyegano eziri ahaagati y'ebiriika by'ebintu ebirimu obumwe
answer_c: Abaguzi abakuru n'abaguzi abato
answer_d: Okuhindura n'okukuumira amani

Tebeekanisa erikukwata aha mbeera y'omutima: Ebiriho ebihyaka omu by'okuteekamu omutima ogutahwera (Pacemakers)

Ebyahindwire ebihyaka omu by'okuteekamu omutima ogutahwera (Pacemakers):

*   Pacemakers ezitaine micwe: Obuhangwa obu nibwo bukuru ahabw'okuba nibukora butaine micwe erikubaasa kureetera oburemeezi. Nibateekwa omu mutima butunu, kandi nibukora gye kukira obw'omuhanda.

*   Pacemakers ezirikukwatanisa omutima n'obwongo: Obuhangwa obu nibukoresa tekinologia erikukwatanisa omutima n'obwongo, ekirikubaasa kuhwereera abantu abaine oburemeezi bw'omutima n'obw'obwongo.

*   Pacemakers ezirikukora nka sensa: Obuhangwa obu nibukoresa sensa okumanya embeera y'omubiri, ekirikubaasa kuhwereera omutima kukora gye.

Emyamwa y'omugasho:

*   Nibongyera amagara: Pacemakers zihwereera abantu abaine oburemeezi bw'omutima kukuraho amagara.
*   Nibahwereera omutima kukora gye: Pacemakers zihwereera omutima kukora gye, ekirikubaasa kutaasa omuntu aha kufa.
*   Nibataasa amagara: Pacemakers zitaasa amagara g'abantu abaine oburemeezi bw'omutima.

Ebirikwetengwa okwetegyereza:

*   Pacemakers zirikwenda okuteekwa: Pacemakers zirikwenda okuteekwa omugyezi w'omutima.
*   Pacemakers zirakora n'amasannyalaze: Pacemakers zirakora n'amasannyalaze, n'ahabw'ekyo nikibaasa kuba eky'akabi.
*   Pacemakers zirakwenda okureebwa: Pacemakers zirakwenda okureebwa omugyezi w'omutima obutoosa.

Eky'okumanya:

Ahabw'okuba tekinologia agumizamu kuhinduka, abantu nibabaasa kwetegyereza ebintu bingi ebirikukwata aha mutima. Pacemakers n'obuhangwa oburikukura obutoosa, kandi nibubaasa kuhwereera abantu abaine oburemeezi bw'omutima kukuraho amagara.
answer_d: Omukono gw'ebiro ogurikworeka abasheensi abagiziire omugisha omu by'amanywe g'omutima (pacemakers) ogu twine obu.

question: Omugyezibwa aine ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa abeeshuri be kumanya embeera y'okuzimba nk'ekicweka ky'obwirwanirizi bw'omubiri obw'omuzaaro. Ni nshonga ki aha zirikukurira ezishemereire kuba zimanyirwe abeeshuri kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Obuhagyi burikwata ebirwanisa endwaara nibyo bireetera obutofaali bwa T kureeba ebirwanisa endwaara
answer_b: Obuturofiri nibwo buryo bw'okurya obutofaayo bw'ebintu ebirwaza eby'omutaano.
answer_c: Obuturo bw'omubiri (T lymphocytes) oburikukwata aha kintu eki (antigen) butandika kweyongyera.

question:

Ni murimo ki ogurikukurira ogu orikubaasa kukoresa kushobora yaaba abeeshuri bahikiire aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Teekateekire ekiteekateeko ky'okushobora kumanya omukago oguli ahagati ya lipaze na lipidi.
answer_b: Tebeekereza omulingo gw'okukora ekigereso ekirikworeka omulingo amara g'omunwa garikukoramu aha by'okulya ebirimu sitashi
answer_c: Shwijuma ebintu ebirikukora omu kucwekyereza kw'ekigeragiro kya pepsin aha protein
answer_d: Shwijuma ekishushani ekirikworeka oku ishuukari omu musaayi erikuhinduka bwanyima y'okurya eby'okurya ebirimu amaka g'emishwi mingi.

question: Omugurusi ari kukora aha mutwe gw'eby'okumanya eby'omubiri ogurikusiiriira, kandi nayenda kushoboorora omugasho gw'obuhangwa bw'obutito omu bantu. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kworeka, nikirikurikurugaana n'enteekateeka etariyo y'abanyeshuri aha bikwaata aha buhangwa bw'obutito?

answer_b: Obutakiti nibubi aha biramu.
answer_c: Obutakago bw'omubiri nibworobera okufunza eby'okurya omu nda.
answer_d: Obutambi bw'okurwanisa endwara nibwita obucooko obugasa n'obutagasa omubiri.

question: Omwegyesereza aine ekigyendererwa ky'okureetera abanyeshuri be kuteekateeka ebi barikuteekateeka ebirikukwata aha bintu ebimwe ebi abantu barikukoresa ebimanyiso by'ebiramu. Ni enki aha bintu ebi ekyabaasa kwemerera omwegyesereza kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa kye?

answer_d: Omwandiko ogurikukwata aha nkoresa y'obutoffaali bwa stem omu kwongyerera abantu abarikurwaire endwaara

question: Omwegyesereza aine ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa abegi be okwetegyereza omulingo gwa plasmolysis kuraba omu kugezesa. Okugezesa kuli okuha abegi aba bashemereire kukora kwongera okwetegyereza kwabo omulingo ogu?

answer_c: Toba omanye ebiiri karoti yaaba etumbire omu maizi agyezire, reero otumbe omurundi ogundi bwaba omugyiremu.
answer_d: Toba omu omubisi gw'amazzi agashekusheku omutoolireho oruhu rwagwo, reero orebe enkyukakyuka omu bunene bwagwo bwabaireho bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu.

question: Omwegyesi arikwenda kushwijuma ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: Kushoboorora ngu ebintu ebiriho bikozirwe omu butaffa bw'omubiri bumwe rundi obwingi kandi ngu obwo butaffa butebeekanisibwe omu bintu nk'ebitundu by'omubiri, endimi, n'enkora z'omubiri. answer_c: Nibarikirira emikago hagati y'ebicweka by'omubiri gw'ekintu ekiramu omu buteerane bwabyo
answer_d: Nibarikiriza omukago oguri ahagati y’okubaho n’obwingi bw’ebintu ebirimu akantu n’omurimo gw’akantu ako

question: Omwegyesereza akora emirimo ekurikukurira ahabw’ekicweka ky’okwega ekirikukwata aha mitegekere y’akatomu: 1. Abegi bashoma kandi bashwijuma ekitabo ekirikukwata aha mutego gw’akatomu ogwa hati n’ebintu byagwo bikuru. 2. Abegi bakora ebizibu ebirikukwata aha mitegekere y’akatomu n’ebintu ebigirikozese, omutegekere gw’amasannyalaze, n’emibaro ya kwantumu. 3. Abegi baganira omu bibinja ekitabo ekirikukwata aha ku akatomu ekagyenda nikihinduka n’ebintu byagwo bikuru n’ebishushani ebirikugyenderera (Democritus, Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr). 4. Abegi bagyeragyeranisa emitego y’akatomu etari emwe n’emwe nibarikworeka ebintu byayo bikuru. Orukurato orurikukurira omu muringo ki nirwo rurikuhiga okwega okurikugyenda nibukura omu kwetegyereza omutegekere gw’akatomu?
Omu kwegyesa omu ishomo erya "Obushyuushu," omwegyesa nayenda abegi be kumanya amakuru g'ekipimo ky'obushyuushu, ebintu ebiri aha hansi ni birikwetagisa kubanza kwegwa kugira ngu eki kirungihe?
answer_a: Amaani g'amaisho
answer_b: Okurora kw'obushuushu
answer_c: Okugaziika kw'ebintu ahabw'obushuhe
answer_d: Emishaanuro y'okupima obushuushu

question: Marcial nashomera abegi be'shure omugani ogurikukwata aha: Omushaija naateeka enyama z'oburo bw'entaano (noodles) ahabw'eka ye. Atekereza amaizi omu rufunjo bwanyima yaata omu rufunjo enyama z'oburo bw'entaano. Kurugiirira aha biragiro ebi ebiija n'enyama z'oburo bw'entaano, ashemereire kucwekyereza omuriro, kwonka ahabw'okuba arikwihuta, nagumizamu n'omuriro mwingi ahabw'okugira ngu omu muringo ogwo amaizi nigaza kwokya munonga kandi zigateekwa bwangu. Ku barikuganiira aha biteekateeko bye ebirikukwata aha mbeera egi, abarikukiraho nibarikukiriza eki omushaija yaakozire. Ni enki aha bikorwa ebi Marcial ashemereire kutebeekanisa abegi be kuremesa enyikiriza zaabo ez'obuto?
answer_a: Kushwijukya oku obushushu bw'amazzi oburikuteerera (boiling point) buhinduka ota omu mbeera z'obutonde ez'omutaano
answer_b: Kupima obwire oburikwetagisa okuhuumura amaizi 200 mL omu biraagi ebirikuba biri aha muriro ogw'amaani agatari gamwe
answer_c: Kutebeeka omuringo gw'okushwijuma enshobano y'obushushu bw'okuteera nk'omukoro gw'omwingi gw'amaizi agatoozibwe.
answer_d: Okwotsya amaizi omu bbiika okuhitsya obu gaatokota, yongyera amaani g'omuriro, reero opime obushuushu bwaago buri sekendi amakumi ashatu okumara edakiika ina.

question: Omugyezibwa naagira ekigyendererwa ky'okureetera abeeshuri be kutebeekanisa okunoonyereza kw'okugezesa okurikukwata aha maani g'okuremesa. Eki akyenderera, aine ebipinga ebirimu amataagi g'ahaiguru agasheeneene (agyorobi, agariho omusenyu, agariho sipoonji, agariho ekyoma) n'emeza eshobora kutererwa. Abeeshuri bareeba ngu obu bateeka ekipinga aha meza kandi bagiterera, aha muringo ogurikutererwa, ekipinga kitandika kuseerera. Aha bikorwa ebi orikuruga, niki ekirikubaasa kwihiira omugyezibwa kumanya obwingana obu abeeshuri be barikukikora?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kumanya ebintu ebiri omu kucwekyereza ekyo n'okushobora omuringo gw'okuhandiika ebiri kubaho.
answer_b: Ha abeeshuri omwegi omanye okuhendera okushobora kupima embeera ahu buli kitabo kitandikira kuseerera hamu n'okubara omuhendo ogwa wakati gw'ebipimo bishatu ahakya kitabo kimwe
answer_c: Gambira abaana kuta omutaano gwa buri kimwe omu mwanya oguhamiire, hanyuma ohingure emeeza okuhitsya omutaano gurashanduka, reero opime embaju oku gurashandukire.
answer_d: Gambira abeshomesa kumanya entambwe ezirikukuratirwa omu kutaaho omukago ogurikubaasika hagati y'ahaiguru y'ekikoomi n'engyeso ei kirikutandikira okuseerera.

question: Omugyezibwa naayenda kukora omurimo gw'okubuuriza ogurikwebemberwa n'abeeshuri be, nukwo bategeere ngu obuhame oburikurugamu okukora ebintu nibwo bukuru omu kuzooka okumanya. Omugyezibwa yaaba naayenda kushuuruura oku ekyenderwa eki kyahikiiriziibwe, ni birikukurataho byona ebirikumworeka ebirikumwemerera kukikora butoosha?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebiragiro ebirikumanyisa ebyatungwa omu mutendera gw'okugezesa.
answer_b: Nibarikorera ebiragiro ebirikumanyisa ebyafunirwe omu mutendera gw'okukora ebishomeso omu kunoonyereza
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omu kubangaanisa ebiirikurangaaha nibarikukwataganya obuhame bw'ebirikurangaaha n'ekibuuzo ky'okushoma ekibaire kibaziibweho.
answer_d: Nibarikora omulingo gw'okukora okucungura ebiragiro ebibasobozesa kutunga obuhame oburikweshongyera aha by'okukora (empirical evidence) kugarukamu ekibuuzo kyabo ky'okushwijuma.

question: Shoma omwegyesa arikushobora kushoma n'okushoborora ebiri omu bukakafu arikukoresa obuhame oburikwegamira aha biteekateeko ngu enshangwa z'ebintu ebiriyo zitwaraine n'okuhinduka kw'ebintu. Omu myemerero y'abegyesa eri ahansi, n'enyihe erikwataine butoosha n'okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki?
answer_a: Taahura ebintu ebirimu obumwe omu bika byabyo kurugiirira aha miteera y'okubitaahuramu.
answer_b: Gyeragane obwahati bw'ebishushani by'ebintu ebyabaireho omu mataba g'eitaka bimwe n'embeera z'enyima n'ezo obunaku obu.
answer_c: Kurugi kuruga ebishangwa by'ebihara by'ekintu ekiramu, omuntu asobora kumanya emico y'ekika ekyo.
answer_d: Gereranisa ebimiro ebirikushushana omu binyama ebiitwaara, nk'ekikondo ky'enjuba n'ebabaani ry'ekinyamunywera.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa kuhamuririra abeeshuli be amakuru g'obukorane bw'okubanza, nk'enki ekyarugirweho eki arikubaasa kukoresa kushuuruurira?
answer_a: Enyonyi ya African hornbill etunga ebiwuka bingi omu mwabo omu kikaali kyayo, ebiirya obuceezi; omu muringo ogu, nibyo birukya obuceezi oburikwekwatanisa omu kikaali.
answer_b: Enshojo zirimu obutakiteriya omu nda zaazo oburikubaasa kucweeka seluloosi, nukwo ogwo omugati gubaireho ahabw'enshojo zombi.
answer_c: Ebirabyo bya orikidi nibegamiira aha miti kubaasa kutunga omushana, amaizi, n'ebirikurisa ebirungi, hatariho kubitwaara kuruga omu muti, ogutarikukwatwaho orikidi.
answer_d: Obutakitiiria bwa Rhizobium nibutunga ebiriisa ebi burikwetaga kuruga omu mireenzi y'ebishyimbo, kandi omu mwanya gw'ekyo, obutakitiiria obu nibukwata nitrogeni ei ebimera ebi birikwetaga.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa abegyeswa be kucweekereza embeera y'okugezesa egi ahaansi, ahabw'okushobora kumanya obushobozi bwabo obw'okwetegyereza ebintu ebiri kukora aha kukura kw'ebimera: Omu kifo ekigaliire, ekiine ntabiragiro kandi eky'obushuushu obutahinduka, ebimera bibiri (A na B) bikateerwa aha muheru gw'ekyombeko. Ekimera A nikimurikwa omushana gw'ekiragura n'ekimera B nikimurikwa omushana gw'obururu. Byombi bikaba nibiheebwa amaizi agyinganire omurundi gumwe omu saabiiti. Obwo abagambira kugarukamu ekikaguzo eki: Ni kimera ki aha bibiri ebi eky'okwetegereza ngu nikyo kizaakure gwa mwingi? Eky'okugarukamu ki aha by'ahaansi eki nikyo kizaakuratira omwegyesa kumanya ngu ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Omuti A nigukura muno ahabw’okuba enfuumu z’omushana gw’ekiraganiro zigyenda zigyereine n’amaani g’omushana okukira enfuumu z’omushana gw’ebiruru
answer_b: Ekiti B nikakura omuhanda gwayo ahabw'okuba omushana gw'obururu nigushobora kwikirwa chlorophyll omu bwingi obukira omushana gw'ekiragani.
answer_c: Tibimera byona tibirikura ahabw’okuba n’obu baraabe baine amaizi, kandi bari omu mwanya ogugumirwe, tibaine CO2 ehagire.
answer_d: Ebishaho byombi nibikurira omu muringo gumwe ahabw’okugira amazzi maingi, eikiriza okubyara byombi kubyugura eminwa yabyo (stomata) hatariho buzibu bwa CO2 kutaaha.

question: Omugyezaho omwegyesa naayoreka abegyesa be orukurato rw'okukora orurikukwata aha mukago gw'ebirikurwanisa endwara n'omubiri: Ni nshobyo ki ey'okutandika omuntu aine yo erikubaasa kukuraho orukurato oru?
answer_a: Oburobyo B birikukora emiringo y'obutakuumira omubiri etaine bwihisho.
answer_b: Antigeeni zihinduka kwikora omu bwoko bumwe bw'omubiri ogurwanisa endwara.
answer_c: Emiringita bisobora kwegaita na buli kika ky'ekirwaza omubiri.
answer_d: Obuturo bw'omubiri ogurwanisa endwara obwa B nibuzaara emiringo mingi ey'obuturo oburwanisa endwara bwabwo bwabugambirweho ekintu kimwe ekirikureeta endwara.

question: Omuhanda gw'okutebeekanisa eishomo aha nkora y'ebirimba, ebiri aha mushobooroza ebiteekwa abeeshuri baawe kumanya omu maisho, kubaasa kwetantaza oku hormoni zirikutsibura okugarukwamu omu kashagama akagendererwa?
answer_a: Ebintu ebirikurekurwa kureetera omubiri kurekura hormoni
answer_b: Emitero y'ebiramu (hormones) erikukora
answer_c: Okutegeka homooni omu bw'omubiri kuraba omu by'omazi
answer_d: Emiringo y'okugarukamu ey'emikorere y'emisisa

question: Omuhereza w’ebyamagara omu kwesomesa okuhikiirira, omwegyesa wa bayolojiya atwariramu ekibuuzo ekirikukurataho: ‘Ni nkyukakyuuka ki ez’omubiri eziraareebwa omu mukazi orikuheebwa omuti ogurikuzibira omurimo gwa GnRH? Zigambe.’ Ni ndagiriro ki y’okushomesa erikukwatwaho n’ekintu eki ekitebeekanisiibwe?
answer_a: Shoborora omuringo gw'omukora gw'emishumurizo ogurikukwata aha nkyukakyuuka z'obutoosha.
answer_b: Shoborora oku gavumenti y'emihormone y'omu hypothalamus aha mutwaro gw'ebiro by'omushana omu ibyairo n'omunda y'omukazi
answer_c: Shobora omukwenda gw'ebintu ebirikukurataana omu mutwaro gw'amagi, orikugambira aha kicweka ky'obuhumbo bw'amagi, okurekurwa kw'eigi, n'ekicweka ky'omubiri ogurikurekurwa.
answer_d: Rondookereza orutondeekye rw'ebirikurugaho omu mutumbi gw'omukazi omu bwire bw'okucwecera, eky'omutumbi kweyongyera, hamwe n'eky'omutumbi kureetera ebintu birugaho.

question: Omuhwezi omuhingurizi omu omutwe gw'ebiroge, omwegyesa aba nayenda abegyi be kutunguura obushoboorozi bw'okucwamu embeera ezirikukwatwa omu kwega. Murimo ki gw'okushomesa ogurikwija kumuha omwegyesa obushoboorozi bw'okugera obuhikizi bw'ekigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Okukora akacungiro k’etaaba kwongyera kumanya ebintu ebirimu obutagatsi.
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa ebyarugire omu kubaruura ebyakozirwe abeeshuri aha bintu ebiri kukwata aha kunywa omwenge omukye.
answer_c: Okutebeekanisa omusingi gw'enyegyesereza aha kunoonyereza okurikukwata aha bintu ebiri kubahoora abato okukoresa enjaga
answer_d: Okugyenda kw'ebyakozesebwa ebyombirwe abeeshuri aha mikorere y'emibazi erengura omubiri omu bwengye aha mutindo gw'obuhangwa bw'emibazi omu businziiro bw'obwengye

question: Omugyeziki arikwenda abegi be kwetenga sayansi nk'omuringo ogutahwera gw'okubaka obwengye. Kutiisa ekigyendererwa kye, arikushaba abegi be kukora akatabo k'ebiro omu bibinja kurora ebi abasheeki ba sayansi aba bakozire: Friedrich Miescher, Robert Feulgen, P. A. Levene, Frederick Griffith, Oswald Avery, Alfred D. Hershey, na Martha Chase. Ni kimwe aha bintu ebi abegi barikwega eki kyetegekwa kworeka okukura kw'obwengye obu?
answer_a: Sharamura ebishushani ebirikworeka ebice by’okutandika kw’obwomeezi bw’akantu (cell cycle).
answer_b: Shobukanisa omuringo gw'okutambuka kw'amashagama g'obutonde, kuruga omu kazindalo kuhika omu protein.
answer_c: Shoborora omuringo gw'akazindaro ka DNA n'omukago gwaagwo n'okweyongyera n'okuhandiika.
answer_d: Shisha ebireeto ebirikworeka DNA nk'omunyika ogutwaara amakuru g'obutonde bw'abazaire

question: Omugyezibwa naagira ngu abeegi beebanze bashoboorore empindahinduka z'obutonde bw'omubiri ezirikugyenda n'omulingo akameme kakurira hamu n'omulingo keeyoreka omu kookolo. Okukora eki, ateekaniza ebikorwa ebi abeegi be akora: 1. Kutebeekaniza ekishushani ky'omutwarize gw'akameme n'obulingo kirikugyenda nikitebeekanizibwa. 2. Kumanya ebirikukwata aha mulingo akameme kakurira hamu n'omulingo keeyoreka kuraba omu kuzoora. 3. Kukwatanisa engyenderwaho y'ensibo z'obutonde bw'omubiri enkuru omu kutebeekaniza omutwarize gw'akameme hamu n'omu bika bya kookolo eby'omutaano. Omu bintu ebi orikwenda kukora, ekirikukurataho kuruga omu buhule bwangu kuhika aha buzibu nibwo ki aha bikorwa ebyo byona okushobora kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa?

Omuhwezi omuhare omu iraaya ry'amasomo g'amasanyu g'omuriiguru, omugyezani akabuza abegi be ekibuuzo ekirikukurataho: "Ni taabu ki omuri taabu ezi ibiri ekyo orikuteekateeka ngu nikiza kureeta omushana mwingi?" Nk'ekirikurugamu, abegi be boona bakagarukamu ngu oburemeezi bw'omushana gwa taabu B nibwija kuba bwaiguru okukira obwa taabu A. Okukurataho, omugyezani akatebeekanisa ngu bagyezese okuhikiiriza obuteekateeki bwabo kandi baganire ebiri kurugamu, nibagyeragyeranisa n'ebyo baraabe nibateekateeka n'ebyo baraabe nibamanyiire. Aha bikurikukwata aha ekyo kiri ahaiguru, niki ekigyendererwa ky'omurimo ogw'akabiri oguratebeekanisibwe omugyezani?
answer_a: Kureetera okuteebereza okutari kumwe n'okuhiga abaana b'eisomero kucenceera omu biteekateeko byabo
answer_b: Kwehwa ebibuto by'abeegi ebikwatiraine n'okukora kw'ebiroogooto
answer_c: Kushobora kumanya ebiteekateeko by'abeeshuri ebirikukwata aha mikorere y'amasannyalaze
answer_d: Kwetegyereza ebireetera abeeshuri kukora enshobi z'ebiteekateeko ezaayorekire omu murimo ogw'okubanza

question: Omuhendi ashemereire kutebeekanisa omurimo ogurikuratira ekigyendererwa eki: “Kucweekereza enyegyesa y’obutini bw’omusyo gw’omushana kushoboorora eby’omushana, nookwetegyereza ngu enyegyesa zirikugira emigasho kandi n’oburemeezi bwazo,” nk’ekicweka ky’eky’omutaano “Omushana n’Eby’okureeba ebirikukuratira emitindo,” omurimo ki ogurikukurata ogurikwija kureka abeeshuri kukora aha kigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Shisha omulingaanisa okutaanuka kw'omushana omu kantu akato hamu n'okucwekyereza kwagwo obu guri kugyenda omu ndabirwamu ibiri ezirikucwekyereza, noroonda eky'okureeberaho ky'omushana nk'obuntu buto.
answer_b: Shisha omuhendo gw'omusisa ogurikumurikira omu ndorerwamu n'omuringaniso gw'omusisa ogurikwetantaza omu busaho bubiri kurabira omu muringo gw'obutini bw'omusisa.
answer_c: Shwijuma omuhanda gw'omushana ogurikuhita omu ndiba n'omushana ogurikugaruka enyima omu ndiba, orikukoresa enyegyesa y'obutini bw'omushana.
answer_d: Shwijuma omuhendo ogw'okubumbwa kw'ebishushani omu ndorerwamu ez'emiringo n'omu ndorerwamu ez'omunda, turikukoresa emisingi y'okumanyisa okurikukwata aha muringo gw'omushana, kuraba omu muringo gw'obushumi bw'omushana

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa n'abegyi be aha mutindo gw'ensi nk'oku Ptolemy yaagushoboorora, kandi nayenda kukora omurimo ogurikumegyendera kubahwera kwetegyereza oku omutindo gwa Copernicus ogw'eizooba nk'entebe gwaizireho kuruga omu kunegyera omutindo gw'ensi nk'entebe. Aha mirimo egi erikukuraho, n'oguhe ogurikubaasa kuhwera omwegyesa kukora eki?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa bagyeranishe, barikushoborora okufaanana n'okutaanirana, emiringo ya Ptolemy na Copernicus omu kubuurira embeera y'Eizioba n'ebirikurugirira.
answer_b: Yoreka abeshomesha ekishushani kya kompyuta ekirikworeka oku Eizooba n'enjuba endiijo zigyenda, kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'okugira ngu Ensi neyo eri hamutwe n'eby'okugira ngu Eizooba niryo riri hamutwe.
answer_c: Yoreka abeshomesha vidiyo erikworeka oku planeti erikwehindura enyima, nukwo bashobore kushoborora eki bareebire kurugiirira aha ngyenderwaho y'okuti ensi neyo eri hamutwe y'ebyanya byona n'engyenderwaho y'okuti eizooba niryo riri hamutwe y'ebyanya byona omu Runyanya rw'Eizooba.
answer_d: Yorekyera abegyesa, okurugiira aha bitebyo by'ensi, amakuru g'ekyo ekiyitwa "Empinduka ya Copernico", ekiva omu kworekwa okuhyaka kw'Obutonde bw'ensi okwashuuranirweho Copernicus.

question: Ni ki eki aha mirimo egi erikwemerera abeeshuri kushwijuma omu bwijwire iteeka ry'okukuumira amaani g'eby'okutwara?
answer_a: Nirikira omuringo ekipinga erikuzingirira aha rubaju orw'ahaiguru erikwendekyere.
answer_b: Kurabura omuringo gw'okukozesa ekikozeso ekirikuhikiire, oreekoodi omwendeso ogu akafera kahitsya ahansi obu karugwa aha meza.
answer_c: Kurora omugisha gw'ekintu ekiri nk'enjuba (sphere) kurabira omuhanda ogwetegyereize nk'enjoka (U-shaped track), orore obureingwa bwaiguru obu kirikushikaaho omu bwire oburikugyenda.
answer_d: Kuruga omuhendo gw'amaani g'okuhingura n'amaani g'okugumira omubumbi ogurikugyenda aha rugyendo rw'omugaiga ogutaine kabiishwa kuruga omu kashushani ka kompyuta.

question: Omwegyesereza kwegyesa abanyeshuri abari omu mwaka ogwa kabiri omu mashomero agashemereire ekigambo "omugabo ogw'amaani g'ekintu okukyeyongyera", omwegyesa akatebeekaniza omurimo gw'okwegyesa n'okwega ogurikukurataho: Abanyeshuri beeteeraine omu timu nto kandi bazoore omugabo gw'amaani g'ekintu okukyeyongyera ogw'ekirikoomi, barikuhandiika ebirikuruga omu meza. Omu muringo gushushana, bazoore obunene bw'amaani ahu ekirikoomi kirikukuratira amateeka ga Hooke. Okumaliriza, batebeekanize lipoota omu muringo gw'ekipande, eky'okubanza kworekwa abanyeshuri bagenzi baabo. Omu bishoboroora ebiri ahansi, obureezi ki obw'okushwijuma ebya sayansi oburikubaasa kukuura omu murimo ogu?
answer_a: Shwijuma omuhendo gw'okushashuuruza omu by'obushomesa obwa sayansi, orikurugiirira aha mazima n'obwesigwa bw'ebirikugarukwamu.
answer_b: Baaza ebibuuzo n'oburemeezi, kurugiirira aha bumanyi bwa saayansi, ebi birikubaasa kucungurwa kurabira omu kunoonyereza kwa saayansi
answer_c: Shoborora kandi ohanike n'obuhame kuruga omu kunoonyereza kw'abahanga, omu kubaza n'omu kuhandiika, hamwe n'entebe, engarama, eby'okureeberaho, n'eby'omuby'omukura (ICT)
answer_d: Tebeekanisa emiteekateeka y'okunoonyereza kw'okugezesa okurikugarukamu ekibuuzo n'oburemeezi kurugiirira aha nshuro ez'amashomo g'okumanya ebintu, orikuteekateeka okukoresa eby'okukoresa n'ebintu omu muringo ogurikwera kukuratira ngu data erikwegyerwa neyemererwa.

question: Omuhwezi w’ekicweka “Amaani g’Omusirikari n’Obungi bw’Omusirikari” omu Kiraasi eya Ikumi na Ibiri, omwegyesa nayenda abegi be kumanyira amateeka kuraba omu kwegaana omukago oguli hagati y’ebintu ebirukukwata aha mubiri. Omu mbeera y’iteeka rya Ohm, ekikorwa ki ekirikukurataho nikyo kirungi ahabw’ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibahandiika egarafu y'amaani g'omuringo gw'omusingye kuruga omu busobozi bw'omuringo oguhikire, nibwo bareeba ngu obuzito buriho obutahinduka.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibahanga ekigarama kuruga omu meza erikurikira amaani g'omuriro ogurikwenda omu mutambi gw'amasanyu aha businge obutari bumwe, reero bagishoboorore.
answer_c: Abeshomesa nibashoma obuzito bw'ebintu ebirikuhita omu bintu ebitarikumanywa; ahakyehengyerezi kyona, nibahabwa omuhendo gw'amaani g'omushana n'obwingi bw'omushana ebyapimwa omu muringo gw'okugezesa.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibahabwe ebipingamizi ebirikumaraana kandi bashoborore, omu kubiha omuringo gw'amaani g'omushana ogumwe ahari buri kimwe, yaaba oburinganire oburikugambwa omukozi nibwo buraikiriza.

question: Omuhendiisa omu, omu n’ekicweka ky’okwegyesa ekirikugira ngu “Obusyo n’Obutiti”, nagabiira abegyesibwa be ab’omwaka ogw’abiri ogw’ahaiguru eby’okusoma ebi: “Omu kyasha kya 17, emirimo mingi y’okucukura ekaba etungire aha bwiju oburikugira ngu okucwamu amaizi agaba gakungaanire hansi kukaba nikureetera oburemeezi bukuru, kandi empampu ezirikucwamu amaizi zikaba zineetengwa okugyemeeserezebwa n’enfuraasi nari abantu. Obu bwire, abahanga nk’a Torricelli nari von Guericke bakakora entunguuka nkuru ezirikukwata aha kinyigizo ky’omwanya, okubaho kw’omwanya ogutariimu kintu, n’ekirikwetwa “amaani g’omuriro”. Omuntu okubanza kugezaaho kuzooka ekyoma ky’okucwamu amaizi kuruga aha ntunguuka ezi akaba ari Papin, nangwa n’obu ekizooka kye kitakazoorwa. Savery akagira obusinge bwingi, ou yazookize ekyoma ahu omwanya ogutariimu kintu gwatungwa obu omwika gwaamaire. Omu mwaka gwa 1712, Newcomen akazooka ekyoma ekirikukora gye, ekirikugira ngu, ahabw’okuba kitarikwetenga obwingi bw’omwika, kikaba kirimu oburinzi bwingi, kandi kikakoresebwa emyaka makumi mushanju hatariho okuhindura kukuru. Entunguuka endiijo yakozirwe Watt, ou, akimanyire ebyahurirwe Black aha by’obutiti obw’ekihiso, akagira ekirooto ky’okutaana ekigyamiisyo n’omubiri gw’ekikoreso, yazooka ekyoma ekya mbere n’ekizooka eki omu mwaka gwa 1776. Ekyoma kya Watt, ekirikucweera sente n’ekirikukora gye, kyarangiire nikikoresebwa, okugyenda hamu, omu mirimo y’ebyoma n’engoye. Tekinologia enu ekatumirwa kuruga omu Bungereza okugyenda omu mahanga agarikwetenga okugyenda omu by’amakuru, nk’e Bufaransa, Bugirimaani, na Russia. Tekinologia enu ekaba entandikiro y’empinduka egi ekyagumizemu okuhika n’obu bwire kandi ekareetera okutungwa kw’ebikoreso bya tekinologia ebiherize.” Ni mirimo ki erikukurataho ei abegyesibwa barikubaasa kukora kuruga omu kusoma kw’ebyahandiikirwe ebiherize?
answer_a: Shoborora omukoragiro gw'ekyombo ky'amaizi ekya Watt yaayombeka
answer_b: Shwijuma obuhangwa bw'ebishushani bya sayansi, oronderere ebirungi byabyo n'obulema bwabyo omu kushoborora ebintu ebirikubaho omu butonde.
answer_c: Haaza eby'okureeberaho, ebimanyiso nari engero ezibagumisiriza kuhuura ebiri omu By'obuhangwa n'okwetegyereza ebintu ebirikubaho omu magara ga buri izooba
answer_d: Yoreka omuringo omanyiso ogurikugambira aha ngyenderwaho y’okuzooka n’okukura kw’okugyenda nibakombeka obwengye, n’okukura kwabo nikuhuriirana n’embeera z’abantu n’eby’omutaano by’ebiro by’enyima.

question:
Omu kwegyesa eby'obuhangwa (Physics), embeera ezirikweshobya ezimanyirweho nibemanyisa, ezi abeeshuri baine kandi ezirikukwata aha kwega ebiteekateeko bisya n'ebirikukwata aha 'Obushushu n'Obutiti.'
Ni enki aha biteekateeko ebi ekitarikukwatana n'emwe aha mbeera ezi ezirikweshobya?
answer_a: Obusyo buri omu nkora z'ebintu
answer_b: Obwire obutaro n'ekirikuhakanisa obushuushu nari okubura kwabwo
answer_c: Obusyo nibwo bureetera obubiri oburenga obubiri kubaaho.
answer_d: Obusyo burimu obusinge nk'omugano gwabwo ogw'amaisho ogurikushushana.

question: Omu bitegyereize omumutwe gw'enyegyesa "Eihuriro" omuishomero rya haiguru, abeegi nibategyerezibwa kubaasa kushoboorora ahabw'enki hariho enjura omu bwomeezi bw'eihuriro erikumanywa nk'ery'omutindo hagati y'ebicurangiro ebirikukozesebwa. Ni nshoboroora ki ezirikwetagisa abeegi kubaasa kushuuruura gye omutindo gw'eihuriro?
answer_a: Amaani n'omuranga
answer_b: Okukoraana n'okwegatta kw'emyoba
answer_c: Okutangaanira n'okwijukya kw'omururu gw'eihuriro
answer_d: Omuringo n'obureingwa bw'omururu gw'eihururu ry'omuriro

question: Omwegyesereza naayenda kushwijuma oku abegi baahikiirize ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Kuhimba ebirikushoboorora ebimwe aha bintu ebirikukwata aha mashanyarazi, nk'okushariza emibiri n'okurekurana kw'amashanyarazi." Ni kiratira ki aha birikukurataho ekirikukwata aha kushwijuma ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Nibashobora kushoborora embeera ezirikwemerera omugyendere gwa amashanyarazi omu bintu bigumu, ebintu by'amaizi, hamwe n'emyoka, turikuhereza eby'okureeberaho bya buri emwe.
answer_b: Nibashobora kushoborora embeera n'oburinganiza ebiriho ebirikugambira aha maani g'omuriro oguri hagati y'ebintu bibiri ebirikukwata omuriro, kurugiirira aha biragiro bya Coulomb.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza emiringo n'eby'obuhangwa ebirinda abantu omu bintu bimwe ebirikubiha eby'amasannyalaze, nk'okutaaha omu itaka n'emigongo y'enkuba, n'ebindi.
answer_d: Nibashoboorora ngu ebintu ebirikuhitsya amashanyarazi birimu oburemeezi bw'amashanyarazi kandi ngu nibirikuruga aha mugano gwabyo, obureingwa, obukuru bw'ekicweka, hamwe n'obushushu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi n’ekigendererwa ky’okukora omurimo gw’okubaza abegyesi be abari omu mwaka ogwa kabiri omunshomero erikuru, ogurikubasisa kumanya yaaba bahikireho obureezi bw’okuteekateeka omu bwa sayansi: ‘Kumanya oburemeezi bw’ebishushani bya sayansi n’enyegyesa.’ Omu mbeera y’omutwe ‘Amaani n’okugyeenda: okugyeenda n’amateeka gaakwo’, oruhe murimo aha mirimo erikukurira yoona ogurikukorwa abegyesi ogurikubaasisa omwegyesi omwegyesereza kubaza okukuura kw’obureezi obwo obwaba nibugambwaho?
answer_a: Teekateeka kandi otungye omuringo gw'okupima omulingo omubiri ogurikutairuka omuhanda oguteekamire gwaagutsiruka, noogugyeragyeranisa n'empima zaagwo aharukundukama orutari rumwe.
answer_b: Kora omugeso gw’okushobora omureetera gw’omubiri ogu gwe gucweera omu kwegwa obusaasi n’okuringaanisa ebirugiremu n’ebyo ebiragurirwe omu biteekateeko.
answer_c: Gumuraho ebizibu by'okugyeza omubiri ogugyenda omuhanda ogugorore, murikukoresa amagezi g'ebya kinematika n'omukago oguli hagati yabyo, kwonka mugyeragyeranise ebirivaamu n'ebyo mwarikuteekateeka.
answer_d: Bala omuhendo gw'obwire bw'okugwa, obureingwa bwa haiguru obu etindo erihikaho, hamu n'omuhindo gw'omutindo gw'okugwa omu itaka, orikukoresa omuringo ogurikushoborora okugwa kw'etindo n'okutendeka etindo omu iguru, orikugyeragyeranisa ebirugiremu n'eby'abandi.

question: Omwegyesereza w’eby’obutonde bw’ensi, okumaliriza omutwe “Omushana”, arikutebeekanisiza abegi be omwaka ogw’okubanza omu mashomero agari haihi eky’okukora ekirikugambira aha kugyeza: Hasi aha hariho embeera ibiri omu ebirimu amatabaaza g’obunene obutari bumwe garikwaka ekishushani. a) Geranisiza emigisha y’ekisiima egiija kureebeka aha kishushani omu mbeera 1 na 2. b) Hikiriza eky’okugarukamu kyaawe orikukoresa engyenderwaho y’omushana nk’obuntu n’eby’okureeba ebirikukoresa emiringo. Bumanyi ki obw’obuhangwa oburikubaasa kugyezibwa kuraba omu kukora oku?
answer_a: Okureetera amakuru kuraba omu bimwani bya saayansi
answer_b: Kushoborora ebiri omu bubiikiro kuruga omu kunoonyereza kwa saayansi
answer_c: Shoborora orukurata aha mishangwa y'obwengye n'enyegyesa.
answer_d: Manyara agashoborozi agahendera eby'okureeberaho n'enyegyesa za saayansi birimu

question: Omwegyesereza orikuza n'abeshuri abari omu mwaka gwa 3 owa siniya aha biteekateeko by'obusinge bw'obushuushu, omu muringo gw'ekicweka ky'Obushuushu n'Obutegyeki. Nkahi aha by'okureeberaho ebya buri izooba erikukiriza kuteekateeka aha biteekateeko ebi?
answer_a: Ku rikwoora ekikopo ky'omutaayi kuruga omunda ya firigi okumara obwire buraingwa, amataba agatangaazire nigaboneka ahaiguru yaakyo.
answer_b: N’obu omuriro ogw’amaani gukozesebwa, obushuushu bw’enteeka erimu amaizi agyesire tiburikwongyera okukura bwaba bukiriho amaizi omu nteeka.
answer_c: Bwanyima y'obwire obumwe turikugarura enyama, ebitakuli bikyashushire munonga kurya, kwonka enyama neebaasa kuribwa hatariho buzibu.
answer_d: Waaba orikureeta ecupa erangiirwe omwiru n'ecupa endiijo erikushushana nayo erangiirwe omweru omu izooba, zoona ziine amaizi omunda, eya omwiru ehika aha bwokyo bwingi okukira eya omweru.

question: Omuhanda gwaha ebintu ebi orikubaasa kukuratira kuruga aha ky'okumanya ekikuru okuhika aha kintu kimwe omu by'okwegyesa ebya kemisiri y'ebintu ebirikukwatana (polymer chemistry) omu mashomero agaa Middle School niguriha?
answer_a: Reeta eby'okureeberaho bya monoma, oshoboorore oku polima zikoorwa kuraba omu muringo gw'ebikorwa bya kemikali ebirikugyenderera hamwe, reero ohe eby'okureeberaho bya polima ez'obutonde n'ez'omuntu ezikoresibwa omu magara ga buri izooba.
answer_b: Okutandika n'eby'okurorraho bya polima ezikozesebwa omu bwomeezi obwa burijo (ez'obutonde n'ez'omuntu), reero oshoborore okuzaaho kwa polima kuraba omu miringo y'ebikemiko erikugyerana nako, kandi oherizeho oshoborore ebi monoma eri.
answer_c: Ha eby'okureeberaho by'ebintu bya polima eby'obutonde n'ebyo abantu baroonda ebi turikukoresa buri izooba, reero oronde ebintu byabyo ebirikubumbwa; bwanyima oshoboorore oku polima ezi zirukorwa kuraba omu muringo gw'okuhinduka kw'ebintu.
answer_d: Yoreka eky'okureeberaho eby'okuhinduka kw'ebintu ebiri omu by'omugasho ebya buri izooba ebya polima hamwe na monoma zaabyo, reero oshaabe ngu, kurugiirira aha ky'okureeberaho eki, bashange polima zindi eziri omu by'omugasho ebya buri izooba kandi batebeekanise okuhinduka kw'ebintu byazo.

question: Ni by'okugamba ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba nibamanyiire obundi kubaasa kwetegyereza eby'omutendera gw'obutareeba bwa radiyo?
answer_a: Enyima y'omutima gw'akatomu
answer_b: Ebirikuta by'akatomu ebigumbya ebintu
answer_c: Emyemererwa y'omumaisho y'obutini bw'ebintu
answer_d: Omuringo gw'ebipimo by'ebintu ebirimu atomu ezineenura

question: Omu klasse erikukwata aha by'obutwa bw'amaanyi, abeegi nibakora okunoonyereza kushoboorora okubaho kw'ekyoma omu nyonyoozi enkuru munonga. Ni by'okwegaho ki ebi abeegi bashemereire kuba baine kugira ngu bashoboorore omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Omugano gw'okuhikaana kw'amaani n'enzitoya
answer_b: Okuhindura omuringo gw'obuziizi
answer_c: Okuhurikana kw'amaatomu
answer_d: Okutaanura atomu

question: Ni bwihangirizo ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba nibamanyire kubaasa kukora aha mugenzo gwa VSEPR omu buziba obutari bumwe?
answer_a: Omuguta gw'akanyaara ogurikuruga omu molekyu ezitari zimwe
answer_b: Eky'omugasho ky'ebiri n'eky'omunana omu kubumbwa kw'ebirikurungaana
answer_c: Okureetera ebiri omu miringo y’emigati ey’ekemiko erikuba rihari omu by’obuzimbe
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okwegamira kw'ebipande bya electron omu shell y'ahaiguru gwakozesibwa aha molecule ez'enjawulo

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurira ekibiina kye: Yoreka emicwe ya pH omu kucwekyereza asidi erikuguma n'omusingi ogutagumire. Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, niki ekirikuba kimanyiso ekikuru okutaho omutima ahabw'okwega oku?
answer_a: Nibakora ekikuubagizo ky'omuguta ogw'amaani n'omusingi oguteera amaani.
answer_b: Nibakora ekigereso ky'okugyeragyeranisa asidi erimu amaani n'omusingi ogutari mwingi amaani.
answer_c: Nibarikira omuhendo gw'okucwekyereza asidi orikugumire n'omusingi ogutagumire kurugiirira ahari pKb y'omusingi.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza kumanya obwingi bw'ekirikali ekikomeire kurugiirira aha bwingi obumanyirwe bw'omusingi ogutakomeire

question: Omuhendiki w’ekyemistry omu class, omugurusi atekereza ngu abegi bashobore kushoborora n’okugaragaza okukwatana kw’emikoba ya ionic na covalent. Murimo ki ogw’okumaliriza oguraikiriza omugurusi kwemeza ngu ekigyendererwa kye kyahikiirweho?
answer_a: Nimworeka ekishushani kya Lewisi ekirikworeka molekyu erimu oburyo bwombi bw'emigongo, reero obagambire kubara ilekitooni z'omu rubindo rw'ahahendo.
answer_b: Kuhakanisa orutonde rw'ebintu n'obuhereza kubategyereza yaaba nibaza kwikiriza ekiragiro ky'ababiri nari ekiragiro ky'omunaana
answer_c: Baha ebiranga n'omubaro gw'obuziba bw'ebintu bishatu, babasabe kubumba emiramu ebiri, buli gumwe gubeineho kimwe aha mitindo ebiri y'emigyeri.
answer_d: Nimuhendera n'ekimeeza ekirikworeka obushushu obu ebintu bishatu by'emishonga birikufuumukira n'okushaanuuka, reero obabuuze kumanya omutaano gw'emigyenzo ebi birikukora.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa n’abegyeswa be ab’omwaka ogw’akabiri omu mashomero ag’ahaagati. Nk’ekicweka ky’entebeekanisa ye, atekateeka kushwijuma obu abegyeswa bahikire aha kiragiro “Kukoresa amagezi g’omugatte gw’ebintu ebiri omu kintu kimwe.” Ebikorwa ebiri aha hansi ebiheebwa nibirikwenda kukora aha kiragiro eki?
answer_a: Nibasheengura ebintu ebirikushaanuuka omu maizi kandi bagamba ekika ky'omutaano ogurikukora kurugiirira aha mbeera y'omubiri y'ekintu ekirikushaanuuka n'ekirikushaanuura.
answer_b: Nibashomesa omuhendo ogutari gumwe gw'omunyu omu muringo oguhikire gw'amaizi kandi batebeekaho buli kidomola omu mulingo ogurikwongyera omulingo gw'omunyu n'amaizi.
answer_c: Nibarikiza omu muringo ogutari gumwe ogw'omunyu omu bunzi bw'amaizi obuhikire aha bwiro butari bumwe kandi bagamba aha mikorere y'omunyu ogwo.
answer_d: Nibashomesa ebintu ebirikushaanuuka omu bishanuurizi ebihendahenda, reero bagamba emigyenzo ya buri kintu ekirikushaanuuka kurugiirira aha kishanuurizi eki baayegire.

question: Omu omuhanda gw'amasomo g'omukoro gw'amasanyalaze omukuru omu by'obuganga, omugurusi naayoleka orukomo rw'amasanyalaze orurikugurwa orurikwetwa orukomo rwa Downs, orurikukiriza okutunga sodium y'ekyoma kuraba omu kucwekyereza sodium chloride (NaCl) erikashaanuuka. Ebintu ebiri ahaansi ebiheebwa nibibaasa kureebwa omu kukora kw'orukomo rwa Downs?
answer_a: Eshumu ya sodium erikukwata aha anode neeba neeshangwaireho ahabw'okuceebya kwa sodium ions
answer_b: Ggaasi ya chlorine erugwa aha cathode okurabira omu kufeerwa kw'amasannyalaze kw'ebipooli bya chloride.
answer_c: Ayoni za chloride zigenda aha anode ahabw'okugwa oxidation
answer_d: Obutomi bwa sodium nibwo buhunga aha cathode ahabw'okugabwa electroni.

question: Omu kwegyesa ari omu mbeera y'okwegyesa abeeshuri ebiri ahari polyfunctional organic molecules, naagamba aha by'okunuura eby'obutonde n'ebyakozirwe abantu. Kandi arikukora eki, naareeta empaka ezirikukwata aha mukago oguri hagati y'eby'okunuura na kansa. Aha bigambo ebi, ekirikubaasa kutwarwa nk'ekigambo eky'obuhangwa ekirikukwata aha mukago oguri hagati y'eby'okunuura n'amagara g'abantu niki?
answer_a: Saccharin neereetera ekookoro y'enshagama omu bwina, ahabw'okuba hariho okushomesa okurikworeka eki omu mbeba.
answer_b: Ebirungo by'okuburamu esukari birimu atomu ezirikubaasa kutaataaganya amagara g'abantu, nk'eriklorine, eririkubaasa kureeta kansa.
answer_c: Okushwijukira ebyahandiikirwe bya NCI, kikagambwa ngu omuhendo gw’okurwara kooko y’obwongo gukatandika kweyongyera omu mwaka gwa 1973, emyaka munaana bwanyima ya aspartame kutandika kutundwa.
answer_d: Ebihari by'okwerinda amagara omu United States byagambire ngu okukoresa ebirungo by'okunywera nikwo kureetera kansa y'enda y'abakazi abamareka bamwe.

question: Abeshomesa abarikwega baine kwetegyereza omu muringo gw'okukora endagaano z'ebirikukora omunda y'ebintu ebirimu obutonde bw'emibiri. Okukora eki, nibakoresa ebintu ebirimu carbonyl, nk'eky'okureeberaho formaldehyde na acetone, kandi okubyetegyereza, nibakoresa Tollens' reagent na chromic acid, nibakora omu muringo ogu: 1. Nibateeka 2 mL ya formaldehyde omu kacupa kamwe ak'okugezesereza hamwe na 2 mL ya acetone omu kandi. 2. Nibongyeraho 2 mL ya Tollens' reagent omuri buri kacupa. 3. Nibabugumya omu mazi agyezireho obucupa obu hatarikubaasa kureebwa enkyukakyuka yoona. 4. Nibagarukamu okukora nk'oku omukanya 1 kandi nibongyeraho 2 mL ya chromic acid omuri buri kacupa. Kurugiira aha by'okurora ebirikwetegyezwa omu kugezesa, aha bigambo ki ebi abeshomesa bashemereire kuhikaana nabyo?
answer_a: Asiidi ya kuromi erikukiriza okumanya butooni zonyine
answer_b: Eky'okukoresa ekikozeso kya Tollens nikikora kityo nikibaasa kworekwa aldehydes zyonka.
answer_c: Asiidi ya kuromiika neyemerera kumanya ekintu kyona ekirikugira akakuumiro ka kaboniili
answer_d: Ekyombeko kya Tollens nikikozesebwa kworeka ekintu kyona ekirimu carbonyl

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi ya Primary 1 omwegyesa naija kutandika kukora aha kigyendererwa ky'okureeba n'okushoboorora empinduka ezirikubaho omu bintu obu orikukoresa amaani, omushana, obushuushu, n'amaizi. Mwegyesa ashemereire kukora aha ki bwambere atakatandika kukora aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Empinduka omu mbeera omu bintu ebirikushushana
answer_b: Emitwaro y'amaani, omushana, obushyuushu, n'amaizi
answer_c: Ebintu by'omutaano ebirukoresibwa omu bwire obwoona obutungiire omu magara gaitu
answer_d: Ekiro ekikorwa ky'amaani, omushana, obushuushu, nari amaizi aha bintu bitari bimwe

question: Omwegyesereza n'omwegyesi ari kukora aha bikwatiraine n'emitwarize y'ensi n'abegyi be ab'omumwaka gwa kana kandi nayenda kureetera eky'okureeberaho ky'emitwarize y'ensi kuraba omu kintu eki turikukoresa buri izooba. Ni kintu ki aha bintu ebi ekirikubaasa kureetera okwetegyereza kw'omutwe ogwo omu muringo murungi?
answer_a: Egi erikaitwe kutegyeka
answer_b: Ekikumi ky'Abarussia ekiteebekanisiibwe
answer_c: Ekyana eky'ebiceegye
answer_d: Omupiira gw'ebitoogo

question:
Shoma omwegyesa arikureeba embeera egi:
Omwegyesa w'abaana abato areeba Mariana, orikufukamira omu rubaraza aine endorerwamu omu mukono gwe. Areeba omuishwa ogwo naayimutsya amabaare kandi areeba ahansi yaago, nashuuruura ahansi y'ebimera, kandi naggyaho ebikooko by'omutsyo. Omwegyesa amwiira haihi, amubuuza eki arikukora, kandi Mariana amushoboorora ngu arikushaka enjojo z'amabaare ahabw'okuba naazikunda kuziingazinga omu mikono ye. Omwegyesa amubuuza, "Noora ngu shi enjojo z'amabaare nibakiira zita?"
Bukumanyirizi ki obw'obuhangwa omwegyesa arikwesiga kuteera aha mutwe Mariana obu arikumuza eki kibuuzo?
answer_a: Okuragura
answer_b: Kureeba
answer_c: Kugyezaho
answer_d: Okugyenda omu kubumbura ebikumire

question: Omwegyesereza naayenda kumanya yaaba abeeshuri beine obushoboorozi bw’okutebeekanisa omurimo gw’okukora ebiteeso kurugiirira aha kibuuzo eki baheebwa. Aha mirimo ekurikukurira etegyeka ki eyaaba neyikiriza ekigyendererwa eki kucungurwa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebishushani n'okugyayo amakuru omuri byo
answer_b: Nibarikoresa kandi bashwijuma eby'okureeberaho kureeta obuhabuzi bwabo.
answer_c: Nibarikana ebikaguzo bya saayansi n'ebitari bya saayansi
answer_d: Nibarikira kushobora kwerengyesa n'empindahinduka ezirikwejumburwa n'ezitarikwejumburwa omu kunoonyereza

question: Ni kikuru ki aha by’okukora ebi orikubaasa kureetera omwegyesa kumanya ebi abeeshuri barikukuratira omu biteekateeko byabo aha ku ebirunga birikubumbuka?
answer_a: Abeekusomesa bashomere kukuratira ebice by'omunwa gw'omuriro omu kishushani ekirikwoleka omunda yagwo
answer_b: Abeekusomesa kworeka okuturika kw'omuriro gw'omunsi nibakozesa viniga, baking soda, flask, n'ebindi bikoreso omu ky'okureeberaho ky'ekicweka ky'omunsi ekirukuturika.
answer_c: Abeekusomesa bashomesere, nibakozesa maapu y'ensi yoona erikworeka ebipande bya tekitoniki, ahabw'enki Omuringo gw'Omuriro ogwa Pasifiki gwatumwa eiziina eryo.
answer_d: Abaana bashuubure obusaale bw’okuhendeka kw’ebintu omunda y’omuriro gw’omunengo omu kishushani ekirikworeka omuringo gw’omunda gw’ekibumbiro ky’ensi n’omuriro gw’omunengo.

question: Ni ebiki aha binu ebikorwa ebirikwija kureka abeeshure kushwijuma ekirikureeta okwokya kw'ensi yoona?
answer_a: Ekitabo ky'omukura ogurimu ebimurikwa omu jurnali y'eby'obuhangwa nikiragaza aha migisha n'obubi bw'ebintu ebirimu chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs). Nikigamba ngu CFCs zikozesibwa omu by'okukonyeza, omu by'okucwekyereza, n'omu by'okukora ebintu by'amabaati, kandi ngu nibita obuziba bw'omwanya ogurikukuumira ensi, obwo ozone layer. Obwo buziba bw'omwanya ogurikukuumira ensi nibukendeera, emishana y'akasana erimu obubi neeyingira omu nsi, egi neereeta endwara nk'ekooko y'aha ruhu n'okuhinduka kw'obwire. Ekitabo eki nikigamba ngu ensi yoona neetaaine kukora hamwe kukendeeza aha kukoresa CFCs n'okushanga ebintu ebirukukora nkazo ebitarikweta obuziba bw'omwanya ogurikukuumira ensi.
answer_b: Shwijuma ekicweka ky'omukura ky'eshaayansi ekirikugamba aha bwingi bwa CO2 omu bwire butari bumwe omu mwaka omu byaro bitari bimwe
answer_c: Okureetera hamu n'ebicweka by'omucwe gw'okushwijuma ogurikukwata aha kwongyera obwingi bwa CO2 omu bwengye.
answer_d: Shwijuma omu by’okushwijuma ebya sayansi ebirimu amakuru agizire aha mikoranire y’ekihindamisho ky’obushomerezi aha bwingi bw’emigaza ehumbya.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi areeta omutwe gw'ekibarua ky'amahuura eki aha banaishomero be ab'ekitaano na kimwe: 'Obuhara bw'ebintu ebi omu Chile nibureeta abantu abarikufa batakikiziire obukumi buna ahabw'endwaara z'omutima n'obuhago.' Kurugiirira aha mutwe gw'ekibarua ky'amahuura eki, omwegyesi nagira abanaishomero be kwetebeekanisa n'okukora empaka aha miringo y'okwerinda okumaraho oburemeezi obu. Aha ndengo z'okwega ezi, niziha ezirikukwatana n'omurimo ogurikutebeekanisibwa omwegyesi ogu?
answer_a: Nibarikira aha bigaragara omu bishushani ebirikworeka okufa kw'abantu batakikiziire obwire ahabw'endwaara z'omutima omu myaka ikumi ehingwire
answer_b: Nibarikiriza ebipimo by’okucwekyereza omuhendo gw’ebyokushiisha ebirukoresibwa omu bitundu by’ensi ebindi.
answer_c: Nibarikirana aha migasho n'obubi bw'ebirikubaasa kukorwa kucwera obucafu bw'obutonde bw'ensi.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ensonga ahabw'enki omuhendo gw'obucafu gweyongyera omu bwire bw'obutiti n'emitindo eyakozirweho okucweeka omuhendo ogu.

question: Omugureesi acwireho kucungura kureeba yaaba abeeshuri beebembera kumanya kwabo aha by'okurya ebi baayegire omu magara gaabo. Ni mirimo ki erikuhikaana n'ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Omu kubuuti, nibahandiika endyo erikukwata aha miteera y'okulya y'abatooro.
answer_b: Buri omu, bakora ebyokurya byabo, kwesiga oburemi bwabo, okurenga, emirimo y’omubiri, n’ekikomekyo
answer_c: Omwe omwe na omwe, bakora orutonde rw'ebyokurya ebirimu omugisha mwingi ebi barikurya.
answer_d: Omu mirongo, nibashwijuma ebirugiremu by'okubonereza okwakozirwe omu ishomero ryabo aha mbeera y'okurya.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurira ekibiina kye: Shoboorora omukago oguri ahagati y'omurimo gw'akacu n'ebicweka byako. Ni ekirikukurira aha bigyendererwa by'okwegyesa ebirikukiraho ebirikutebeekanisibwa omurimo ekirooba n'ekigyendererwa ky'ekibiina eki?
answer_a: Shobora orugufu nk’ekintu kikuru ekirikugyendererwa omu bintu ebiriho byona
answer_b: Geranisiza ebirimu omunda y’akatuuti n’ebizimbiso by’akatuuti ebiri omu bika by’akatuuti eby’enjawulo
answer_c: Shoborora emiterere y'ebintu ebiri omu kashushani k'akacu k'ekirikari n'ak'ekitarikari.
answer_d: Huura ebicweka by’akacu n’ebi abahanga nk’aba Hooke, Leeuwenhoek, Virchow, Schleiden, na Schwann baahwereireho.

question: Omugyezibwa naagambira abeeshuli be kukora omulimo ogurikukurataho omu bibinja: 1. Baine kutoora abarikwenda abashatu: omubanza anywa 700 mL y'amaizi, owakabiri 700 mL y'ekinywebwa ekirikugyema omubiri, na owakashatu tinywa kintu kyona. 2. Omu kasumi ka mita 90, baine kuza omu kaabuyo bakunganye enjujo yaabo aha mita 30, mita 60, na mita 90. 3. Omu kasumi koona, baine kupima obwingi bw'enjujo n'ekipimiso ky'obwingi; n'oburemu bwayo, n'akakarati k'okugyezesa enjujo. 4. Eky'ahaheru, baine kuteekateeka aha bintu ebirikukora eshagama nari enjujo kurugiirira aha byarugire omu muntu omwe na omwe. Obureezi ki obwa saayansi n'ebirikukwata aha by'okwesomesa ebi abeeshuli barikwija kukoraho n'omulimo ogu?
answer_a: Okushwijuma ebiragiro, kwegaaha eky’omugano gw’amaizi
answer_b: Okureeta ebirikukwata aha data, kwetegyereza oku omubiri gurikugumya obwingi bw'amashagama
answer_c: Kutebeera ebiteekateeko by'okucwekyereza, okushoma embeera y'amazzi n'omunyu
answer_d: Kugumisiriza embeera, kworeka ebirikuruga omu matafaari g'obuto bw'ebintu ebirikushushana omu bungi bw'amaazi g'omushana omu matooki

question: Ni eni aha ebiri erikukurira aha, niki ekirikworeka enyikiriza etahikire abeeshuri abari omu P7/P8 abamanyire kugira aha nkyukakyuka omu bintu?
answer_a: Empindahinduka ry'ebirikale nirishobora kuba eririkugarukwamu nari eritarikugarukwamu
answer_b: Amazi kugyera nikikwatanisa n'empinduka etarikugaruka enyima
answer_c: Obusyo bw'omubiri tiguhinduka amazzi gaaba nigahinduka kuruga omu ngaro nkomeire okugyenda omu ngaro y'amazzi.
answer_d: Obunzima bw'ekintu nibuguma butyo obu kigyezibwa omu kikarikukyusa embeera y'omubiri.

question: Omugyezihya naayoreka abegi be embeera egi: Tuteebere ngu twine amaizi aha bwokya bwa 60°C omu kacaali kamwe, kandi omu kacaali ekindi twine omutaano gw'amaizi guringaine aha bwokya bwa 20°C. Nitushuka ebirimu by'obucaali obubiri omu kacaali ekya kashatu. Obwokya bw'omugataano nibwija kuba bwingahi? Obwo, nabaasaasira abegi kwenda eky'okuragura ekirikukwatana n'ekibuuzo, kurugiirira aha kubara, reero bakore okucwekyereza okurikukora. Ku baraamare kukihikiiriza, abegi nibareeba ngu obwokya bw'omugataano buri hansi y'obwo buraamiirwe n'okubara kw'omu mutwe. Ekyakurataho, omugyezihya nabaasaasira kuheereza enshonga ahabw'enki nibateekateeka ngu eki kibaahireho kandi bayoreke ebi baabaire nibesigamiiraaho ku baabaire nibakora okubara. Ni bikorwa ki aha bigyendererwa ebi (ebirikukorwa abegi) ebi omugyezihya arikusiima kuraba omu mulingo gw'okwega ogurikukorwa abegi?
answer_a: Shuuruura enshobi ezirikukorwa omu kubara omu muringo ogu gw'emyitooro
answer_b: Shwijuma oburemeezi bw'omuringo ogukozirwe kukora okubara kwabo.
answer_c: Shisha enshobi ezirikukwata aha muringo ogurikukuratirwa ezakozirwe omu murimo gw'okukora eby'okushwijuma
answer_d: Teeka omuringo gw'okukora ebitebeekaniso ebirikukwasisa okutunga data erikukurirana n'enyegyesa

question: Omugyezaho ki omwegyesa orikukora ogu araabe niguhamya ebi omwegi arikuteekateeka aha muhanda gw'amasannyalaze?
answer_a: Shaba omwegyeshwa kushoboorora omu magambo ge ahurikire ekyarikukwata aha maani g'omuriro n'entobeko y'amaani omu muzunguruko ogurikukurirana.
answer_b: Yoreka omugyeragizo ogurikworeka omwana orikubaasa kureeba amaani g'omushana gw'amatabaaza garikugyirwa hamwe omu muhendo ogurikukuratana
answer_c: Mugambire omwegi okushomesha n'okuringaanisa amaani g'omuriro ogurikwaka omu bulubu yoona ekwatirwe hamwe omu mutungo gw'omushokano, kandi ashoboorore ebi arikureeba.
answer_d: Yoreka omuringo gw'amasannyalaze ogw'amatara ana agyegataire omu muringo ogwa paralleli n'ogundi ogw'amatara ana agyegataire omu muringo gwa seriesi, kandi oshoborore ebirikurebwa.

question: Omwegi orikwegyesibwa akahwa akakurira: DDT ekaba omuti ogurikukozesibwa munonga kwita ebinyegere; kwonka, bwanyima y’emyaka mikye ogw’okugukoresa munonga, gukaba gutakyakora aha binyegere. Ahabwenki DDT yarekereraaho kukora aha binyegere bwanyima y’okugikoresa munonga? Omwegi yaagarukiremu ahabw’omuringo ogu: Bwanyima y’obwire buriheru obw’okumanyira DDT, ebinyegere bikakora obwomeezi obwabire nibibasiisa n’abaana baabyo kutarikwetenga omuti ogwo. Ni nteekateeka ki etahikire erikworekwa omu kugarukamu kw’omwegi?
answer_a: Abantu omu bwingi bw'abantu abaine ebintu ebirungi nibo barokoka kandi bareke ebyana
answer_b: Abantu omuri ekikungu abagira empindahinduka ezibagasa nibo barokoka kandi bakahereza empindahinduka eziyo aha baana baabo
answer_c: Abantu abali omu bwingi bw'abantu, okusobora kwetantara embeera y'obwire, baine kutebeza ebintu ebibasobozesa kuramuka n'okusiiga abazukulu
answer_d: Abantu abasinga omu bwiire nibafiira omu kuhiganwa n'abarikugira enshisha ezirungi, kandi aba nibo abaraareke abana.

question: Kugira ngu omwegyesa akure omutwe gw'ebirikukwata aha kubungaanira amakuru g'obutonde bw'omubiri, ataho ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikugira ngu: "Kwetegyereza ngu hariho oburyo oburikukwasa kubungaanira amakuru g'obutonde bw'omubiri." Kugira ngu akihikiirize, yaatooraine ebiri ahansi aha: 1. Okwambukira aha misalaba (Crossing-over). 2. Okuhindurangana kw'ebicweka by'omubiri (Chromosomal permutation). 3. Interphase n'okweitaana kw'obutofaali omu butofaali bw'omubiri n'obw'okubyara. 4. Okutebeekanisibwa kw'ebintu by'obutonde bw'omubiri omu butofaali. 5. Obucweka oburikureeberera okweitaana kw'obutofaali. Omu rukurato rw'okwegyesa orurikukurira aha, niki ekirikwija kureetera omwegyesa kutebeekanisa ebiri omunda kuruga aha kikuru okuhika aha kitini?

Omuhwezi omu itooro ry'okubanza ery'ekicweka 'Akashagama', omugyezibwa naayenda kukoresa omuringo ogurikwija kureka abeeshuri be kumanya ngu saayansi n'omuringo ogutahwera gw'okugyenda nibamanya ebintu ebirikukwata aha bwomeezi oburikugira akamukamu aha bantu. Ni muringo ki ogurikukurataho ogurikwija kureka omugyezibwa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shaba abeeshuri bakore omufaano ogurikworeka oku proteini zirikurugamu omu cell, kandi obagambire n'oha omushomesa orikukuru kuhakanura omuhanda ogu.
answer_b: Yoreka abeshomesha ebishushani by'obutofaali ebirikushangwa omu ndorerwamu ez'emiringo etari emwe n'emwe
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesha kuhandiika omuhandiko ogurikukwata aha muhendo gw'abamanyisi b'ebya sayansi abarikushoboorora enyegyesa y'obutofaali.
answer_d: Teeka omukoro ogurikukora, abegi bashobore kureeba amataaba agatari gamwe ag'obushoboorozi n'okuhuumuriza emiterere yaago n'omurimo gwaago

question: Omuhendo gw’omwegyesa ogurikukoresa omu kwegyesa ebintu by’amasannyalaze, omwegyesa atekateeka entekaniza y’emirimo ekurikurugaana: 1. Agambira abegyi kukora eby’okureeberaho bingi kubaasa kushanga obutandwa bw’amasannyalaze. 2. Omwegyesa abuuza abegyi ebirikukwata aha butandwa bw’amasannyalaze kandi yaahandiika eby’abegyi barikugarukamu aha kaadi omu kubateekateekyesa. 3. Abegyi batebeekanisibwa omu bibiina buri omwe aine omurimo gwe kandi baheebwa: obuballooni, empapura, obutingwa, n’abaruleeta. 4. Omwegyesa aragiira abegyi kwetenta obuballooni obuzimbire n’aruleeta n’omutwe gwabo nari ekyenda, reero babireete haihi n’ebintu bitari binene, nk’obutundu tw’empapura n’obutingwa oburikureega. 5. Abegyi nibashabwa kugamba n’okuhandiika ebi bareebire. 6. Eky’ahaheru, baheebwa obwire bw’okutebeekanisa okushoboorora okurikukirizibwa boona aha butandwa bw’amasannyalaze. Omu biteekateeko ebi, ekirikukurataho nikyo kigumira omurimo ogukozirwe?
answer_a: Ebirimu by'emyemerero tibirikukwatwaho
answer_b: Ebirimu eby'omutwe ebirikukorerwaho tibirikukwatanisibwa omu muringo ogurikwetengyesa.
answer_c: Obwengye bw'okuteekateeka omu bumenyi bwa sayansi tiburikukura.
answer_d: Okureeba tikurikwatana n'ebyo twamazire kubahoona.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa akakozeseza ekibuuzo eki omu kashomesha k'eby'okugyeza ebintu ebirikugyenda: "Ekintu nikigyeenda kurugiirira aha mucwe gw'ekikwatagurizo eki: x=25+40t−5t2 (t omu bisekondi na x omu miita). Obureiyo ki eki kintu kiriba kigyenzeho aha bisekondi 5 na 6?" Ku yaaba araabe areebire eby'okugarukamu, omwegyesa natunga ngu abeeshuri be tibarikwetegyereza ngu, kurugiirira aha by'okugarukamu byabo, ekintu kiriba kigyenzeho obureiyo bukye omu bwire burikurengaaho, ahabw'okuba abeeshuri abarikukiraho nibagarukamu ngu ekintu kigyenze miita 100 omu bisekondi 5 na miita 85 omu bisekondi 6. Omu by'okuhakanisa ebi orikukurataho, ekiheebwa ki ekirikushobora kushoboorora obugumire abu abeeshuri abarikukiraho barikurwana nabwo?
answer_a: Obugumu oburikwetengwa omu kushoma ebigambo by'ebizibu bya kinematics
answer_b: Okubura kw'okukora omurimo gw'okumanya ebintu ebihaire n'okukoresa emiringo erikusaana
answer_c: Okuteekateeka kukyeeka kw'obuhangwa aha by'ebirugiremu by'omubaro ebyatoonirwe omu buzibu bw'ekinematiika
answer_d: Obuhangwa oburikutegyereza omu kukuza amagezi g'okubara, okuhikira aha kucumura ebizibu bya kinematics.

question: Kugira ngu omwegyesa yorobeze ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekigira ngu "Eihuzo ry'obushushu nirireetera okuhindura amaani g'obushushu hagati y'ebintu ebirukiraine," n'ahaabwa abegyi be emirimo ekurikira bakoresa ebintu bibiri. 1. Kubara obwingi bw'obushushu ekintu ekiyehuliire. 2. Kupima n'okugyeragyeranisa obushushu bw'ebintu bibiri. 3. Kumanya omukura gw'obushushu kuruga aha kintu kimwe okugyenda aha kindi. 4. Kubara obwingi bw'amaani g'obushushu ekintu kirimu. Omu biteekateeko ebikurikira, nikikuru ki ekirikworeka omutendera ogurikugyenda gye, kuruga aha biteekateeko ebya buli izooba okugyenda aha biteekateeko ebirikukiraho kuguma?

Omwegyesa omwegyesi n'abanyeshuri "amaani n'enki?", kandi haihi yaabo boona bakiriiza ngu "n'ekikorwa ekirikwetagisa kureetera omubiri kuguma nigutambura". Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, niki ekirikukirayo kukwata aha kuteera oburemeezi aha biteekateeko ebi ebikyeziraine omu banyeshuri?
answer_a: Omufoto gw'omukazi omuto arikukurura emeeza
answer_b: Ekifaananyi ky'omuzani w'omupiira ogw'ebigere ariyo naatera omupiira.
answer_c: Ekifaananyi ky'omwana orikwetwara akakapu aha mugongo gwe
answer_d: Ekifaananyi ky'omwambi oguri omuhanda bwaba gumazire kuraswa.

question: Omugyezibwa aine ekigyendererwa ky'okukuzamu abeeshuri be obushoboorozi bw'okutorana ebiri aha mukura gw'entaneeto ahabw'okukora purojekiti z'okushushuurza. Omu kiraasi, abashaba kukoresa mashini ehururuza aha mukura gw'entaneeto kushanga ebikwaata aha bushoboorozi bw'okuragura eby'okutengyeka. Ni bintu ki aha bintu ebi omwegyesa arikutebeekanisa ebirikubaasa kushobooza abeeshuri kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Reeba omukura gw'emikura eshatu eya webu, oihireho ogu orikukunda munonga, orikworeka gye ebi orikushingamira aha kucwamu kwaawe.
answer_b: Ohandiika omuhanda gw'ekicweka kurugiirira aha bi orikureeba ebirikukushemeza munonga aha mukura gwa internet.
answer_c: Baigarukye omubaanzi ogurikugyeragyeranisa ebiri omu mitwaro eshatu ey'ebiteekateeko eby'okubanza ebi barahindwireho.
answer_d: Teeraniza kuruga aha muko gw'omukura ogurikwesigwa munonga kuhika aha muko ogurikwesigwa kukye omu mikura eshatu ey'obaire omu kutandika, orikuhereza enshonga ezirikukoresibwa.

question: Omuhendo gw'okwegyesa ki ogurikubaasa kuhikiirirwa kurabira omu murimo ogutebeekanisiibwe? "Muri kontekisi y'ekicweka "Atomu n'omutima gwayo," omwegyesa naatebeekanisa omurimo ogurikukurira abegyenda b'omu mwaka ogw'ana omuishomero: "Muteenganise ebirikurugamu omu kwega omutima gwa atomu n'omuringo ogurikubaasa kukoresibwa omu by'obuhangwa, murikureeba ngu, kuruga omu ebyo ebirikubaho omu mutima gw'atomu y'ebintu ebimwe, nikibaasika kutunga amaani g'omushana n'okukuraaza tekinologia erikugasira abantu. Okukira munonga, muganire aha muringo gw'okwombeka ebitebe by'amaani g'enyukiriya omu ihanga ryaitu kwenda kureeta amaani g'omushana."
answer_a: Shobora omukuru gw'akatomu n'omutima gwakyo (nucleus), nookimanye ebihairane ebiri ahagati y'ebintu ebirikushushana (elements) n'ebitari kushushana (isotopes), hamwe n'amaani ag'omusingi agarikukora.
answer_b: Yegyesa abeshomesha okwetegyereza obuhangwa bw'obwomeezi bw'esayansi oburikukwata aha mutima gw'akatoomu n'omurimo gw'abanyasayansi b'enyukiriya.
answer_c: Higa abeshomesa okukunda okuhangana kw'okwega ebiri omunda y'akacwe n'omuringo bikorwa n'ebintu ebirikubaho obutoosha omu magara.
answer_d: Kukuzaho abeeshuri obushoboorozi bw’okushoboorora oku amaani agarikugwa omu mutima gw’akatomu garikugyibwa n’oku amaani aga garikubaasa kuhindurwa gaitu amaani g’omushana.

question: Shoma obugabe bw'okwegyesa obu: "Shoborora eby'obutahangaanwa bw'omushana kuraba omu kugezesa hamu n'okukoresa eby'okureeberaho, orikureeba eby'okureeberaho by'obutini n'omucweko by'omushana." Ni birikukurikira aha, ni kiki ekirikwija kushuuruura obugabe obwo butunu?
answer_a: Shoborora okuhinduka kw'omushana kurikukoresa omuringo gw'omuyaga gw'omushana.
answer_b: Shobora eby'omushana ebiri omukutwara omuhendo gw'obutini bw'omushana
answer_c: Shoborora obukuru bw'omugasho gw'omuringo gwa Doppler orikurugiirira aha mutindo gw'omurabyo orikworeka omigasho gwaagwo.
answer_d: Shobora omumbeera eya buli izooba ahu orikubaasa kureeba ebintu by'omushana ebirikukwata aha mutindo gw'obutini bw'ekintu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi naagambira abegyi be omurimo ogurikukurataho: "Mubake ekishushani ekirikworeka omuringo gw'ensi n'okwezi omu bunyakare n'okugyezaho okwirukya ekyererezi ky'eishengyero kurabira omu mushana gw'ekyemuli omu mwanya gw'omushana gw'eizooba." Omu bwire bw'omurimo ogwo ogwogambwaho, niki aha mirimo erikukorwa abegyi egi erikubagambira kusheshera okwetegyereza kwabo omuringo ogurikureeta ekyererezi ky'eizooba?
answer_a: Nibirikwooreka ngu Ensi, Omwezi, n'Eizooba biri omu murongo, nibikora ekisiizi ahari Ensi
answer_b: Nibagira ngu okwiruka kw'eizooba nikubaho omwezi gwaba niguteera ekisiizi kyagwo ahaiguru y'ensi.
answer_c: Nibarikira omulingo omwezi gutambura nigwetoloola Ensi omu bwengye bwona obw'omwezi.
answer_d: Nibakora omulingo ogurikworeka obureiyo bw’ahagati y’Ensi n’Omwezi hamwe n’obunene bwabyo byombi omu mulingo gumwe.

question: Omugyezibwa naayenda kushwijuma obushoboorozi bw'abegi be okutebeekanisa ekizibu ky'okushwijuma ebya saayansi kurugiirira aha bintu ebi ebirikureetera ekintu kurembera. Ni ekihe ky'emirimo eki abegi barikukora ekirikwija kureetera omugyezibwa kushwijuma obushoboorozi obu?
answer_a: Nibakora ebitebeekaniso kwetegyereza ebintu ebiriho ebirikukwata aha kutaangaanira kw'ebintu, nibatebeekanisa ebikoresho ebirikukwata (amazi g'emiringo etari emwe, ebintu eby'emiringo etari emwe, oburemu, n'emiterere)
answer_b: Nibakora omu kutebeekanisa ebiri omu bwire ebikundirwe kuruga omu kupima obungi bw'ebintu n'okureeba okuzaaza kw'emibiri etari emwe omu mazi g'emishushani etari emwe, nibashwijuma kandi nibahikaana aha kintu okuzaaza kw'emibiri kurugaaho.
answer_c: Nibakoresa obuhame kuruga omu kureeba oku ebintu bireremba omu mazi g'emishorongo etari emwe n'emwe n'okupima oburemerezi, nibakoresa okuteekateeka n'okuzooka empaka ahabw'okushoboorora kwabo oku barikuteekateeka.
answer_d: Nibakora omulingo gw'okuhiganira aha kintu ekirikubaasa kuteebwa ekirikukwatanisa okuyangata kw'ebintu n'ebintu ebirikubahindura, nk'omutindo, obuzito, n'obwinganizo, nibateeka omusingi gw'omukago ogurikwetengyesa hali eby'amagezi bya sayansi ebi okubabuzamu omu mulingo gw'okukora ebiteebo byabo.

question: Omwegyesereza naaba atandika omutwe gw'okwegaita kw'ebirikale bya kemisiri kandi nayenda kworeka abegi ngu okumanya omu kemisiri nikukura, nikuhinduka kandi kurimu empaka. Kuti kuhikiiriza eki, ekirikukurikira aha, niki eki kyaaba nikikwatana?
answer_a: Empaka aha miringo y'akatomu
answer_b: Poroota y'okucwekyereza aha mugenzo gwa VSEPR (Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion)
answer_c: Empaka aha kworeka amateeka g'empewo
answer_d: Nshaba y'okushwijuma ebyahandiikirwe aha byafaayo by'ekiteekateeko ky'omukago

question: Omwegyesa owa Grade II Secondary naayoreka abegi be eky'omulingo gw'okweyongora kw'amazzi kw'emyunyu ebiri eza sodium: NaCl(s)+H2O(l)→Na+(aq)+Cl−(aq) NaHCO3(s)+H2O(aq)→Na+(aq)+HCO3−(aq). Obu ababuuza aha mulingo gw'okushunguka kw'emyunyu zoona, abegi bashubiza ngu emyunyu zoona zineeshunguka omu maizi omu mulingo gumwe. Bwanyima y'okukora okucwekyereza, bakitaho ngu tizineeshunguka omu mulingo gumwe. Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, ekirikukurataho nikyo kirikworeka enshobya y'abegi aha mulingo gw'okushunguka kw'emyunyu ezi?
answer_a: Nikirikurugyira aha muhendo gw'ebipooli ebirikwegaruramu kuruga omu munyu gwoona.
answer_b: Nikirikurugyira aha bunene bw'ebipooli ebi bikutaanisa kuruga omunyu gwona ogwo
answer_c: Nikirikurugyira aha kutaabururwa kw'ebipooli omu kinyabutaabuzi.
answer_d: Nikirikuruga aha mikoranire erikukwata aha bintu ebiri omu mutego n'ekirikubisa omu mutego.

question: Eki aha ebiri omu biteekateeko ebi abeeshuri bakira bagira ebikwata aha kwetandika kw'ebintu omu by'okushisha obusingye (thermodynamic processes)?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibarikiriza ngu okweyongera kw'amaani g'akataranta nikusiima okwefeerereza.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibagira ngu ebikorwa ebitarikutebeekanisibwa nibibaasa kuba eby'okureetera okushushana.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibarikiriza ngu ebikorwa ebirikwekwataho bitwara obwire bukye kukora
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibateekateeka ngu ebikorwa ebitarikutebeekanisibwa nibyesigama aha bwoki n'okutangatanga kw'amaani.

question:
Omugyezibwa arikugyezaho abegi be kumanya amateeka ga Hund ag'okweyongyera kw'amaani.
Ni ki aha bigyezibwa ebi orikuteekateeka ngu nikyo kirukukirayo kurungi kwemeza yaaba abegi bashangaine ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Kuhandiika endagiriro y'ebirooni y'ensi yoona ey'atomu ez'omutaano omu mwanya ogwaabo ogw'ahansi
answer_b: Kuhandiika emiringo mirahuko y'ebirikoresho bya elekituroniki by'atomu ezitari zimwe na zimwe omu mbeera yazo ey'ahansi
answer_c: Kugyerageranisa omugabano gw'obusirikale bw'amasannyalaze omu bishushani by'ebirikoni by'ekika ky'amasannyalaze eky'ahaiguru ky'obuto bw'ebintu obutari bumwe
answer_d: Kugyerageranisa emiterere y'ebintu bya elekituroniki eby'aha rubaju omu atomu ezitari zimwe omu mbeera zombi ez'ahansi n'ezirikwimukya.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’okubanza omuishomero erikuru akora omurimo ogu ahabeegi be: Tora ebikopo bitaano omu biteekemu 50 mL y’amaizi agatokoroirwe, otekemu ebi: 5 g y’omunyo (NaCl), 5 g y’eshuka, 5 g ya bicarbonate, 5 mL y’amajuta, 5 mL ya alcohol. Obwo, omwegyesa abagambira kushoboorora ahabw’enki ebintu ebimwe ebi bateekiremu biratokoroka byoona, ebindi bitatokoroka gye, kandi ebindi bitatokoroka. Aha butoosha bw’ebirikukurataho, niki ekirikukwatana n’omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Geranisiza oburinganiza bw'emibazi erimu omugabo n'etaine mugabo omu mitobe ey'omutaano
answer_b: Shobora y'emitwarize y'ebintu ebirikushushana by'omutaano obu birikushaanuuka omu kinuunuuzi ekitarimu mutego
answer_c: Eri omukago oguri ahagati y'obuziba n'oburinganiza bw'ebintu ebirikushushuka omu maizi
answer_d: Taahura emiringo y'omukago ogurikwata hamwe ebintu kurugiirira aha bushobozi bwabyo bw'okushaanuuka omu maizi

question: Omuhendi omuhingiirizi omu kicweka ky'ebisibo bya kemikali, omwegyesa nayenda abegyi kumanya amataara g'emigyenzo gy'okubangana hagati y'ebintu bya kemikali hamu n'okukuraaza obwomeezi bw'obuhangwa. Ni nshonga ki aha zirikukurira egi, egiroho omwegyesa kumanya obucureezi bw'ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kutooranya molekyu ez'enjawulo kurugirira aha mikoranire yazo y'omunda.
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesha kwombeka ekitaabo ky'ebiteekateeko kurugiirira omu kurora eicweka ky'okwegyesa ekirikukwata aha mikoranire y'ahamuringo hagati y'ebintu kuruga omu kitabo ekirikwegyesa.
answer_c: Shaba abeshomi bashwijume obuhangwa bw'omukago oguli omunda y'ebintu ebyobutonde.
answer_d: Shaba abeshomesa kubanza kutebeekanisa omuringo gw'okukora okucwekyereza kw'okushobora kumanya obuhangwa bw'emigyenzo etari emwe n'emwe ehuriire aha migyenzo y'omubiri.

question: Omwe aha migyenderero y’okwegyesa y’ekicweka ky’ebintu ebiriho omu Puroguraamu y’Eishomero ey’Omwaka ogwa kabiri neegira ngu abeeshuri bategeere ngu enyamaishwa zimwe zineenyegyesa ezifaanaine, ezi zirikumanyisa ngu nibashobora kuteekwa omu kibinja kimwe. Aha mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikuhiga abeeshuri kukora omurimo gw’okutegyeka enyamaishwa omu bibinja?
answer_a: Shoborora emiringo erikwegyerera aha maisho y'ebishusha by'enyamaishwa ez'omutaano ezirikworekwa omu bishushani ebitari bimwe
answer_b: Taaha emigaragaruro y'ebishushani by'enyamaishwa omu mitwaro kurugiirira aha bwoko bw'eky'okubisiika kyazo.
answer_c: Shushani enyama kurugiizi ezi orikugambwa.
answer_d: Huza emigisha etari emwe n'obuhangwa obu eturimu.

question: Omwegyesereza omuhwezi w’ekicweka kya 3 agizire nagwo nagwo n’abegi be aha mugingo "Kureeba n’okushoborora, kuraba omu kunoonyereza kw’okugezesa, ebi ebimera birikwetenga." Kucwera omugingo ogu, nashaba okunoonyereza kw’okugezesa okurikukurataho: Omu bbeki ishatu ezirikureebeka n’obuhobo bw’okutururiraho oburikwetenga omucwe gw’omutaka gw’omu nshamba guringaine, nibabiba embuto eziringaine omu bbeki yoona. Hanyuma, nibateeka ebeki aha dirisa ry’ekicweka kyabo kandi nibazifukirira n’ekiringiti kya 10 mL y’amaizi n’omuringo ogurikukurataho: Ekimera 1: omurundi gumwe omu izooba. Ekimera 2: omurundi gumwe omu saabiiti. Ekimera 3: emirundi ebiri omu saabiiti. Obuhikiro, nabashaba kwandika ebi bareebire n’enteerana ezi baagizire. Ni birikukurataho ebirikwoleka ngu abegi bakabaasa kutunga enteerana ezirikukwata aha kunoonyereza okwakozirwe okurikukurata aha kintu ekirikuhinduka?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omushana n'ebimera by'omu maizi ebi rikuru kukura.
answer_b: Nibarikira ebiriisa ebi amaizi garimu ebirikukwasa ebimera kukura
answer_c: Nibyo birikukiriza obwingana bw'amaizi ekimera kirikwetaga kukura kwakyo
answer_d: Nibashobora kushoborora omurimo gw'emirizi omu kwonka amaizi eki kimera kirikwetaga.

question: Omu kw’ishomero ry’abaana abato, omwegyesa naagambira abahungu n’abashiki kutunga okukora okucwekyereza, okurikwetenga kuta omucwe gw’amaishe omu izooba. Naabagambira ngu, omu kasiriri, buri omwe ashemereire kushiiga ekishushani ky’eki arikuteekateeka ngu nikizaakuhika aha mucwe gw’amaishe. Bwanyima nibaruga omu rubuga naabaheereza buri omwe omucwe gw’amaishe kw’eta omu izooba. Ku baruga omu kika, nabaashaba kushiiga haihi n’ekishushani ekya bwambere eki bareebireho buzima ekihikire aha mucwe gw’amaishe. Okuhikiiriza, nabaashaba kushoboorora oku ebishushani ebi birikushushana n’oku birikutaana, n’oba eki baaba bateekateeka ngu nikizaakuhika buzima kyahikire. Obureezi obu butaano nibwo burikworekwa omu kuhikiiriza kw’obureeberezi obu?
answer_a: Okureeta ebintu ebiirikukwatwa.
answer_b: Okuteebereza
answer_c: Okugyeragyeranisa
answer_d: Kucwekyereza

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekyanga 6 akaba atunga akabonero "Kwetegyereza ngu obushushu buruga omu kintu ekiine obushushu bwingi bukaza omu kindi ekiine obushushu bukye" n'ekikaguzo eki: Ahabwaki abantu bakoresa engoye nzigazi kwetangira obutakonyeera? Ku yaashomereize eby'abegi baamugarukire, omwegyesa akasanga ngu baingi baagarukire bati: "Ahabw'okuba engoye zigyezaho obukonyezi kutahika omu mubiri." Ni bintu ki ebiraahwere abegi kwetegyereza oku obushushu buruga omu bintu bimwe bukaza omu bindi?
answer_a: Kora omugure gw'okukora eki abeeshuri, omunda y'ekiro, bakwate n'engaro zaabo omutwe gw'omuti, omutwe gw'ekyoma, n'omutwe gwa pulasitiki, kandi bahandiike orikuhoora nari orukutsa. Bwanyima, bapime kandi bahandiike obushuushu bw'ebintu ebi kwongyera kuhameza okuhingurira kw'obushuushu.
answer_b: Kora omukoro gw'okugezesa omuhanda gw'obushuushu ogurikuruga omu kikopo ky'amaizi ekirimu obushuushu bwingi kuruga omu kindi ekirimu obushuushu bukye, orikworeka ekirikubaho aha muhanda ogwo obu ekikopo kimwe kiba kibisiirwe n'ekitungu ky'entaama eky'obutonde.
answer_c: Kora omuguto gw'okugyezaho orikworeka ebikopo bishatu ebirimu amaizi aha bwihumbi 10°C: ekikopo kimwe okite omu izooba, ekindi okite haihi n'ekyotero, n'ekindi okite haihi n'ekikopo ky'amaizi aha bwihumbi 70°C. Bwanyima, mutegeereze obwire obu birikutwarira kuhika aha bwihumbi 15°C kumanyisa oku obushushu burikwenda.
answer_d: Kora omugure gw'okugezesa ahu orikworeka akakwaso k'ekyoma n'akakwaso ka aluminiyumu omuriro gw'ekyokerwa, reero, okoresa etemamita, okarekooda obushuushu bw'eka kakwaso kwena okuhameza oku orushuushu rurikwenda.

question: Omuhwezi orikwegyesa omu kiraasi ky'omwaka gwa munaana (8) aha bikorwa by'okutwara ebintu omu butaffaali, obu araabe nagamba aha kibaaho aha butaffaali bw'omusaayi obutukura obu buraabe buteirwe omu mazi maingi, omwegi abuuze: "Kiki ekirikubaho aha bimera obu bitarikubiirwa amaizi kandi bikakunkumuka?". Ebirikukurataho nibimwe aha by'okushoboorora ebi omwegyesa araabe ahabire abegi, kubaasa kukuumira obuhangwa n'okukoresa orurimi orurikwetagisa aha mutendera gw'eshomero ogurikugambwaho?
answer_a: Ebirimwa byabura amazi, obutaffa bw'ebirimwa nibutandika kurekyera amazi omu mwanya oguri ahagati y'obutaffa, ekirikendeeza obwingana bw'amazzi agari omunda y'obutaffa, ekintu eki nikimanywa nka plasmolysis, ekireetera amataagi kureebeka nk'agahweire.
answer_b: Ebirimwa byabura kwesherwa, omunda y’akashabo neeba netaine mazzi garingaine omuhanda n’obweru bw’akashabo, ekireetera emyunyu kuza omunda y’akashabo kuruga omuhanda, nukwo omwingo gw’obwinganiza bw’omunda y’akashabo gukendeere, ekireetera amataagi kureebeka nk’agahungire.
answer_c: Ebirimwa byabura amazi, obutonde bw’omunda y’akabimbe nibuba bwingi kusinga obw’aha rubaju, n’ahabw’ekyo amazi nigaruga omuhanda gwa hanze gataaha omunda, ekirikureetera akacweka k’omunda kukura, n’orugata rw’enyima kuruga aha kisenge ky’akabimbe, ekirikureetera ebikondo kureebeka nk’ebihwereire.
answer_d: Ebirimwa byabura amazzi, obutofaali oburikukikuruukya nibuba butaine amazzi gaaheire, ekireetera amazzi kuza kuruga omu butofaali bw'omunda kuza omu obutofaali oburikukikuruukya, kigyerese obwinganisa bw'omunda y'obutofaali kandi kireetere ekicweka ekikuru omu butofaali kukwata, ekireetera oruhu rw'obutofaali kwetantara orukuta rw'obutofaali, ekireetera amataagi kureebeka nk'agahweire.

question: Omuhendo gw'okwetangira endwara ogurikurugamu ahabw'emigunju. Ni nshonga ki abeeshuri abashemereire kwetegyereza kubanza kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kirikuteekwa?
answer_a: Ekiijukiro ky'omubiri ekirwanisa endwaara
answer_b: Ebimanyiso by'obwirwanirizi bw'omubiri obw'omuzaano
answer_c: Ebimanyiso bya T lymphocytes
answer_d: Enkola y’okukora ya makirofaagi

question: Omu omwaka gwa munaana, omu omutwe ogurikukwata aha mitebe y’ebintu, omwegyesa naayegyesa ebikwata aha mitebe y’akatomu. Kureeba yaaba abegyeswa bategeire omutaano gw’omubaro gw’akatomu n’omubaro gw’oburemezi, nabaabuuza kworeka omuhendo gw’obutini bw’amasannyalaze, obutini bw’obuzito, n’obutini obutaine masannyalaze omu aluminiyumu etarikwetenga masannyalaze, twaba nitureeba ngu omubaro gw’oburemezi bwayo ni 27 kandi omubaro gw’akatomu ni 13. Abegyeswa abamwe nibooreka ebi: Aluminiyumu eine obutini bw’amasannyalaze 27, obutini bw’obuzito 13, n’obutini obutaine masannyalaze 14. Oburemeezi ki abu abegyeswa barikworeka omu muringo gwabo gw’okwega ebikwata aha by’omunda?
answer_a: Okwikiriza ngu omuhendo gw'obusirikale bw'amasannyalaze niguhikaanisa omuhendo gw'obusirikale bw'amaizi na butoni
answer_b: Kutamanya ngu namba y'akatomu neehwera n'omubaro gw'ebintu birungi
answer_c: Okwikiriza ngu omuhendo gw'obunene bugyerere nibuhikaana n'omugatte gw'emigugu mirungi n'emibi
answer_d: Kukimanya ngu omuhendo gw'oburemeezi niguhikaana n'omugato gw'obutini oburi omunda y'akariho.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekyanga 7 yataireho ekigyendererwa eki ahabw'ekyanga rye: "Shoboorora emitwarize y'emyuka omu kubiangana n'ebiragiro bya Boyle." Biki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba bamaze kwega kubaasa kwetegyereza ebi biri omu mutwe ogu?
answer_a: Emitwaro y'ebintu
answer_b: Amaani g'amaanyi g'ekiriketi gya ggaasi
answer_c: Omumaro gw'ebintu ogurikugira ngu byombekirwe omu bucweka buto buto
