answer_d: Omumaro orwa kinetic-molecular theory y'emigasha

question: Aha kumuhweerera kw'omutwe gw'Eiragiro rya Boyle omu kiraasi ey'omwaka gwa 7, omwegyesa aine kwetegyereza akabonero k'okwega aka: "Kumanya omukago ogwashimwa hagati y'ebintu ebiri omu Iragiro rya Boyle". Murimo ki ogurikwija kwiha omwegyesa obuhame bw'okwetegyereza akabonero k'okwega aka?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa bashoboorore omuringo ekiko ky'omuteeko kirikukora.
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri bashoboorore omuringo eibaalooni erimu omuyaga gw'obushuushu erikukora.
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesa kubara obwingana bw’omuyaga ogw’aha muheru oguri omu kintu ekigizire omu busingye obutari bumwe.
answer_d: Shaba abeeshuri bashoboorore enshonga ahabw'enkyukakyuka y'obwingana egiro kw'ebbombo bw'amazzi erikukura kuruga ahansi y'eidhiiba.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’akashatu owa siniya ashoborra abegyeswa emigarukiro y’omubimbe by’obwonko omu kuheereza obutumwa bw’obwonko. Obu arakuuteera ngu obutumwa bw’obwonko buheerezebwa bwangu omu miyendo y’obwonko erimu obureingwa burikukira, omwegyeswa omwe nagira ngu tarikumanya eky’arukushoborra. Omwegyesa acwa orubanja rw’okukoresa okushoborra okundi. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho eziraakundire omwegyesa kworeka omu muringo ogurikuhikire ngu emyendo y’obwonko erimu obureingwa burikukira neheereza obutumwa bw’obwonko bwangu?
answer_a: Shuuruza omumeza ogurikworeka omushoberera gw'omwirukiro omu mihiro y'obwongo y'enyama ez'omucwezi ez'emirameteri etari emwe, nukwo bashobore kugaruraanisa enshobano omu mushoberera gw'omwirukiro.
answer_b: Yoreka eky'okureetera omuntu kureeba omuringo ogw'amaizi garikutwara obwire bukye kugyenda omu mwanya ogurikumara omu rubingo oruhango kurusha omu rubingo oruto, obu orikuta omu miringo yombi amaizi agyinganire kandi emiringo yombi ekaba ey'oburaingwa obulingaine.
answer_c: [Ndi kukwata ekishushani ky'obwatsi bw'omubiri (axons) oburimu obunene obutari bumwe, obumu burimu omubavu (myelin) obundi tiburimu, nibwoleka ebicweka ebi ebintu birikuhindukira (depolarization) hamwe n'emikutu y'ebyoma (ion channels) erikukozesebwa n'omuringo omuriro gurikugaburwa (charge distribution) omubanza, omu, na hanyuma y'okuhika kw'amaani (action potential)]
answer_d: Sherekereza nk'omugo gw'amasannyalaze, oruganda rw'omuti rurikukuumira emigwa y'amasannyalaze nikora nk'emyeriini aha migwa y'obwonko, ekongyera omwendeso gw'okutwara obutumwa.

question: Omugyezibwa asomesa aine kukora n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho n'abanyeshuri abali omu mwaka gwabo ogw'abiri omu mashomero agari haihi: "Kukuraaza omushoborora gw'obwomeezi, kurugiirira aha buhame, aha bikorwa by'okuhungura emiringo omu nyamaishwa". Ebikorwa ebiri ahansi aha nibiija kubasiisa kukora aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Kurugiira aha mishangwa y'emyaka y'ab'eka abaine endwaire ezirikushushana, abeegi nibagyeragyeranisa kandi niboonyereza ekirikureeta buli ndwaire.
answer_b: Kurigyira aha mishangwa y'ebisembe by'endwaara ezirikukwata omubiri gwona, abeeshuri bashwijuma ebi bishangwa kandi bamanye omulingo endwaara ezo zirikukwata.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibahinga omu mmeeza ebiranga by'ebishoro ebirikukurwa omumuryango gw'ebinyama kandi bagyerengyereza omu muringo buri kimwe kirikworekyerwa.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibahanga oruganda rw'omuryango (pedigree) rurimu emigwi y'eshagama y'abanyeshuri bagyenzi baabo n'emyaka yaabo kandi nibaha obushobororo bw'oku emigwi y'eshagama etungwa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekibiina kya 12 abegi kubahaana omukago hagati y'obuhangwa obuhumire n'enkuba y'akasidi. Ni murimo ki ogu abegi bashemereire kukora kugira ngu kihikane n'okukora okucungura kw'obwengye?
answer_a: Kora omukura gw'ebitabo ogurikukwata aha mukago oguri ahagati y'enkuba erimu asidi n'obushisha bw'obutonde bw'ensi.
answer_b:
Eizo orikukuru erikugamba aha mukago oguri ahagati y'enkuba y'omushuro n'obushangwaazi bw'obutonde bw'ensi, kandi ogarukemu kuraba omu kucwekyereza.

Eky'okucwekyereza: Twakora tuta kworeka omuringo enkuba y'omushuro erikukwata aha butonde bw'ensi?

Eby'okukoresa:
1. Ebintu by'okugera omushuro (nka pH meter nari litmus paper)
2. Amaizi g'enkuba
3. Amaizi g'omushuro (gera kugira omushuro nk'ogw'enkuba y'omushuro)
4. Ebirimwa nari enyatsi
5. Ebyanzi nari ebintu by'okuteramu
6. Eby'okugera

Engamba:
1. Gera omushuro gw'amaizi g'enkuba n'amaizi g'omushuro.
2. Tera ebirimwa nari enyatsi omu byanzi bibiri.
3. Tera ekintu kimwe n'amaizi g'enkuba, ekindi otere n'amaizi g'omushuro.
4. Gera oburebure bw'ebirimwa buri izooba nari obwire oburikugyerwa.
5. Yetegyereze emigarukiro aha birimwa byombi.

Eky'okugarukamu: Amaizi g'omushuro nigakwata gye aha kukura kw'ebirimwa?
answer_c: Kora omurimo gw'okushomesa ogurikworeka omukago oguri ahagati y'obuhangwa obuhindire n'enkuba erimu asidi.
answer_d: Yoreka omuhendo omuringo omushana gw'amazzi g'omushuro gurikukora aha bimera.

question: Omugurusi akagambira abeshuri kukora omulingo gw'okucweekamu ogurikukurira, n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwoleka emiringo y'okutwara ebintu ebirikushonga n'ebirikushonza omu rubaju omu rubaju orurikusiima: 1. Yongyera ekishonga ky'eshukari ekirikukwata ahagati omu kacuupa akarikusiima. 2. Teeka akacuupa omu kibya ekirimu ekishonga ky'eshukari ekitali kingi nk'eky'omu kacuupa. 3. Reeba ekirikubaho bwanyima y'obumwezi bukye. Kiki ekirikukomya omulingo ogwacwekirwe omugurusi kukora n'ekigyendererwa ekigambirweho?
answer_a: Ekikoreso tikirikukiriza kworeka omuringo eky'omunyu kirikwekwata.
answer_b: Ekikoreso nikikiriza obuhinduzi bw'amaizi bwonka.
answer_c: Ekikoreso tikirikworeka oku amaizi garikwimukamu kurugiirira aha bungi bw'ebintu ebiri omu mazi.
answer_d: Ekikozesebwa tikikiriza kwolekya okuhendeka kw'obutini bw'ebintu kuruga aha muhendo muto okwija aha muhendo munini

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekibiina ky’omwaka ogw’okubanza omuishomero erikuru, omu bwire bw’ekiganiro aha nshonga z’obutonde bw’ensi, ashemereire kushwijuma ekigyendererwa eki: “Kwetegyereza ebirugirira omu kurekurwa kw’ebintu by’emishonga aha kwangirika kw’omutanda gwa ozone.” Ni murimo ki ogurikubaasa kwikiriza omwegyesa ou kukora obuhame oburikukwata aha kutuura aha kigyendererwa eki kyakiragirwe?
answer_a: Shaba abeeshuri kweshushaanisa ebiri omu meza erikworeka obwingi bwa CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons) omu mwanya gw'ahaiguru n'obwingi bw'emiramu ya ozone eriyo.
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri bashoboorore ebiri omu ekifaananyi ekirikworeka oku ihinduka ry'omubazo gw'obungi bw'ebirikureeta ozone omu mwanya gw'ahaiguru (stratosphere) omu myaka makumi ataano ehingwire.
answer_c: Orikiriza abeeshuri kukora ekishushani ekirikushoborora ebirikukurataana n'okuceebya kw'omutanda gwa ozone omu mwanya gw'ahaiguru (stratosphere)
answer_d: Shaba abeshomesa bagye kukora ekishushani ekirikworeka ebintu eby'omu maka ebirikuta CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons) omu mwanya gw'omuzoni.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ebikorwa by'okwegyesa n'okwega ebihendahenda n'abegyi abali omu mwaka gwa kabiri omu mashomero ga sekenda, ebikwata aha kitabo ky'ensi n'obwengye bwona. Omu bikorwa ebiri ahansi aha, abegyi nibashobora kureba bata okubaho kw'obwengye n'eby'obuhangwa omu magara ga buri izooba?
answer_a: Abeshomesha niboonyesha omuhendo n'emitwaro y'ebintu ebirikwetorora Ensi, kandi bagambe aha mugasho gwabyo omu kukora kw'enkora z'okushanga ekifo.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibakoresa akarenda kushanga eizooba amashura g'omwezi agarukaho, n'okuragura omwanya ogu izooba, ensi, n'omwezi birimu omu biro bitari bimwe omu kwezi.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibagamba aha bintu bikuru ebirikumanyisa Omwezi kandi bashoma omuhandiko ogurikukwata aha kureeba kw'okubanza kwa Galileo n'endorerwamu ye, ahu yaareebire ngu obuso bwagwo tiburi bweranda nk'oku buraabeire bureebeka omu kubanza.
answer_d: Abeshomesha bareeba vidiyo erikukwata aha bigyendererwa by’entebeekanisa ya Rosetta n’ekicweka kyayo ekya Philae, ekashoboirwe kutuura omurundi gwa mbere omu byafaayo aha mataama g’ekyanda. Bwanyima, bagamba aha bukuru bw’obutumwa obu bw’aha bwengye.

question: Omwegyesereza omugabe w’eisomero ry’ahaiguru ari kutebeekanisa eishomo eririkumanyisa “Kushwijuma n’okushoboorora ebiri omu bubaire oburikugwa aha bintu”. Ni murimo ki ogurikukwatana n’okukuratira enteekateeka y’okugyenda nibakuzaho obwengye bw’abashomesibwa, ogurikubaasa kwikiriza abegi kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Bara omuhimbo gw'ebintu ebirikukwatanisa omu mbeera za buri izooba
answer_b: Kora omukoro gw'okunoondera aha matariisho g'ebiteekateeko agarikutaana omu kugongana kw'amaani n'okutari kw'amaani
answer_c: Gamba okucumita aha miringo y'enyegyerere ezimwe, orikwegamira aha bipimo by'omuhanga gwazo omu kuteerana.
answer_d: Shobora ezigambwaho omu vidiyo ezirikworeka embeera za buri izooba, orikwoleka ebintu ebirikuzigumira.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ari kutandika omutwe ogurikukwata aha maani g'amasannyalaze n'ebintu ebirikujajurwa amasannyalaze omu kiraasi y'omwaka ogwa Senior. Omu bwiire bw'ekiro, omwegyesa akazooka ngu okuteebereza okurikukirira abanyeshuri kuruga omutima obu barikushoboorora oku emiringa y'amasannyalaze erikukora n'okugira ngu "obu omusyo gw'amasannyalaze gurikuhita omu by'omugasho ebirikushaanisa, nigugwaawo." Ebikorwa ebiri aha bwansi ebi orikuteekateeka ngu nibyabaasa kureetera abanyeshuri kuteekateeka butaaho okuteebereza oku?
answer_a: Rangiize omuheru orukurukurana rw'emyaka n'obuhendo bw'amatara gabiri agari omutaano agashemeirwe aha batiiri.
answer_b: Rangirira omuhendo bw'akaisho k'amatara abiri agyenzire hamwe omukaseries aha battery, bwanyima ogatandikaanise.
answer_c: Rangirira omuhendo gw'erumuri bw'amatara abiri agari g'omutaano agashemeirwe hamwe aha baturi. Bwanyima ogatandikaanise.
answer_d: Rangiize omuheru orikukurirana n'okugyeragyeranisa okwiragira kw'amatabaaza abiri agyenzire agashemezibwe hamwe omu mutungo ogurikushushana aha batiiri.

question: Omuhwezi omu, otebeekanisiza ekicweka ky’abanyeshuri abali omu mwaka gwa kabiri gw’amatendekero ga secondary, nayenda kushaka ebikoreso by’eby’oburezi ebirungi ebirikubaasa kukoresibwa omu kicweka n’abanyeshuri abarikubaasa kugaragurira hamwe obunene n’oburaayo bw’eizooba n’emibumbe yaaryo omu bunene bwabyo. Ni ebikoreso ki ebi orikubaasa kukoresa omu kicweka ebirikubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky’eisomo?
answer_a: Eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka omuringo gw'Eizooba n'emibumbe
answer_b: Eky'okureeberaho ky'omuringo gw'ekikoompyuta ekirikworeka obunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba endiijo omu muringo ogurikushushana.
answer_c: Emeeza n'ebirikugambwaho aha bukuru n'oburaayo bw'enjuba omu mishanuro
answer_d: Ekishushani ky'omulingo gw'enkuba y'eizooba erimu data aha bunene n'oburaayo bw'enjuba z'omunsi okuza aha izooba

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa orukurato orurikukurira abegyirwa b'ekicweka kya mbere omu mashomero agarikukuru, aine ekigyendererwa "Kwetegyereza obukuru bw'okukora okushukuruza omu by'omusisa omu kuzooka okumanya kw'ebitare". Omu mirimo egi erikukurira ahansi, n'enki erikukwatana n'ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shoborora omuringo ogurikukoresibwa omu kucwekyereza emikuba ya seisei omu kwega ebiri omunda y'ensi.
answer_b: Manya g'amaani agarekurwa omu musisa nigatambura guta kuraba omu mirumbo ya primary, secondary, na surface.
answer_c: Gambamu ebintu ebirikureeta omutingito eby'obutonde, nk'okushobana kw'ebipande bya tekitoniki ahabw'okugyeenda kwabyo
answer_d: Shuuruura omuhanda gw'omushana gw'omutingo gw'omutima gw'ensi orikurabira omu kubaririra omuhanda kurabira omu bifo bishatu eby'okupimisa eby'omutingo gw'ensi, orikurugiirira aha bipimo by'omutingo ebyatungwa buri kifo.

question: Kugira ngu omwegyesa w’omu mwaka ogw’okushatu owa siniya akore aha biteekateeko by’akanyigirizi k’amaizi, atebeekaniise eishomo arikugyenderera ngu abegywa bakorese ebiteekateeko by’obuzito bw’ekintu omu kuringaanisa emibiri n’ebintu ebindi. Omu kutandika kw’eishomo, orukorwa ruraakuratwa kworeka ebiteekateeko by’obuzito bw’ekintu. Aha murimo ki ogu abegywa bashemereire kukora, bwanyima y’orukorwa orwo rwaaba rwamanywa, kugira ngu bagyendereere ekigyendererwa ky’eishomo?
answer_a: Rangi ebirikwija kubaho amaizi ashatu agataikaranisa bwaba gateirwe omu kintu ekipima obwinganiza bw'ebintu, kandi orondooze ahabw'enki ekirikureebwa kibaho.
answer_b: Shuuruura omuhanda gw'okushobora okuzoora obungi bw'ekintu ekiri omu mazi kuraba omu kuremera eki ekintu kirikuremera aha bwato bw'ekintu ekirikukibikiira.
answer_c: Shobora ki omugyengye gw'ebyangabwa bya Antarctica nigukwata guta aha buningiro bw'enyanja, kurugiirira aha buzito bw'omugyengye n'amaizi?
answer_d: Shobora omuhendo gw’omutindo n’omubaro aha bukuru bw’ebintu ebirikushushana omu bwingi bwebiro, kwonka birikutaana omu bunene, nari obunene bumwe kwonka birikutaana omu bwingi bwebiro.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omukuru ari kutebeekaniza isomo arikugira ekigyendererwa ky'okushoborora "ebirikukwata aha miringo y'okutambura kw'ekintu omu ruziga orikukwata." Ahabw'ekyo, naija kushoboorora ngu omunyaruro gw'omutwe (ω) gw'akantu kaagumaho nigwo gumwe, omunyaruro gw'aha rubaju (vt) nigweyongyera omugazi rwagwo (R) rugyenda rurikura, arikukoresa omuringo vt = R·ω. Twahamiisize ngu abanyeshuri abamwe nibabaasa kugira oburemeezi omu kwetegyereza okushoboorora oku, omwegyesa acwireho kwongyera omuringo ogundi ogurikushoboorora ebirimu by'isomo rye. Twahamiisize ebi biri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira enungi kukoresa okushoborora ekintu eki?
answer_a: Koresa omuringo ogu kukora omugisha ogurikwetengyesa, nk'okushobora omushobero gw'omupiira gw'egare.
answer_b: Yoreka omukono ogurikworeka omugano gw’omuringo gwa radius na speed y’aha rubaju omu gw’omuringo ogurikworeka omukago oguhikire ahagati y’ebintu ebi birikukora.
answer_c: Yoreka ngu obwahati orikukora omubiri ogusibwe aha mugozi niguhinduka obu obuhendo oburikukoresebwa omu kuzunguruka buhindurwa.
answer_d: Geranisheza omuringo ogu obwangu bw’ebicweka bitari bimwe omu glasi ey’omutindo gw’empunu erikumiirwe, yaagyenda neyeziringa neyetegyereize aha rubaju rumwe aha itaka eriringaaniza

question: Omugyezibwa naatekateeka eishomo ry'ekibiina ky'abaana abari omu mwaka gwa kashatu gw'ahaiguru, ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okumanyisa "Okwihura kw'ahaagati n'amaani g'ahaagati nk'ensonga ezirikureetera omubiri kugyenda omu ruyo rw'omuringo ogurikushushana". Okumanya ki aha bikwaata aha vekita abaana bashemereire kuba nibamanyireho kubaasa kwetegyereza amaani g'ahaagati gariyo nigagumira omubiri oguri kugyenda omu ruyo rw'omuringo ogurikushushana?
answer_a: Okugyibwamu kwa vekita
answer_b: Omugabo ogwa cross hagati y'emigwe
answer_c: Omuringo gw'okuta omutaano aha vekita
answer_d: Okutaanura vekita omu bice byayo ebya Karuteziani

question: Eki aha omumanyiso ki ahaabaana abeeshuli erikuremesa omumanya gw'ekigyendererwa kya Archimedes?
answer_a: Okuteekateeka ngu oburemeezi bw'omu bwengye tiburikwata aha buremeezi bw'amaizi oburikurugamu.
answer_b: Okuteekateeka ngu obwiire obu ekintu ekiri omu maizi kirimu nibwo burikukwata aha maani g'amaizi garikumukwataho.
answer_c: Okuteekateeka ngu oburemeezi oburikukora aha mubiri oguri omu maizi nibyesigamira aha bwomeezi obu gurimu
answer_d: Okuteekateeka ngu oburemeezi bwa haidurositatiki oburikukozesebwa ekintu ekirikwita aha bwato bw'ekintu ekirikukibumbabumba nikwesigamira aha mitero y'ekintu ekirikukibumbabumba.

question: Omuhwezi omu omwaka gwa 3 ogw'okushoma, omuhwezi naagira ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikugira ngu: "Shoboorora ebintu ebitari bimwe ebirikubaho buri izooba orikukoresa omusingi gwa Bernoulli." Aha bikurikukwata ahari eki, ni enki aha biteekateeko ebirikukurira aha kamanyiso akarikwija kureetera omuhwezi kumanya ngu abegi bahikiire aha kigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Nibashobora kushoborora emigararuro etari emwe n'emwe y'ekikwatagurizo kya Bernoulli
answer_b: Nibarikira omukukora akamashine akakozesibwa okushuukira ebihogo by'omubiri.
answer_c: Nibashobora kushoborora ahabw'enki obureingwa bw'omugongo gw'amaizi bugyezibwa obu buri kugwa kuruga omu taapu
answer_d: Nibashobora kushoborora ahabw'enki ecupa ya pulasitiki eremwa obu omuyaga oguri omunda gwayotsibwa?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mwaka ogw'akashatu omu somero erikuru ari kukora ekizibu ky'okuhandiika okucungura ekitongole ky'okutegyereza ebikwatiraine n'okutegyereza okurikwinga. Omwe gwa by'okucungura nigwo "Nibakoresa emigararo y'ekibaro erikushoborora omuringo gw'okutegyereza ogurikwinga ogutahinduka kushobora oburemeezi obutari bumwe," ekintu ki aha bigambo ebi ekirikukiraho kwemerera ebi barikukora?
answer_a: Teerera kumanya omwendego gw'omutindo gw'okuzunguruka gw'ekirima ky'abaana ekirikukora okuzunguruka okuhikire 5 omu daakiika emwe.
answer_b: Manya omuringo ogu omutabo gurikwekyenda n'omwinganiso gw'obureingwa bw'ekipinga \( \frac{5\pi}{2} \) radians
answer_c: Bala obwangu bw'akameme akarikwingana aha izooba obu oburaayo bwaakyo aha izooba buri \( R \), kandi obwangu bwaakyo oburikwingana bukaba buri 100 m/s obu oburaayo bukaba buri \( \frac{R}{2} \)
answer_d:
Orikurata orikugambisa kubara omushoberera gw'omugyegyerezi kuruga omu muhendo gw'omutendera, orikushoborora buri izooba rikwemerera:

v = rω

Ahabw'ekyo:
v = Omushoborera gw'omugyegyerezi
r = Omugyera
ω = Omuhendo gw'omutendera

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa sekenda, omu kubitebeekanisa bye by'eisomo, ateireho ekigyendererwa ky'abegyeswa okuhikaana eky'okuhinduka okurikukora omu bwiini bw'obutini obw'emishisa n'obumanzi bwabwo. Ni bintu ki ebiraheereza omwegyesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki omu kiraasi?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kworeka emitwarize y’ebintu ebirikurugwa omu kintu ekiriyo nikyeyenda omu mucwe gw’obutareeba.
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa bashoboorore omutaano gw'ebintu ebirikurugamu omu kashushani k'omukanda gw'obumanzi bw'enkyerere.
answer_c: Shaba abeeshuri bacuunde aha maani g'okureebana n'okukwatana agari omunda y'akacwe kamatomu, n'ekigyendererwa ky'okutunga obumanzi.
answer_d: Basomesa abeeshuri kwetegekereza akameeza akarikukwata aha miringo y'okubumbuka kw'ebintu ebiriyo ebintu ebiriyo obutwa ebi nyukiriya erikukora kugira ngu etereere.

question: Omugyezibwa naayegyesa abegyegyi b'omu mwaka ogw'obushatu aha mutwe gw'ekicweka ky'obutaguruka bw'ebintu (Chemical Equilibrium), aine ekigyendererwa "Kwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirikukorwa omu kwegaita kw'ebintu (chemical reaction)," kuraba omu kashushani akarikworeka obunji bw'ekintu n'obwire. Ku araabe naabuuza abegyegyi be aha bitegyerezo by'omutaano gw'obutaguruka (equilibrium constant), atunga ngu abarikukora nibashoma kashushani nk'oku kiri. Mubuzo ki omwegyesa orikubaasa kubuuza kubaasa kuhwera abegyegyi kwetegyereza okuhinduka omu bunji bw'ebintu omu kwegaita kw'ebintu (chemical reaction) kuraba omu kushoborora ekishushani?
answer_a: Ahabweire ki ekirikuruga omu by'okubanza n'ebirikurugamu aha guraafu?
answer_b: Obungi ki bw'amaanyi g'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebyo ebivaamu obukozesi bwabyo obutandika?
answer_c: Eizo kiro kiro eby'okubangaanisa birekeraaho kugwaawo kandi n'ebirikurugamu birekeraaho kukorwa?
answer_d: Harimu oburemeezi omu kubumbwa n'okukozesebwa kw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirikurugamu?

question: Omugyezibwa atekaine kutebeekanisa kukora aha kigyendererwa ky'okushushaniisa omu bwijwire enshonga y'okuhinduka kwa pH omu kuringaaniza erikugumirirwe omu kiraasi yaabo. N'ekyo arikurugiirira, omugyezibwa nashaba abeeshumi abakuru kuzooka ekikoomi ky'okuringaaniza ekya asidi enyambe n'omusingi ogw'amaani, ahabw'ekyo obwingi n'omutaano by'ebintu byombi nibiihwa. Obu omugisha nigugyenda omu maisho, omugyezibwa areeba ngu abeeshumi abarikukora ekikoomi kukihitsya aha kashusho k'okuringaaniza, ahabw'okuba nibatunga omuhendo gwa pH oguri ahansi y'efuuru bwanyima y'akashusho ako. Ni murimo ki ogurikukurataho oguraagira omugyezibwa kugarura abeeshumi kumariiriza okuzooka ekikoomi ky'okuringaaniza?
answer_a: Yenda abeshomesa omu maabaraato, bashobore kumanya omumaiso g'okulingaaniza omu muringo gw'okugezesa.
answer_b: Mugambe ngu, kurugiirira aha kipimo kya pH, kikyombekirwe kurugiirira aha muhendo murungi gw'obwingi bw'omushuro gw'akasidi nari ogwa base.
answer_c:
Mubagambire, hamu n'eky'okureeberaho, oku murikubaasa kushoboorora omuhendo gw'emooli ezirikushigara za buri kintu omu biikaro bitari bimwe omu kubungaania.

Eky'okureeberaho: Titrating 25.0 mL ya 0.10 M HCl hamu na 0.10 M NaOH

Okubungaania nikutandika:

Emooli za HCl omu kubungaania = (0.10 mol/L) * (0.025 L) = 0.0025 mol
Emooli za NaOH ezirikwongyerwamu = 0 mol
Emooli za HCl ezirikushigara = 0.0025 mol

Omu kubungaania bwaba buhingwireho 10.0 mL ya NaOH:

Emooli za NaOH ezirikwongyerwamu = (0.10 mol/L) * (0.010 L) = 0.0010 mol
Emooli za HCl ezirikushigara = 0.0025 mol - 0.0010 mol = 0.0015 mol

Omu kubungaania bwaba buhingwireho 25.0 mL ya NaOH (ekiro kya equivalence):

Emooli za NaOH ezirikwongyerwamu = (0.10 mol/L) * (0.025 L) = 0.0025 mol
Emooli za HCl ezirikushigara = 0.0025 mol - 0.0025 mol = 0 mol

Omu kubungaania bwaba buhingwireho 35.0 mL ya NaOH:

Emooli za NaOH ezirikwongyerwamu = (0.10 mol/L) * (0.035 L) = 0.0035 mol
Emooli za HCl ezirikushigara = 0 mol
Emooli za NaOH ezirikushigara = 0.0035 mol - 0.0025 mol = 0.0010 mol
answer_d: Koresa kompyuta omwegyesibwa arikuta omuhendo gw'ebipimo by'omusingi ogwongirweho, kandi enkora neemuha ebintu by'okubambahaho omurongo.

question: Omuhita omwegyesa owa sekenda ari kukora aha mugasho gw'okwegyesa "Kushoborora embeera y'okuringaniza erikuhikwaho enyikirizo z'eby'omwiisho" omu kiraasi erikukwatanisa n'omutwe gw'okuringaniza kw'eby'omwiisho. Omu bwire bw'omurimo, omwegyesa naayorekwa okubuzabuza kw'abegyeswa aha kibuzo eki barikumubuuza: "Ebirikutwarwa n'ebirikurugamu nibihika aha mbeera y'okuringaniza omu bwabo?" Aha mirimo egi erikukurira, niki ekirikubaasa kureetera omwegyesa kugarura omutima aha muringo gw'okwegyesa-okwega aha bw'abegyeswa?
answer_a: Reebera omulingo ekikorwa kirikugyenda omumaisho okuhitsya obu kicweka ky'ebintu ebirugiremu kimaze kukoleka
answer_b: Shuuruura eby'okureeba n'eby'omunda by'entebeekanisa y'ebirikwembiingwa okuhitsya obu etungire oburingaaniza
answer_c: Kora omukoro gw'okugezesa ogurikworeka ebi ebiriho ebirikuhindura embeera y'oburingaaniza omu nkora z'ebintu bya kemikali.
answer_d: Kukora omukoro gw'okugezesa ogurikwija kukuha obushoboorozi bw'okuragura omuhendo gw'ebintu ebirikwetaba omu mutengo, orikuruga aha muhendo gwabyo ogw'okutandika.

question: Omwegyesereza ki omwegyesa orikubaasa kubuuza abegi kureetera kuta omutima aha biteekateeko byabo kuruga omu kumanyisa oku?
answer_a: Obushushu nibukora buta aha ntebeekanisa y'omuringo?
answer_b: Okurugyererana orukuhuumire kurikukwatana kita n'entebeekanisa y'omuringo?
answer_c: Ahabw'enki obumanyire kugamba aha bintu ebirikukara n'ebirikuhoora, omu muringo ogu, aha kacaali ekirikuhyoora na kacaali ekirikukara?
answer_d: Omubumbo gw'omutindo gw'obushuushu bw'omuheru n'obushuushu bw'ebintu ebiri omu birago nikiki?

question: Abanyeshuri b’omu mwaka ogw’okushatu omu mashomero ga sekenda nibetebeekanisa lipooti y’ekicweka aha kucweera ekirikwetwa "Ebintu Ebirikukwata aha Muhendo gw’Ekyetengo." Ni by’endaaba ki ebi baraabe bamaze kwega kubaasa kushoboorora ebirugiremu ebi baatoonire?
answer_a: Eteeka ry'omuringo gw'omuhindo
answer_b: Omugashani gw'okugongana
answer_c: Okugamba aha mugenzo gw'okuhinduka ogutahinduka
answer_d: Ebintu ebirikwata aha muhendo gw'ekikorwa.

question: Omwegyesa, omuhiga omuhendikiro gw'ebintu bya kemisiri, abuuza abeeshuri be kutunga omurimo ogurikukurataho: Handiika engyenderwaho y'abarastani yona ey'ebintu ebiri omunshonga y'amaizi na amonia. Shushani emishushani ya Lewisi erikuhikaana na buli nshonga. Yombeka emishushani y'enshonga zoona n'ebumba n'obuti bw'emichwe nk'oku biri omu muringo gwazo. Shaho okushushana n'okutashushana aha miringo y'enshonga zombi. Ni birikukurataho byona, ni nshonga ki ezirikuba zirikushobora kucungurwa n'omurimo ogurikugambwaho?
answer_a: Rangi omukago gw'ekirikureeta hamwe ebintu kurugiirira aha mitwarize y'amasannyalaze g'obutini bwabyo
answer_b: Okureetera okugaba kw'ebipooli omunda y'ebiramu kurabira omu mikaro ya Lewis
answer_c: Shwijuma okugabana kw'obungi bw'obutini oburikukora emiramu omu molekyu nk'oku kyorekwa omumanyiso g'omuringo gw'okwegomba kw'amasannyalaze g'omu kabindo k'aha rubaju (VSEPR)
answer_d: Shuuruura ebiri ahagati y'akatomu n'ebitarikushuurura omu kazindaro kurugiirira aha miterere y'ebirikugakora.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omukuru omuheereza omu bw’ishomero erikuru ashaasha abegyi be kwetegyereza ebintu ebikuru ebiri omu kubara obwire ekiikaro bw’ekintu ekirimu obutwa obwa radioactive.
Murimo ki ogurikwija kuleetera abegyi kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shuuruuraana omu mwirondoozi gw'ebintu ebirukusaanuuka omu muhendo ogurikurugamu okucwekyera kw'ebintu ebirukusaanuuka.
answer_b: Ndyemeza ngu obwingi bw'akanya akarikukira aha kitabu ky'omuriro kuruga omu kintu ekiriyo nikigwa, nibukukwatana n'obwingi bw'ebintu ebiriyo ebiriyo nibigwa.
answer_c: Kuhuumuriza ebiri omu meza y'ebiro by'oburemezi bw'ekintu n'obwire oburikuhita omu kucwekyera kw'ebintu ebirimu obutwa.
answer_d: Teerera okuhinduka kw'ekintu eky'obusobozi bw'amaanyi g'omuriro n'okushobora omuhendo gw'obuto bw'akaziba obuhindukire.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w’omwaka ogw’okubanza omuishomero erikuru, omu ishomo ry’Ekibalo ky’Ebirungo, aine kucungura okwetegyereza kw’abegyeshwa aha bukuru bw’ebirikurugamu omu muringo ogurikuroraanisa omu kubaririra kw’ebirikurungo.
Ni bintu ki ebiri ahansi ebi omwegyesi arikubaasa kutebeekanisiza abegyeshwa kureetera kumanya ngu bamanyire ebi baayegire?
answer_a: Bara omuhendo gw’omugano gw’ebipimo bya mole hagati y’ebintu ebikozesebwa n’ebintu ebireetwawo omu muringo ogurikukurira.
answer_b: Bariita obureme bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebirugamu, oteekateeke omukago gwabyo omu kubara.
answer_c: Yombeka omugamba gw'okuhinduranya hagati y'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebintu ebireetwawo, n'omutindo gwabyo ogw'obwingi omu kikumi
answer_d: Yombeka omumeza gw'okuhikaanisa hagati y'emoola, obutini, n'obucweka bw'akatomu, orikusiingira aha bintu ebirimu omu kwikirizana.

question: Omurimo ki ogu omwegyesa w'eky'okuna omu mashomero agashemerire kutebeekanisiza abeeshuri be kureetera obwengye bw'okutebeekanisa ebintu, obwo nibakora aha mbeera z'ebintu?
answer_a: Mureebire abeeshuri omulingo gw'okukora okucweeka okurikworeka ngu oburemu bw'ekintu ekirikukwenda tibuhinduka eki kiyemeire.
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri baahandiike kandi bashuure omuringo gw'okukoresa okumanya yaaba amaizi gahindura obwingi bwago obu gahindura embeera.
answer_c: Gyenda abeshomesa bashomesibwe kukoresa ekipima bwihotero, kureeba obwiihotero bw'amaizi omu kacaafu obu buhinduka obu baraashe omu maizi obutookye.
answer_d: Eizi ki rikubaasa kubaho aha maizi, gari omu mbeera y'omutindo, gaashuuruurwa omu bwihumbi bw'omukaaro?

question: Omuhwezi omu ishomero ry'abana bato, omwegyesa ashemereire kushwijuma omulingo omwana atungireho oburemeezi bw'eky'okureeberaho eki ekya Corporality n'Okugyeenda: Aronda nari ayoleka omuhanda gw'ebintu eby'omunda nk'omutima, amahaho, obwongo. Ni engyenderwaho ki eyaaweereza omwegyesa kurungi kushingura ekigyendererwa kye?
answer_a: Shaba abaana kureeba ebinda by'omubiri gw'omuntu n'ebumba kandi oshireho obukugu bwabo orikukoresa akatabo k'okureebamu.
answer_b: Mubuuze omwana omwe naatoore ekicweka ky'omubiri gw'omuntu ahe obushoborozi bw'okugyenda ahabwabyo. Okorere hamwe obuhame kuraba omu bihandiiko by'okureeba.
answer_c: Shaba abaana kuta omubaanzi gw'ebicweka by'omubiri aha kishushani ky'omubiri gw'omuntu, reero oreekodi ebi bakozireho orikukoresa omugano gw'okushimira.
answer_d: Mugambire abaana kureeba vidiyo y'omubiri gw'omuntu, bwanyima mugambirane omu tubiina ebyo bareebire. Okunganye obuhame kuraba omu bihandiiko by'ebyabaireho.

question: Abaana abari omu Pre-kindergarten, omwegyesa abaeta aha rubaraza kwetegyereza embeera z'ebintu. Eki nikitwariramu kureka etabaaza omu izooba kureeba ekirikubaho. Enyima, abaana nibakora okuteebereza kandi nibabishushaniisa omu katarabo. Omu kumanyisa oku, nkyukakyuka ki y'embeera y'ekintu egi abaana b'omutendeka ogu barikubaasa kureeba?
answer_a: Okushaanisa
answer_b: Okwehisa
answer_c: Kuguma
answer_d: Okuhinduka omukka kugira amazi

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa pulayimale nasoma yombeka omutwe ogurikugira ngu Okuteekateeka nk'omuhangaika. Abaana bakagira omutwaro omunungi omu by'okurabamu nk'okukora engeyeso n'okwega ebikwatiraine n'omuringo gw'abahangaika. Obwomeezi obu barikwega n'okwetegyereza n'okucumita. Kiki ekirikubaasisa kuteeraniza obwomeezi obu omu baana?
answer_a: Ekipe ey'okukoresa omuntu kwetegyereza, okuhandiika ebintu bisya ebyegamiirwe omu kucwekyereza, reero okucweekereza.
answer_b: Eky'okukuratira, kworeka ebiteekateeko by'okubanza n'okwetegyereza kw'okugezesa, hanyuma ogeranise data erikukurwa enyima
answer_c: Ekitabo ky'okutebeekanisa, ekirikukora nk'omugufu gw'entebeekanisa n'ebiteekateeko by'okubanza eby'okucwekyereza, reero obwomeezi nibukurikiranwa.
answer_d: Ebikoresho by'okukorakorana n'okwetegyereza ebirikworobiya n'okukiriza okucuurura omuhanda ogurikwetegyerezebwa, kwonka kugaragaza ebyahurirwe.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omuishaaniro akoreire aha mugasho gw’okwegyesa ogurikugira ngu "Kukoragana omu mbeera za butoosha, omu bikorwa ebirikugumaho omu kukuza eby’obutonde oburikugumaho." Kutiinisa eki, yaagabana n’abaana obumwe aha by’okwegyera: kureeba vidiyo, kukora empapura, kutaayaayira esente za risaikulingi, n’ebindi. Hanyuma, aine kwetegyereza omugasho ogu yaatooranize. Nkoreki omuringo gw’okwetegyereza guraabe gubwire kukoresa okumanyisa oku omugasho ogu gwatiinisiibwe?
answer_a: Orikwenda omuhanda gw'okushimisha ebikorwa abaana abarikukora omu bwire obutungiire. Nk'eky'okureeberaho: okuzimya amateeka g'amaizi, okutorora empapura.
answer_b: Oorobereza ebirango, orikurugiira omu ku kondooza eby'abaana obwo barikuteeraho omutima, obu barikuhurira orugano orurikukwata aha bikorwa ebirikugumya obutonde bw'ensi.
answer_c: Orikurata omu kuchekiresti yaaba abaana nibashobora kwetantaza aha bishushani by'emikoro erikukwasa n'emikoro etaarikukwasa omu butonde bw'ensi oburikukuumirwa. Nk'eky'okureeberaho: okukoresa ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omurundi gwa kabiri, okuta amataka omu byondo.
answer_d: Ongyeera amakuru kuraba omu rurembo rw'okucweekereza orurikukoresibwa kucweekereza ebi abaana barikugamba nari ebiteekateeko byabo obu barikureeba vidiyo erikwooreka embeera ezitarikuhwera omu kukuuma obutonde bw'ensi. Nk'eky'okureeberaho: okukoresa amaizi omu muringo ogutari murungi, okusuura ebintu omu musenyi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa klasse ya kashatu, omu mutwe gw'okufaaho eby'obutonde, ekigyendererwa "Kwetegyereza Eiragiiriro ry'ebiragiro 3 omu bikorwa ebirikukwatwaho". Okukora eki, akaha abeeshuri omurimo ogu abeeshuri baabaasa kuhandiika ekikorwa kya buri izooba ahabwa buri kimwe aha mitwaro: Kukendeeza, Kukoresa Butoosha, Kuhindura. Omu aha beeshuri akatwara eby'okugarukamu ebi: 1. Kukoresa obukoore bw'okwetantaza oburikweshamba. 2. Kubyara ebimera omu byanzi by'amata. 3. Kwahukanisa n'okutoorana ebyanzi ebirikwija kutaangwa omu ka. Ni buha buhabuzi kuruga owa omwegyesa oburikubaasa kuleetera omweeshuri kuteeraho n'okumwebembera okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eky'ateekateekwa?
answer_a: Eby'okureeberaho birungi munonga! Kwonka R zoona ziriho? Ninkukunda kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebi: Kiki ekirikukwemerera kukoresa obutungi bukye nari okutunga ebikuru byonka? Muringo ki musya ogu orikubaasa kutebeekanisa kuhingura eky'okugarukamu kyaawe?
answer_b: Eby'okureeberaho birungi munonga! Kwonka ama R goona nigahikayo? Ninkukunda kuhandiika amakuru g'ebigambo bishatu ebi: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, orikurugiirira aha by'okureeberaho, reero ogarukye ekibuuzo eki: Ni nkora ki aha zino ei orikuteekateeka ngu neekora gye omu magara ga buri izooba?
answer_c: Eby'okureeberaho birungi munonga! Kwonka orabiremu "R". Okuhikiiriza eky'okugarukamu, ninkukunda kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebi: Ni miringo ki ey'oraabe nooteekateeka kutaaho omu ishomero? Nooyenda ota kureetera omwegi munaku okushanga omugasho omusya gw'ebintu omu mwanya gw'okubita?
answer_d: Eby'okureeberaho birungi munonga! Kwonka obaire orabiremu "R". Okuhikiiriza eky'okugarukamu, ninkukunda kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebi: Ahabw'enki ebikorwa ebi birungi omu kureeberera eby'obutonde? Nibitwara bata omu kukendeeza obucafu n'omwanda omu nsi yoona?

question: Ni murimo ki oguhikire abeeshuri abari omu mwaka ogw'okushatu gw'amashomero okukoresa kushoborra eky'obwire oburikwingana n'omwezi gukinga izooba (solar eclipse) n'okikyerereza banyaabwe?
answer_a: Baha kuheebwa orupapura orurimu enkingi zitarikushushana ezirikushushana n'eizooba, reero bashuure n'erangi eriragura ekisiikirize ky'okwezi omu bwiire obutari bumwe obw'okwiruka kw'eizooba kwona, kandi bashoboorore oku orwo rutaanira.
answer_b: Nibarikira omushana "gw'izuba" nibakoresa etoroshi aha kabumbi k'efoomu ekari kukyikirira Ensi, reero bareeba emiterere n'obunene bw'ekisiizi ekirikwolekwa aha bbaoodi enjeru, kandi bahandiika ebi barikureeba.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omumaiso g'eizooba n'akataara k'omumaiso, barikuranga omushana gwakyo aha ibaara erirangwa nk'ensi; bwanyima, nibakoresa akapiira akato barikwekwata bagenda nibakiija omu maisho g'akataara k'omumaiso, nibareeba oku ebimurikire aha ibaara birikuhinduka.
answer_d: Nibaijukiriza eizooba n’akataara, ensi n’emitwe yaabo n’emyoingo yaabo erikurugirira omu mwanya gw’akataara, n’okwezi n’akabuumbo k’omweru akabakwata omu ngaro zaabo n’omukono gwaabo ogugoroirwe, kandi bagyezaho okukyingura butoosha omu muringo ogurikuruga ahari izooba, nibareeba ekirikubaho aha kwaka kw’akabuumbo.

question: Omwegyesi w’abaana abato omu ariyo naatebeekaniisa kukora obuhame bw’okugyenda nibareeba obubonero bw’okucweeka aha kicweka kikuru eky’Obuntu n’Okugyeenda: Naamanya ebicweka by’omubiri gwe bimwe naayorekyezaaho arikubiranga. Kucweeka obuhame nk’obwo, omwegyesi naija kukoresa za vidiyo n’ebyahandiikwa ebirikushoboorora. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikukiriza kucweeka okuhingurwa kw’akabonero ako?
answer_a: Omuzungu arikushusha omu kicweka ky'okushambaza, omukuru naatuura haihi n'endorerwamu, omwana yaizire haihi, amubuuze ebicweka by'omu maisho ge birikuba biri haihi.
answer_b: Omuzungu mukuru omu bwire bw'okukora ebintu butarikurugire, nabuuza omwana aha bw'emitwarize etari emwe n'amugambira kukwata omutwe gwe aharikukorera omutwarize gwona ogwo.
answer_c: Omuzungu akuhindura obwire, omukuru arikwimba enyimba ezirikukwatana n'ebicweka by'omu maisho, arikubikoraho aha mubiri gwe wenka naareeba yaaba omwana nabigarukamu.
answer_d: Omuzungu naakora ebikorwa ebirikukwata aha bice by'omubiri byeitungaanisa, nk'okukoma omukono, okuhindura ebigyere n'omutwe; reero yaabuuza abaana kumutooreza ebikorwa ebi.

question: Omwegyesi w’ekicweka kya kindergarten araganisa omu purojekiti y’eby’amagara ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikukurira aha kintu eki: “Kuhimba ebiteekateeko aha birikurugamu omu bintu ebirikubaho omu butonde ebi orikureeba, orikwesigamira aha bumanyi n’obuhangwa ebi waabaire nooyegaho.” Ni enyegyesa ki aha zirikukurira egi erikukwasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Yolesa vidiyo erikushoborora oku emiyaga mikuru erikukorwa. Bwanyima, oite abaana omingi kugamba aha byabaho ahari bo, kuraba omu bibuuzo ebi: Oyabaire omu muyaga mukuru? Kiki ekyaabaireho omu butonde?
answer_b: Yoreka eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka enyanja omu kacupa k'eicuba. Reero, oreebese nk'ori kugyema itsunami, oragiire abaana kureeba ekirikubaho kandi obabuze ekibuuzo: Nikiki ekyaabaireho amaizi g'enyaja gaayenda aha itaka?
answer_c: Mureke abaana bakore orusozi rw'omuriro nibakoresa ebibumba, omu tukungu tutono, nibakurata endagiro ezihaireyo. Bwanyima, mureke tugyeragyeranise okuturika kw'orusozi rw'omuriro, reero mubabuze: Mbwenu noobaasa kushoboorora eki woreebire? Okuturika okwo kwabaireho kita?
answer_d: Tebeekanisa oruziga rw'okuganiira n'abaana aha kumanya kwabo okurikukwata aha mitingito. Reero, obatoore kureeba, omu ky'okureeberaho, okurikwihirira omutingito kandi obabuze: Mbwenu shi mwangyoreka muta ekyabaireho? Ni matungo ki egiine kutunga aha bwijwire?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omuto n’abaana aha mugingo gw’okwega ogurikuruga omu Kicweka ky’Okwetegyereza Ebirikukwata aha Butonde: “Kugezesa n’ebintu ebirikugattwa hamwe n’ebirikushaanwa omu mazi okukoresa ebintu ebirikukoresebwa buri izooba, nk’ensabbuuni, amazi g’omunyo, na jelatini, noogamba aha nkyukakyuuka ezoorekirwe.” Kutiisa eki, abeta kwetaba omu kugezesa “Enjura y’Emihogo.” Eki nikitwariramu okushuka amazi, reero amajuta, bwanyima obutooni bw’ebara omu kacupa akarikworeka, n’obuyambi bw’omuntu omukuru. Obu arikukora eki, omwegyesa nabuuza abaana, “Kiki ekirikubaho?” Antonio, omwe aha baana, nagira ati, “Ninkunda emihogo ei orikweteraho.” Omu migambi egi erikukurataho, niki ekirikukonyera Antonio kutuura aha mugingo gw’okwega ogugambirweho?
answer_a: Nikukusima munonga ahabwokuba nozikunda, Antonio. Eyi orikukunda okukira zoona n'ehi? Hati, yetegyereza ebintu ebindi, nk'eky'okureeberaho, amaizi na amafuta tibyebumbire hamwe.
answer_b: Ekyo nikikuru, Antonio, nanye nkasiima emibala eyatukozeseze. Orikumanya ngu obu ziri omu amauta, zigumaho nk'ebipooli?
answer_c: Murungi, Antonio, ngu okasiimire emiringo ei twakozeseize. Noobaasa kumbwira oba orikureeba enjura yona aha miringo eri omu amauta n'eriya ehikire omu maizi?
answer_d: Kikuru eky’obwengye, Antonio, abanywani baawe omu klasse nabo bakasiima emibala ei twakozeseze. Hati, ninkukunda kureeba ekirikubaaho aha mibala egi aha muheru gw’okugezesa.

question: Omu omukuru omu itsaani ry'omunaana, aherize kushoborora omugasho gw'ebirikuruga omu kintu ekirikugira obutofa bw'omubiri, omwegyesa naija kwongyera kushoborora omugasho gwabyo arikukoresa orugero orurikugyeragyeranisa mashini n'ebicweka by'eifaakitore n'obutofa bw'omubiri. Orugero orurikukurataho oru omwegyesa arikwija kugambaho niruragana na "cytoskeleton"?
answer_a: Ekyeruro ekihindura ebintu ebirimu obumbe bw'obuhangwa okubihindura amaani
answer_b: Omukura ogurikukonyera obutebeekane kugumaho omunda y'eifaakitore
answer_c: Ekicweka ky'okugenzesa ekiina amakuru g’ekyanga kandi kikagenyiha ebirikubaho omuri kyo
answer_d: Ekyeruro ekishobora kuteeraho akarembo aharizooba erikusangwa eryetwaire kuruga omu furirikatoori

question: Omugyezaho omwegyesa w'eky'omunaana ashangire ngu abeeshuli beine oburemeezi bw'okwetegyereza ekirikukwata aha osmosis. N'ahabw'ekyo, n'atebeekaine omurimo oguraabasiise kwetegyereza oku omuringo ogu gw'okutwara ebintu ogutari gwa maani gukorwa. Omu miringo egi erikukurataho, n'oguhe omwegyesa araabe asaasaize kwongyera aha kwetegyereza kw'abeeshuli be aha mukoro gwa osmosis?
answer_a: Gyenda abeshomesa bacumuure ekicweka ky'ebitakuli ekiramu gramu 10 omu mazi g'omunyu ogutaine mutindo ogushingaine, ogwa 0.9%. Enyima y'eminute 15, mugyemu ekicweka ky'ebitakuli, mupime oburemu bwabyo, hanyuma mugyerageranise n'oburemu bwabyo obw'okubanza. Shoboorora ekirikubaho aha kuhingurira kw'amaizi.
answer_b: Gyenda abeeshuri bacumuure akacupa k’ekyaayi omu kikopo ky’amaizi amaruru, barore ekirikubaho. Reero, ocumuure akacupa k’ekyaayi ekindi omu kikopo ky’amaizi g’okushushu, orore ekirikubaho. Shoboorora omuringo gw’okutwara ogurikubaho n’oku okushushu kurikukwata aha bunaku eki kyaayi kirikumara kwesiigira omu kikopo kyona.
answer_c: Yoreka eky'okureeberaho: yijuuza ebeka n'amaizi otaatseho akatonye k'obwojo. Reeba ekirikubaho aha bwojo, obuuze ebibuuzo kwetegyereza ngu obwojo nibureeta enyihaho y'omutaano kurugiirira aha bwingi nari omutaano gw'obwojo ogurikusaasaana omu maizi.
answer_d: Yoreka omuhanda ogurikworeka ekyombo kirimu ebicweka bibiri eby'ahukaniisiibwe oruhu rw'akacwamu. Yoreka omunyu n'obutuli buto, obwingi omu kicweka kimwe, obare obutuli omu bicweka byombi, orabe ngu obureingwa bw'amaizi nibumwe. Enyima y'edakiika 5, yoreka ekyombo kimwe, obare obutuli obushigire omu bicweka byombi, orabe ngu obureingwa bw'amaizi buhindukire, nibweyongyera omu kicweka kirimu obutuli obwingi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w’ekyomunaana ari kutebeekaniza isomo aha miterere y’obuzimbe bw’obutofaali oburikukora ebindi, kandi yabaasa kwenda abegyesi kukwataganya okukura kw’omugasho kw’enkumbu y’omunda y’obutofaali n’omurimo gwayo. Ni enki aha bikorwa by’okwegyesa ebiraakuratira ebi nebiija kureetera abegyesi kukurira aha kigyendererwa ekitebeekaniiziibwe?
answer_a: Yolesa ebifaananyi bya "microphotographs" y'obutaffaali oburikukora ebintu by'omubiri (secretory cells) orikubagambira kumanya omurimo gwa buri kimwe aha bintu ebirikugambwaaho.
answer_b: Baha kubashushani aha microphotograph y'akashushano k'akariisa akarikukora ebintu by'omubiri (secretory cell) omuhanda ogu protein zirikutindira zigyenda nibiita omuhanda gw'okwiha ebintu omu mubiri (exocytic route), reero obishoboorore.
answer_c: Reeta ekishushani ky'akashagama k'omubiri ekirikukora ebintu by'omunda n'ekindi ky'akashagama k'omubiri gw'enyama, reero obagambire kugaragura omulingo ebintu ebirikubihweraana birikumaraana.
answer_d: Reeta ekishushani ky'akash सेल ekirikukora eby'okuhisha n'ekindi ky'akash सेल k'omubiri, reero obagambire bashoborore omugasho gw'obwo bush सेल kurugiira aha miteerere yaabyo.

question: Omwegyesereza w’eky’omunaana ari kutandika omutwe gw’ebiramu by’omubiri. Okukora eki, nashoborora enshuraniso nkuru eziri ahagati y’oburamuby’omubiri obwa eukaryotic na prokaryotic, nk’okubaho nari obutabaho bw’akacwe kamurungo omuri byo. Ku araamara, omwegyeswa abuuza: “Oburamuby’omubiri obwa prokaryotic nibushobora bute kwegabura?” Twashushaniisa omulingo gw’omwegyeswa, nishoboroza ki hali enshoboroza ezi omwegyesi ahabwa, erikumwemerera kugarukamu ekibuuzo kye omu mulingo ogurikwetegerezebwa kandi ogurikugira obuhame bw’ebirikukwataho?
answer_a: Obutare bw’ekirokaryoti tibuzaara, baitu tiburikukozesa muringo gw’okwegaita, ekikumanyisa ngu tihariho kwegaita kw’obutare bw’omubiri omu muringo ogwo, nk’oku kirikubaho omu butare bw’ekiyukaryoti
answer_b: Obushoboorozi bw’akashagama kwegaanisa bukigyira aha kubaho kw’omubiri gwa DNA, k’aba hariho obutima rundi hatariho. Omu muringo ogu, obushagama bwa prokaryotic na eukaryotic byombi biine DNA.
answer_c: Okugabura orubaju n’omuringo gw’okuzaara abantu bashya babiri kuruga omu rubaju oruzaire. Oburimwa bw’orubaju orwa prokaryotic n’orwa eukaryotic byombi biine omuringo ogu.
answer_d: Obutundu obutaine nyukiriya, nk'obutundu bwa purokayotiiki, buine ebintu by'obutonde. Omubo, omulingo gw'okweyongera gwa bayinari fisheni nigwo gukolebwamu, omuli DNA egikopiibwa hanyuma obuziba bugatenganwa, nibuzaara obutundu bubiri obulinganaine obunene.

question: Orikwezo ry'okucungura, omwegyesa w'ekicumi na munaana ateekaniziise ekigyendererwa ky'okushomesa ekirikukurira: "Shoboorora emisingye y'omugano gwa Dalton ogw'ebintu by'omunda." Ni birikurugamu byahi ebirikwoleka okucungura ebirikubaasa kwolesa abegi kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Nibakora ebintu by’emishororongo ya kemikali etari emwe esingirwe aha muhendo gw’ebintu bibiri nari okukiraaho.
answer_b: Nibarikira omuhendo gw'obwingi bw'obutini oburikwetaba omu kwegaita kw'ebintu.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omubuzo gw'ebipimo by'oburemerezi bw'ebintu ebiri omu kintu ekikozirwe n'oburemerezi bw'ekintu kyona ekikozirwe
answer_d: Nibarikiriza kubara oburemeezi bw'ekintu ekirikubaho omu mitwaro eshatu ezitari zimwe ezihikaine oburemeezi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mukaga omuheru gw'eklassi aha nsingye z'eby'okurya, nayenda kumanya yaaba abegyeswa bategeire omugasho gw'ebintu ebirukora eby'okurya. Ni murimo ki aha mirimo erikukorwa abegyeswa erikubaasa kumuheereza okushishoora okukwata aha mbeera y'okwega kwabo?
answer_a: Yijuza ekishushani ky'ekimera, orageze ebintu ebi kikiraganisa n'ebi kirukukora omu kubumbabw'emuringo.
answer_b: Ha eby'okureeberaho by'ebintu ebirukora ebyokurya byabyo byenyine.
answer_c: Ebirugaaba omuhanda gw'ebyomeeri gwaabaasa kukurugamu omu byomeeri bw'emiti yaaba ezaahwereireho
answer_d: Shuuruura omukago hagati y'ebintu ebiramu ebiri omu mutego gw'ebyokurya

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’okubanza owa siniya, omu itendekyero erikukwata aha bintu ebirikutunguura okukora kw’ebimera eby’okurya, naija kugamba aha kutebeekanisa eby’okushobora n’abegyeswa be. Ni kikuru ki aha bikorwa ebi omwegyesa arikukora ekirikubaasa kureetera eki ekigyendererwa kuhikiirira?
answer_a: Ha ebyarugiremu omu kwega ebikwata aha maani g'ekyanga hamwe n'ebyo twarikwenda kumanya, ngu abeeshuri bashobore kwemeza nari kuremesa.
answer_b: Teeka omuringo gw'okukora okushomesa omuti gukaba gukwesherezibwa omu mishana etari emwe n'emwe, kandi orikurugiirira aha kwetegyereza kw'okushomesa, abeegi bashoboorore ebintu ebirikwetegyerezibwa.
answer_c: Obururu n'obushuushu n'omufuunjo nibigira bita omu kufeerera kw'ebimera ebyokurya (photosynthesis)?
answer_d: Haati ezirikubaasa kuba enshonga y'ekibuuzo ky'okushwijuma eki: "Omuringo ogu CO2 erimu guri kugumira omuhendo gw'okukora eby'omurimo gw'ebimera (photosynthesis)?" n'oguha, abeeshuri bashobore kwotorana egyo erikukirayo obuhikire.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’okubanza owa siniya ari kukora aha mugenzo gwa Darwin ogw’okuhinduka kw’ebintu. Ekigyendererwa kimwe n’okureetera abegi kwetegyereza ngu ebiriisa ebirikukwatana munonga omu kuhinduka kw’ebintu byabaire nibigabana izooba rimwe ery’enyima. Omu kucungura okumanya, areeba ngu abegi abamwe tibarikwetegyereza eki ekirikugambwaho. Ni murimo ki aha mirimo erikukuratira erikubaasa kureetera aba beegi kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Taata ebiramu omuhendo kurugiirira aha kufaanana kwabyo omu mbeera y'omubiri.
answer_b: Garukamu ebibuuzo kurugiirira aha kucweekereza ekicweka ky'ekikoni kya cladogramu
answer_c: Yomba ekishushani kirikugaburamu eby'okureeberaho by'ebishagiro by'obutazigye ebirikwohereka n'ebitarikwohereka
answer_d: Geranisiriza emikorogo ey’ebihimba ebiheraine omu bintu ebirukuumirweyo kugira ngu otandikeho obunywani bwabyo

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’ina owa siniya ari kutebeekaniza isomo eriragira abegyereza kumanya omugasho gw’okugemba omu by’obushaho bw’abantu boona. Ni enki aha bikorwa ebi abegyereza barikukora ekirikwija kugasira omwegyesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by’omukurrikuru w’eby’okwegyesa aha kumanya ebimanyiso bya sayansi?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebirikuruga omu kugemwa kurugiirira aha byahandiikwa by'okugezesa nk'eky'omuntu nk'Edward Jenner.
answer_b: Nibashwijuma, kurugiira aha bicweka by'ebishushani, obwingi bw'endwaara ezirikwata kandi bakashoboorora ebiri kubireeta.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza, kurugi eby’omubalanguzi, omuhendo gw’abantu abahaire oburinzi n’okuguhuura n’okugaruka kw’endwara ezimu.
answer_d: Nibakora omurongo gw'ebiro by'okukura kw'ebintu bikuru ebirikukwata aha kugemeesa, nibashoboorora omugasho gw'abanyasayansi ab'entaango omu kibanja eki.

question: Omu omukuru omu mwaka gw'abiri ogw'ahaiguru, ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa abeeshure kumanya eby'omuringo gw'amagi n'omuringo gw'enda, ekibiina ky'abeeshure nikikora orutaro aha muringo ogu. Ku barikushoboorora omuhanda gw'okurekurura amagi, omweeshure naagira ati: "Obu akahu kyakuura kandi omuringo gwa luteinizing hormone gweyongyera, nikirekururwa kuruga omu igi kandi nikireka kureeta estrogen. Hanyuma, ekintu ekiihyaka nikireebeka omu igi erikwetwa corpus luteum, erikutandika kureeta progesterone." Kiki ekirikuzibuura okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi ekirikworeka omu kugarukwamu kw'omweeshure ogu?
answer_a: Nihabwe ngu okubura kw'omwe aha mishangwa y'omu nda y'abakazi nikwo kureetera okuhwa kw'amagi.
answer_b: Okurikira aha kuba okurekurwa kw'ebijumbe by'amagi tikurikugenderera aha bungi bw'emishonga ya gonadotropic omu musaayi
answer_c: Kutahoora omukago ogutahikire ahagati y'ebicweka by'omutindo gw'okukura kw'amagi n'emibazi ya gonadotropic ehindura omutindo ogwo
answer_d: Ninkora ngu omubiri gwa corpus luteum guriho gwenyine omu ibumba ry'omwisho kandi gutarikuruga omu kintu kyaba kigumire omu mwisho ogwo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya, omu mutwe gw'ebintu n'amaani omu butonde bw'ebiramu, naija kutebeekaniza okushomesa okw'okubanza okw'okugyenda omu maisho kw'ebirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza omukago oguli hagati y'omulingo gw'okukora eby'okulya kw'ebimera n'omulingo gw'okuhuumura kw'obutonde bw'ebiramu obuto". Ni murimo ki ogurikwija kumworeka okugyenda omu maisho kw'okushomesa oku?
answer_a: Yijuza ekicweka ky'okugyeragyeranisa n'ent differences enkuru eziri ahagati y'omuringo gw'okukora eby'okulya kw'ebimera (photosynthesis) n'omuringo gw'okuhuumura kw'obutaffaali (cellular respiration)
answer_b: Photosynthesis na cellular respiration nibikorwa bikuru eby’omugasho omu kutunga obutaro bw’ebiramu omu butonde. Photosynthesis, ekikorwa eki ebimera birikukoresa omushana gw’eizooba kukora ebyokurya, neekwata carbon dioxide omu mwanya n’amazzi kuruga omu itaka, byombi neebyihaho oxygen. Oxygen ogu nigwo abantu n’ebindi biramu birikuhuumura. Cellular respiration, ekikorwa eki ebiramu birikukoresa kukora amaani kuruga omu byokurya, neekoresa oxygen neebyihaho carbon dioxide. Carbon dioxide ogu nigwo ebimera birikukoresa omu photosynthesis. Eki nikitunga obutaro bw’oxygen na carbon dioxide omu mwanya, ekirikukwasa omu kutunga obutaro bw’obushwere omu butonde.
answer_c: Teeka ekipande ekiine emigyego y'ebirikukorwa omu kubumbabumba kw'ebimera n'okuhuumura kw'obutare bw'omubiri, omuri byombi okwesigama kw'emiringo egi nikwo kuraangwa.
answer_d: Teekanisa ekishushani ky'ebizimbe by'akacuuba omubaireho okukora eby'okulya kw'ebimera (photosynthesis) n'okuhuumura kw'akacuuba (cellular respiration), nooreetera hamwe ebintu ebikuru ebikozesebwa omu buri omwe omurimo ogwo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogwa kana owa siniya yaabaire atekireho ekigyendererwa ky’okuba abegyi be bateekateeka kukwata aha bikorwa bya enzayimu ezirikukozesebwa omu kweyongyera kw’obwingi bwa DNA. Omu kyezo ekyaahaheru aha mutwe ogu, amubuuza ekibuuzo ekirikugira ngu: “Fludarabine n’omubazi ogurikukozesebwa kukiza amagana gamwe g’ekooki, gurikuremesa okweyongyera kw’obwingi bwa DNA kuraba omu kuremesa DNA primase. Kurugiirira aha bwamanya obu, ekicweka ki ky’okweyongyera kw’obwingi bwa DNA eki fludarabine erikukwataho butoosha?” Ni kamanyiso ki aha by’okushomesa akarikupimwa ekibuuzo eki?
answer_a: Shobora ekikorwa ky'omusaizi ekirikukwatanisa n'okukora RNA erikukoresibwa omu kubanza kw'okukora DNA
answer_b: Shoborora omukora gw'ekikorwa ky'enzayimu ekirikukorera aha kuzibura orunyololo orwabiri orwa heriksi.
answer_c: Sherekereza omukora gw'ekikorwa ky'enzayimu ekirikukwatanisa n'okwongyera obutini oburikukura omu mugo gw'obushorozi
answer_d: Shobora ekikorwa ky'omuguta ogurikukora omu kucwekyereza emikago ya haidurojeni egihuura enyikirizo za DNA hamwe

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya akora omusomo gw'okukora aha kiragiro ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Okwombeka eby'okureeberaho ebirikushoboorora eby'obutonde bw'ensi eby'aha system y'eizooba". Kandi okugyenda aha bunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba, omwegyesa acwamu kworeka etaabulo y'omugabo ogurikwetengwa ogurikwongyerwaho obunene bw'eizooba n'enjuba arikukoresa empandiika ya sayansi. Niki ekiraabe kiri omuringo murungi gw'okukora ogurikwongyera aha etaabulo kandi gukikora aha kiragiro ky'okwegyesa omu muringo ogurikuhikire?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa ebirimu omu mw'etaafeeri omuri taabulo kuruga omu buceeri kukuru, noohiga abeeshuri kwikiriza omutima aha muteekanisi gwabyo omu mwanya gw'okwetenga amakuru g'emibaro.
answer_b: Shutama omugazi gw'Ensi nk'ekipimo ekikuru omu meza, oreebeireho orukurato orundi orurikworeka omugano hagati y'omugazi gw'ebintu by'omu iguru ebirikushushana n'ogw'Ensi.
answer_c:
Ngyenda y'omu iguru n'obunene bwayo
