question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’abiri omu sekenda ari kutebeekanisa amasomo g’ekicweka kya Kinematics. Omu rimwe aha masomo ago, naija kukora omurimo oguraagyezaho ebiri omu isomo, kurikukiriza aha bw’amaani oburi omu kalikula aha Mutindo gwa Saayansi. Omu mirimo ei abegyeswa baraakore, oruhe orurikukiriza omu bwengye aha bw’amaani obwo oburi omu kalikula?
answer_a: Nibashoboorora oku omuringo gw’amaani g’omugyegye gutwarira aha kucumura ebizibu bya buri izooba
answer_b: Nibashobora kushoborora oku omuringo gw'amaani g'omugyegyo gwateireho omu byafaayo by'abantu.
answer_c: Nibashobora kushoborora oku okukura kw’eby’obuhangwa n’omuringo kureetsire obuhangwa oburikukiraho obw’okushobora kupima omugabo gw’amaani g’omugyego.
answer_d: Nibashoborra oku omugyenzo gw’okugwa omu mwanya gw’obusheesho guruga n’oku omugyenzo ogu gyesigamire aha bwangu bw’amaani g’okurugamu.

question: Omu bitabo by'eshomero obwingi, omu kwega ebikwaata ha mashanyarazi n'omuringo oguhingurira omu mutego gw'amashanyarazi, "okushushanisa n'amaizi" nikukoresibwa kusingura okwetegyereza ebintu nk'amaani g'omuringo n'amaani g'amashanyarazi, omu bindi. Omu kushushanisa oku, emiringo y'omutego gw'amashanyarazi ogw'omusingi negeranisibwa n'emiringo y'omugyigyo gw'amaizi agurikwingira omu rubingo, nk'ahaamaizi garikushushana n'ebintu ebirikugyenda. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikurugaho, ekihe kyaaganiisa ki ekirikushushana n'omugabe ogu nk'omuringo gw'okwegyesa okwegyesa abegi emitego y'amashanyarazi erikwingira?
answer_a: Tikirikukora kukoresa omu kwega ebikunizo by'amasannyalaze ebihingaanire hamwe n'ebiri omurongo.
answer_b: Nikugyema abeeshuri kwikiriza ngu omugyano gw'amasannyalaze nigubaasa "kushura" omu mutambi, kwonka gutarikubaasa "kwambuka"
answer_c: Tirikwikiriza abeeshuri kukwataganya amagezi g'okuzibira omugendo gw'amasannyalaze n'ekintu kyona ekirikureebwa omu mugendo gw'amaizi.
answer_d: Nikikuratiiza abeeshuli okuteekateeka ngu amaani g'omuringo ogurikukurira omu kasahani k'amasanyu nigushushana n'omuguta gw'amaizi ogurikukurira omu kasahani k'amaizi.

question: Omucondo gw'omwegyesa ogurikukirayo obuhikire kushoborora okutahurira kw'omwegi, kurikugarukamu omuhanda ogurikwetegyereza kandi n'obuhikire bw'ebirikukirayo, n'oguha?
answer_a: Reeba omuhanda gumwe n'ogundi gw'ekijiiko. Ekishushani eki orikwereeba omuhanda ogurikwetenga nikyo ky'obushushani obutahikire, n'ekishushani eki orikwereeba omuhanda ogurikukwenda ahansi nikyo ky'amazima.
answer_b: Oshemereire kwijuka ngu ebishushani by’amazima buri obwiire nibiba bihinduraine, kuruga ahaiguru okuhika ahansi, obwo ebishushani by’obushangwa buri obwiire nibiba birugaine omu bwengye.
answer_c: Ebifananyi eby'obushuba nibireebeka nk'ebiri enyima y'endorerwamu, kwonka ebifananyi by'amazima nibireebeka omu maisho gay'endorerwamu kandi nibishobora kworekwa aha kikoomi.
answer_d: Ebifananyi eby'obushuba nibikoleka omu kibanza ky'obushuba eky'omuriro kuraba omu kwongyera aha misiri egwire, obu ebifananyi eby'amazima bikolekera omu kworekwa kw'emisiri eyeretsire.

question: Ni bumanyi ki abanyeshuri abarikwingira omwaka gwabo ogw'okubanza omu mashomero ga siniya abaine kuba barikumanya kare kubaasa kwetegyereza ebintu ebirikukwata aha mishana nk'okwerorera n'okucwekyera kw'omushana?
answer_a: Okumanya ngu omushana nigwenda omu murongo ogugororokire
answer_b: Okumanya ngu leza eriha omushana gw'ebara rimwe.
answer_c: Okwetegyereza omushana nk'omuyaga gw'amasannyalaze n'obushoboorozi
answer_d: Okwetegyereza emiringo y'omushana nk'omuyaga n'ekintu

question: Omwegyesi w’omwaka ogw’abiri, omu Physics, omu bwire obu ari haihi kwegyesa, naija kukorera hamwe n’abegyi be aha kigyendererwa eki: "Kwetegyereza amateeka ga Newton n’okugakoresa kushoboorora embeera eza buri izooba". Twaba niturora embeera eri ahaiguru, ni enshonga ki aha zirikukurugiraho ezirikworeka enyikiriza ez’obushuba ibiri ezirikubaasa kutaataagura omwegyeso gw’ekigyendererwa eki turikwenda?
answer_a: Obureiyo n'obuhinduko bw'omwanya nibimanyisa ekintu kimwe; amaani agurikukoresibwa kutaata ekintu nigashuuruurwa oburemeezi bw'ekintu ekyo.
answer_b: Omubiri gwabaire nigumire, tihariho maani agurikora; okuhutaana nikubaho obutoosha omu muhanda gumwe n'okugyeenda.
answer_c: Omwanya gw'ekintu nigushobora kushobororwa kuraba omu buraayo bwagyenda kuruga aharikutaandikira; ebintu ebiriho byonka nibishobora kukoresa amaani.
answer_d: Obuhabuzi buri buriire niburemesa okweyongyera omuhanda; amaani agaakoresibwe ekintu ekito aha kikuru munonga nigo mato okukira amaani ag'okugarukana ag'ekikuru aha kito

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'omu mwaka ogw'abiri ogw'ahaiguru ari kukora ekikoreso ky'okushimira ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurira: "Kwoleka ngu nibetegyereza ngu okumanya ebiri omu bwengye nikuhinduka kandi nikweyongyera hamwe n'obuhame obusya." Ni kiratwa ki ky'okushima ekirikukwata aha kwega kw'abanyeshuri aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shoborora omuhanda ogu bw’ensi yoona ekuraireho okurikukurirana n’enyegyesa y’Okutandika Kukuru.
answer_b: Shoborora omuringo ebintu by'omu bwengyerero byabaireho kuraba omu kwegomba kw'amaani g'omuguto.
answer_c: Geragyeranisa emigisha n'obugufu bw'emiringo etari emwe emwe y'ensi yoona omu kushoborora oku egikura.
answer_d: Shisha ebitebyo ebyakozirwe ekitebe ky'okushoborora engyenderwera y'ensi n'ekitebe ky'okushoborora engyenderwera y'eizoba aha bikwaata aha nkora y'omushana

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’abiri owa siniya, omu mutwe gw’eky’enjegyereza (Kinematics), naija kukora okukebera okw’okubanza kw’okwetegereza okwetegereza kw’abeeshuri aha mbeera y’okugwa kw’ebintu. Kurugiirira aha kigyendererwa eki, murimo ki gw’okushishooreza oguraagira omwegyesa kutunga obuhame oburikukirayo oburungi aha kumanya kw’abeeshuri okw’okubanza aha mutwe ogu?
answer_a: Omu mwanya gw'aha rubaju, nibata obuntu butari bumwe omu iguru kandi bagyeragyeranisa ebintu ebirikukwata aha kuta okwo.
answer_b: Nibazamu bibuuzo ebigyendereire kugaragura hamu n'okuteerereza obwire ebirikwetenga ngu ebintu bitwarwe nibigwa kuruga omu buringaanire obumwe
answer_c: Nibarikira omu kishushani oburyo omupiira gwa tennis guri kwihuta obu guri omu mwanya kuruga aha omweziini omwe kuhika aha ondiijo
answer_d: Nibakora omumapu y'ebiteekateeko erimu ebiragiro bya kinemaatika ebikwata aha kutambuka kw'ebintu ebigwa byonka.

question: Aha, omushohori gw'eihangaanwa ry'omuguruko (Doppler effect) aha muheru gw'eklassi y'abanyeshuri ab'omwaka gw'okubanza owa secondary, omwegyesa naakora okushomesa kw'okuhameza okwegyesa kw'abanyeshuri. Ekintu kimwe omu kushomesa eki nikigira kiti: Omu ihangaanwa ry'omuguruko (Doppler effect) n'emigisha y'amaizi, omushohori gw'okusaasaara kw'amaizi niguhinduka? Shoboorora. Omunyeshuri naagarukamu ati: "Omushohori niguhinduka ahabw'okuba nigyesigamira aha muringo n'obureingwa bw'omugisha, kandi byombi nibihinduka omu ihangaanwa ry'omuguruko (Doppler effect)." Bintu ki ebi omwegyesa ashemereire kugambira omunyeshuri kumuhabura aha kwega kwe, ngu ashobore kumanya n'okusingura enshobi ye?
answer_a: Tikirikwo n’ekihamire kugira ngu omulingo n’obureingwa bw’omururu nibihinduka, ahabw’okuba ekyo nikibaho aha muntu orikureeba. Kandi, byombi nibihinduka omu mulingo ogutari gumwe, n’ahabw’ekyo ebirikurugamu byombi nibisiigara biri kimwe.
answer_b: Niki ekireetera omulingo gw'amaloboozi n'oburaingwa bwago kuhinduka? Haliho ekiliyo omu mbeera enu? Omulingo ogu amaloboozi garabaire omu Doppler effect tiguhinduka. N'ahabw'ekyo, ku omulingo gw'amaloboozi ogurikuhurikwa gweyongyera, oburaingwa bwago nibuceera.
answer_c: Tikirikwoikiriza kugira ngu omushobero gw'okusaasana niguhinduka, ahabw'okuba niguharaireho. Omu mugisha gwa Doppler, obureingwa bw'omuyaga nibwija kuhinduka aha mureebi, kwonka omu muringo ogurikuhakanisa n'okuhinduka omu bwingi bw'omuyaga aha mureebi. N'ahabw'ekyo, ekirikurugamu omu bwingi bwombi nikiharaireho.
answer_d: Ijuka erireetera omulingo gw'omuvumo kugyezaho. Haliyo lyona omu mbeera enu? N'obu omureebi arikubaasa kureeba omulingo n'oburaingwa nibahinduka, omulingo gw'okusaasana tiguhinduka. Nikitya shi omulingo n'oburaingwa bw'omuvumo nibihinduka?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'omwaka ogwa kabiri omu somero erishemereire, omu mutwe gw'Eby'emiterere n'Eby'okushushana, ari kutebeekaniza isomo eririmu ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Okumanya obukuru bw'emiterere ya R nari S omu bizibo ebikoresibwa omu magara ga buri izooba". Ni ebikorwa by'aha hansi ebihaikirire okukora n'abegyirizibwa kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesha bateekateeke aha makuru g'eby'obushuuru ag'okukora emibazi erimu R na S isomers
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa bacuubaaze aha migisha y'okukoresa emibazi ebiri eri abantu, emibazi egi neeba neeshushana omu muringo gw'obuzimbe bwayo kwonka neetahukana omu miringo ei gikora.
answer_c: Gyezaho abeeshuri kugaragura enshonga ezirikushushana n'ezitatushana omu miterere y'ebintu ebirikukora omubiri (physicochemical properties) y'ebintu bya R na S ebirikushushana omu muterere (stereoisomer) by'ebintu 5 ebikoresibwa buriijo, nk'eky'okureeberaho, ibuprofen
answer_d: Shaba abeeshuri bakoresa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog kushobora R na S configuration y'ebintu 5 ebikoresebwa butoosha, nk'eky'okureeberaho, fructose

question: Omwegyesereza ki orikubaasa kwikiriza omwegyesa kukora aha mitwarize y'ekikoroidi kugarukamu okutari kumanya kw'omwegi?
answer_a: Koresa omugisha gwa Tyndall omu kikoliroidi ekimanyirwe.
answer_b: Gatangye omucweko gwa mayoneesi n'amaizi, oreebe ebi orikureeba.
answer_c: Yashushani omuhendo gw'akareebeka gwa koroidi egi abantu barikukoresa buri izooba.
answer_d: Shisha omuringo gw'omukago gw'ebirikubumbwa (molecular structure) aha kkoroyidi (colloid) n'omutaano (solution).

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’okubanza owa siniya, omu mutwe gw’okuchangaanisa amaranzi, ari kukora orusoma n’ekigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: “Okukoresa amakuru g’omulingo, Stock, hamu n’enganda okuchangaanisa amaranzi g’ebyoma”. Obu arikushoborora oku amaranzi aga galikuchangwa nikukoresibwa amakuru ga Stock, namanya ngu abegi tibarikwetegyereza ahabwenki baine kuteekamu obugumi bw’ekyoma omu namba z’abaroma omu mbeera zimwechonka. Okukomaliza ekizibu eki, omwegyesa acwiremu kukora omurimo. Omu mirimo erikukurataho, niki ekirikukomaliza obuzibu obu omwegyesa atunga omu begi be?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naija kuhandika aha baabaati orutonde rw'ebishubo bya meto kandi ashabe abeeshuri kubara embeera y'okusaazibwa ya meto omuri buri gishubo. Bwanyima, bateekateeke aha muhendo gw'embeera z'okusaazibwa ezitari zimwe ezirikwoleka meto omuri buri kintu ky'obuhangwa.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naahandiika aha kaadi eby'okukora ebiri haihi n'ebya metal oxides, reero yaabuuza abeeshuri kuta eiziina rya buri gumwe, nibakoresa amateeka g'eiziina rya Stock, bwanyima, bagarukamu ekibuuzo: "Ahabw'enki metal oxides ezirikwatanisa ezirikwombekwa zineiziina ryaazo ririhendaine?"
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naahandiika aha bbaoodi fomura za dioxo na copper monoxide, abeeshuri bagarukamu ekibuuzo eki: "Emyungo ebiri niki ekirikubaasa kworeka enshonga y'okubahukanisa omu kubaza kw'e Stock, ku omutaale oxide yaaba neegizibwamu omutaale gumu?"
answer_d: Omugurusi ahandiika aha bbaaho ebintu by'entaano eby'ekyoma n'amaani gaabyo ag'okwegatta, reero asaba abeeshuri kuhandiika omu bbitabo byabo emigari y'ebyoma ebirukusana ebi ebyoma ebi birukubaara, reero bagarukemu ekibuuzo: "Ahabwenki ebyoma ebimu birukubaasa kwegatta n'omwika gwa oxygen omu bwingi obutari bumwe, nibikora ebintu ebirukusana eby'emishonga ebirukutali bumwe?"

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’eshomo ry’ahaiguru erya kabiri n’abaana be arikwija kukora nabo aha bintu ebirikukwata aha bushobozi bw’ekintu kwenyunyuura n’omugasho gwabyo. Ekigyendererwa kye n’okukikora arikurabira omu kwikiriza ebyo esomo erikutsindika aha kumanya ebintu bya saayansi. Omu mbeera egi, murimo ki, ogurikwija kukorwa abaana, ogurikubasa kwikiriza ebirimu ebi kandi gwikirize ebyo esomo erikutsindika aha kumanya ebintu bya saayansi?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebintu ebirimu okukunkumura n'okubumbura eccupa ya soda
answer_b: Nibarikora omulingo gw'okucereeza ebimera eby'omu maizi omu bwokya obutali bumwe kandi bagyerageranise n'amaani g'ekikoni ekikozesa obwooya n'obutiti.
answer_c: Nibakora eky'okureeba ebirikubaho omuntu yaahuhira omu kacaayi k'entaano arikukoresa akacumu, amazzi g'entaano gahinduka amajeru.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ebirikuruga omu kashushani ekarikworeka obwingi bwa oxyhemoglobin omu musaayi kurikushoboraana n'oburemeezi bw'omwika ogwa oxygen.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa secondary omu mwaka ogwa kana, obwahatiire enteekateeka y'ekicweka aha kwikirana kw'ebintu bya asidi na baze, ateeraho ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikugira ngu: "Huura aha muganano gw'obwingi n'omugyenzo gw'ekibaro okubara pH omu mishonga etari y'amaani eya asidi na baze ez'emiringo etari emwe." Okumanya ki okurikukurira okukuru abeeshuri kwakaba bamaze kutunga kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki kirikuteekwa omu maisho?
answer_a: Omukago gw'amaani g'omushongi n'omusingi ogwaagwo ogurikugwaamu
answer_b: Okwoikirira kw'eky'etantaro ky'ebintu ebirimu obusobozi bw'amaisho
answer_c: Okugambira aha muhendo gw'okuhinduka kw'ebintu omu kintu ky'obutayegyenga omu kwegaita kw'ebintu bya kemikali
answer_d: Okuteekateeka omubuzo gw'amaanyi g'ebirikiso omu birungo bya kemikali ebirimu amazzi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa secondary omu mwaka ogwa kana, omu mutwe gw'amaani g'obuziizi, ateeka ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi ye ngu abegi bashobore kushoboorora ebintu ebirikugumya obuziizi bw'atomu. Kumanya ki okurikukirira aha bi abegi baine kuba bamaze kutunga kubaasa kuhikiiriza okwegyesa oku?
answer_a: Okuruguruka kw'ebintu ebirimu obutwa bw'amaanyi
answer_b: Omugatte gw'enzitoyo y'akasiima ka atomu
answer_c: Namba y'obuto n'omubazi gw'enzitoyo
answer_d: Omutima n'ebiragiro by'amaani by'akatomu

question: Omutwe gw'abanyeshuri abali omu mwaka ogwa kabiri omu mashomero g'ahaiguru baine kukora omurimo ogurikugyenderera aha mugasho gw'okwega: "Kushoborora ebintu ebirimu obutonde bw'ebyomubiri kuraba omu mitwe yaabyo egirikukora". Ni kirikurugamu aha birikukurataho ekirikuba kitarikuhikaana n'ekigyendererwa ekirikumanyisibwa kandi tikishemereire kuba kimwe aha birikugyendererwa omu kubaza omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Kumanya ebirango by'emikora
answer_b: Orikushora ebintu ebirikukora omu muringo ogurikushushana.
answer_c: Orikushora ebintu ebirikukwatana omuhanda gw'okushushana kw'emiterere yabyo
answer_d: Kutegyeka ebintu by'obutonde bw'ensi ebirikushushana orikukoresa amagara g'okutebyeka IUPAC.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ari kukora aha mutwe gw'ebyaara n'amaani n'ekibiina ky'abegyesibwa ab'omumwaka gwa munaana. Aha rimwe aha bibiina, nateekaniza omukozi gw'okugezesa ogurikugyenderera abegyesibwa kworeka ngu obwingi bw'ebyaara oburikukwatwa nibwisigamira aha bwingi bw'ebyaara obw'omutaano obwa buri kintu. Ni engyeso ki y'okugezesa egiine omugasho gw'okugyenda aha kigyendererwa eki kirikuteekwa?
answer_a: Okareesha obuzito obuhinguraine bw'amaizi na giriseri omu bbiika ezitari zimwe kandi opime obushuushu bw'okubanza n'obw'aha muheru bw'obwire oburikuhairwe.
answer_b: Ta omuhendo gwa mL 50 z'amaizi agyezire digirii 90 omu bikopo bibiri ebiringaanire, ekikopo kimwe kyakozirwe omu ndiba n'ekindi kyakozirwe omu bwaafu, reero opime obwire oburikwetagisa okureetera obushuushu bw'amaizi kugwa kuhika digirii 25.
answer_c: Okonyeza mili-lita 50 z'amaizi agyezire hamu na mili-lita 50 z'amaizi g'omunyo omu bbiika ezitari zimwe kandi opime obwire obu amaizi agyezire n'amaizi g'omunyo garikutwara kuhika aha kasheeshe k'okuteera.
answer_d: Shana ekijiko ky’ekyuma ah’ekyokyeso hanyuma okiteeke omu kikopo ky’amaizi agari ah’obuheereza bw’omu nju kandi opime obuheereza bw’amaizi buri masegonda 20 kuhitsya bugumya.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa orikutebeekanisa eishomo ry'okukoragana n'abanyeshuri be ab'omumwaka gwa munaana aha mugingo ogurikukurataho: "Kutaho ebintu ebirikugyendererwa n'ebitarikugyendererwa omu bintu ebirikukwata aha kuhingura amata". Ni murimo ki, ogurikutebeekanisibwa omwegyesa, ogurikukwata aha mugingo gw'eishomo?
answer_a: Shisha omu omuntu orikwerarikana n'omuntu orikurwaire sukaari neetwaana eta?
answer_b: Yombeka omubazyo gw'omugisha gw'okunywa omwenge aha bunji bw'amazi g'omwiiha
answer_c: Yijuza etaabulo erikurikira, erikureeta ebaraara y'omuceere omu biro ebitari bimwe omu kasumiro
answer_d: Yijuza omuhanda gw'okwijuzamu ekitabo ekiine omubuzo gw'omutindo gw'ebintu ebirimu omu bice by'omubiri ebihendekire omukura gw'ensigo

question: Omwegyesereza naayetebeekanisa omutwe gw'ebiramu bya "Ideal Gases" ogu arakuza omu kiraasi ey'omwenda. Ekigyendererwa ky'ekimu aha masomo g'omutwe ogu nikyo: "Kwetegyereza omukago oguri hagati y'obushuushu n'obwinganiza bw'empeho omu mbeera z'obwomeezi obwa buri izooba." Kwolekya omukago ogu, omwegyesereza araakoresa eky'okureeberaho ekirikukwatana n'amateeka g'empeho. Ni enki aha mbeera ezirikukurugaho ekiri eky'okureeberaho kirungi okuhikaana n'ebirikwija kwegyesibwa omu kiraasi?
answer_a: Omukoragiro gw'ekyoma ekiteekyesa eby'omucwezi
answer_b: Oburo bwekyata ky'omugaati ogukozirweho omuseetwe
answer_c: Okuhuumura omukka kuruga n'okwingira omu bumba.
answer_d: Okutandika kubaho kw'ebipooli obu orikuguraho eccupa ya soda

question: Omuhwezi omu itsyaaha ry'omunaana, omugurusi akozire okucungura aha atomu n'okubumbwa kw'emishuro. Ebirugiremu biraayoreka ngu omubaro murungi gw'abanyeshuri nibaikiriza ngu okubumbwa kw'emishuro ya cationi nikubaho ahabw'okuba atomu neyongyera nari "netunga" protoni. Murimo ki omugurusi araabe ashohoire abanyeshuri be kuteeraho kuteegyereza omuhanda murungi gw'okubumbwa kw'emishuro ya cationi?
answer_a: Gyenda abeeshuri bashoboorore omuhendo gwa purotoni, erekituroni, na nyuturoni omu ayoni ezirikushushana kurugiirira aha namba y'akatomu (Z) n'aha namba y'oburemerezi (A).
answer_b: Mugambire abeeshuri kukora, hamwe n'omwegyesa, omuhanda gw'emisingi (table) ogurikworeka omuhendo gwa purotoni, erekituroni, na nyuturoni omu macayoni n'amaanayoni agasheeneene.
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesa bakore ekishushani ky'ebiteekateeko aha bbaoodi ekirikugyenderera aha biteekateeko ebi: nyukiriyaasi, esheeri, irikitooni, purotoni, nyuturoni, ayoni, kayoni, na ayoni.
answer_d: Mugambire abeeshuri kugaragura omukago oguri ahagati y'emitwarize y'akatomu ka sodiumi etarikwetantara n'emitwarize ya sodiumi nk'ayoni, nibwo bareeba omuhendo gw'ebiprotani, ebirekitironi, hamu n'ebinyutironi bya buri emwe.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa n’abaana b’ekikumi kya 7 omutwe gw’omubiri ogutariikiriza endwaara. Omu aha b’ekikumi, n’ateekateeka kwegyesa ekigyendererwa ekirikukwata aha: “Kwetegyereza omuringo ogw’okutangira ogwa kashatu.” Ni nshuraniso ki ey’omugaso abegi bashemereire kuba nibabaasa kukora batakaatandika kwegyesa ekigyendererwa eki bateekateeka kwegyesa ekikumi?
answer_a: Ahabw’omubiri ogurwanisa endwara n’ekirikurwanisibwa
answer_b: Ahabw'emirimo ya B na T lymphocytes
answer_c: Ahagati n'okugumisiriza hamu n'okwijukya kw'omubiri ogw'amaani gwaasiima kurwana n'endwaara
answer_d: Ahari aha kwikiriza endwara n'okutarikwikiriza endwara omuntu arikutunguuka nago

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekyangahe kya mushanju ari kutebeekanisa isomo ry'amaani, arikugira ekigendererwa ky'okushoboorora omuhanda gw'amaani g'omutwe gw'ekyoma, nari ebiragiro bya Hooke. Ni ebiha ebyo abeeshuri bashemereire kuba barayegire eby'omumaisho kubaasa kwetegyereza ebiragiro ebi?
answer_a: Okureetera obunene, oburyo, n’oburemeezi bw’amaani
answer_b: Omukago oguli hagati y'amaani g'obureeme n'okuhinduka kw'emibiri.
answer_c: Okushushanura amaani g'omuguta ogurikugarurira aha kintu gwaitooba.
answer_d: Okumanya emigarukiro y'amaani aha mbeera n'okuhendeka kw'ebintu

question: Omugyezibwa naagyeragyezya omugisha gw'okuhandiika ekibuuzo ky'okubonereza omwana owa 7 omuisho gw'okushuuruura obuhame bw'omutindo gw'okwetegyereza kw'ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Shoboorora emitwarize y'emiyaga mirungi omu mbeera za buri izooba, orikurora amateeka agigyeragyezaho." Ni kiraganiso ki aha birikukurataho ekirikushobora kwerekana okushiitukira aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omu muringo ogurikwetegyereza amateeka ga Boyle, Gay-Lussac, na Charles omu by'okureeberaho ebya buri izooba.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza ebishushani, nibashobora kwetegyereza omukago oguli ahagati y'omuremero n'obushushu bw'omuyaga
answer_c: Nibamushobora kumanya omu magara ga butoosha obunene bw’ebintu ebirimu omuyaga n’obushyuushu bwabyo
answer_d: Nibarikira omu kubara omuhendo gw'obushuushu, omuhendo gw'obwinganiza, hamwe n'akanyigirizi k'omuyaga, nibakoresa omuringo gw'amateeka g'omuyaga ogurikukwata omu mbeera za buri izooba.

question: Omugyezibwa orikwegyesa ekyanya ky'amasannyalaze n'ekibiina kya 5, naija kukora okushomesa; omuri byona, naija kwenda kumanya obuhikizi bw'eky'okurorraho eki: "Okwetantaza ebintu ebirikukwata amasannyalaze kuruga omu bintu ebitarikukwata amasannyalaze". Ni murimo ki ogurikukwata aha ky'okurorraho eki twagambireho?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kureeba omuringo omunyamaishanga g'amasanyu gurikukora n'okugushushanisa n'ogundi ogutarikukora, kandi bashoboorore ahabwaki ogwo ogutarikukora gutarikukora.
answer_b: Ore ebazaire abeeshuri kureeba akachati akoreka omuhendo gw'amaisho gw'ebyoma ebirikumanyisa omuringo gw'omushomo gw'amasannyalaze, reero bagarukemu ekibuuzo eki: Ni kyoma ki ekiri aha kachati eki ekiraakoreseze gye nk'ekirikushomesa amasannyalaze omu muzunguruko gw'amasannyalaze?
answer_c: Abeegi abeeshuri kureeba ekishushani ekirikworeka omushaija arikukwata aha miigo y'amashanyarazi n'engaro za ruba, nukwo bashobore kugarukamu ekibuuzo eki: Ahabw'enki omushaija ashemereire kukoresa engaro za ruba ku arikukwata aha miigo y'amashanyarazi?
answer_d: Oreke abeshomesa kureeba ekishushani ky'omuringo gw'amasannyalaze ogutahikiirire, reero batoorane omu bintu nk'ekikopo ky'ekyoma, ekicweka ky'omuti, n'omupiira, ekiri kubasa kuhikiiriza omuringo gw'amasannyalaze ngu etabaaza eyake.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa naija kucweeka akabonero aka omu kiraasi eya mushanju: "Okutaanisa embeera ezikozesebwa kushoboorora ekyanyaikani". Murimo ki ogurikwija kwikiriza abegyi kukora eky'okwereka ngu bakuruhiire akabonero aka?
answer_a: Shanga eicenter y'omusisa ogurikukirira kimu omu rikoodi z'ebitaagi bisatu eby'ebyoma ebirikushobora kushobora emisa.
answer_b: Noonyereza aha misisa mikuru eyabaho omuri Chile n'ebihwereire ebyagikurataireho
answer_c: Shisha ebyetabiremu eby'obushobezi omu nshangwa y'ebigambo obunene na amaani omu maripoota y'abanyamakuru.
answer_d: Shoborora enshuranuro eri ahagati y'omutaano gw'oburemeezi bubiri ogukurataireho aha kipimo kya Richter omu bwijwire bw'amaani agaashohorirwe.

question: Omwegyesa, omuhiga omu omwaka gwa 1 ogw'eshomero erikuru, omu mutwe gw'okuhinduka n'obwingana bw'ebiramu, ari kukora omurimo n'abegi be omuboine bashemereire kugaragurira hamwe amino asidi ezirikushushana omu protein C kuruga omu bishushani by'enyama ezitari zimwe kandi bateebere omukago gw'okuhinduka oguri ahagati yaabyo. Omu kubumbura omurimo ogu, omwegi abuuza: "Kuba ekirikutaabura ebiramu n'amajoro omu DNA yaabyo, shi omugasho gw'okugaragurira hamwe endinganisa z'amino asidi omu protein niki?". Kurora aha mutindo gw'obwegesi bw'omwegi, n'obuha aha kushoborra okurikukurataho okwa muhiga okurikumaraho ekibuuzo ky'omwegi?
answer_a: Protiini emwe n'eshobora kworekwa omu binyabuzima by'ebika bitari bimwe. Amakuru g'okukora protiini ago gahandiikwa omu misiri. N'ahabw'ekyo, twamanya enshuraniso eziri ahagati y'emisiri erikora protiini n'omutarikwa gw'ebirikurungo by'omubiri, emikago y'okuhinduka kw'ebika neeshobora kushingwaara.
answer_b: Ebirungo bya proteini bikozirwe omu rukurato rw'emishokano gya amino acid erikushangwa omu DNA. Ku harukubaho enkyukakyuka omuri egi, neija kuhindura omurongo gw'emishokano gya amino acid y'ebirungo bya proteini ekyo. N'ahabw'ekyo, twashwijuma omuhendo gw'emishokano ya amino acid etari emwe ey'ekirungo kya proteini kimwe, omuntu nabaasa kumanya oku ebika bibiri birikukwatana omu by'okuhinduka kw'ebintu.
answer_c: Protiini zirikukorwa kuruga omu kuza omukubbi gw'ebikumaguriro bya RNA, ekirikuruga omu kuza omukubbi gw'akantu akarikuzara. Protiini egi neeshobora kworekwa n'empinduka omu rukurato rw'ebirikugwisa orwaahaireho. N'ahabw'ekyo, kurabira omu kushwijuma enkurato ezi, emikago y'okuhinduka kw'ebintu omu bika by'ebintu neeshobora kuteerwawo.
answer_d: Omukuru gw'ebirikwa bya amino acid omu protein nigutegerezebwa omukururwa gw'ebirikwa bya codons ezi messenger RNA erimu, kuruga ahabyo erikukolebwamu. Obwo buri codon neehikaana n'omukururwa gw'ebirikwa bisatu bya nucleotides, obwo obwo bwahanguka, protein erimu omukuru gw'ebirikwa bya amino acid ogutari gumu na protein y'okubanza eshobora kutungwa. N'ahabw'ekyo, kumanya omuhendo gw'ebirikwa bya amino acid ebitari bimwe aha rurengo, omuntu asobora kumanya oku zihikire haihi omu by'okuhinduka.

question: Abanyeshuri ab'omu mwaka ogw'akabiri omu mashomero agakurira ag'ababanza, nibakuratira ebibuuzo kuruga owa omugurusi, nibashwijuma okucwekyereza kw'omuhanda okuhereza obuhame aha mwanya gw'ebintu ebiretera omuntu kusaana n'omukago gwabyo n'emiterere y'omuntu omu bintu ebirimu oburo. Kuruga omu kucwekyereza kw'okuhindura oburo omu Xenopus laevis ekyakozirwe John Gurdon, ekyahereize obuhame ngu oburo bw'omunda bw'omuntu burimu ebintu byona ebiretera omuntu kusaana okukura omu bunafu, omwe aha banyeshuri ababuuza: "Ahabwenki oburo bw'omukazi obutariho kantu bukoresibwa omu kucwekyereza, hatariho oburo obundi obutariho kantu?". Ni ndyoha aha bushoborozi obu omugurusi ahereza oburikwija kumwemerera kugarukamu omu muringo ogurikwetegyereza ekirikureetera omunyeshuri okubuuza ekibuuzo eki?
answer_a: Ahabw'okuba omuhanda gw'okuhindura obutofa bw'omunda y'akariisa kuba ekintu ekihikire, akariisa akaheebwa obutofa bwa nyukiriya kishemereire kuba kitarikwetengesa kandi kishemereire kuba kirimu ebintu ebirikuhindura omu muringo ogurikushusha n'eby'akariisa akaheebwa obutofa bwa nyukiriya.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba orwoote n’akagyeenura akataine mirimo erikumanywa gye, erikubaasa kureeta oburinganiza bw’oburyo bw’akagyeenura obukira ahari bumwe, nk’oku orubaju rw’omunda rwayo rurimu ebintu ebirikutandika omurimo gw’okuhindura ebintu ebirikutorana okukora n’okuhindura ebintu ebirikukora omurimo gw’obutonde bw’ebintu oburi omu mutima ogwimutsirwe.
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba obutaffa bw’omubiri obundi, nk’obutaffa bw’enda, n’obutaffa obw’omutwaro ogurikukura ogurimu ebintu ebirikukora omutwaro ogurikukura ebirikureetera okugyaho enzagyo ezirikwetagisa omu kukura kw’omwana omuhango, ekitarikubaho omu igi ry’omukazi
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba orwofaafa orw’ekitima ky’eggi ry’omukazi, okutari nk’orw’obuto obutari bumwe obw’omubiri, nk’obw’omu nda, rwine ebintu byona ebirikwetagisa okuhindura obuto obutari bumwe, ebirikubaasa kureetera obuto obumwe kukora emirimo bukaba burikukora, ekirikubaasa kureetera embeera y’omwana kukura omu muringo ogurikwetagisa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omukuru nashoboorora omuringo ogu obwerinzi bw’omubiri burwanisa endwara, okukiraho amoko g’oburwanisi, omwegi yamubuuza: “Nikimanyisa ki ngu okushomesa oburwanisi bw’endwara ya virusi kwoleka ngu IgG eriyo kandi IgM teriyo?”. Obushoboorora burikukurataho obu omwegyesa ahabw’okugarukamu ekibuuzo ky’omwegi nibukwata aha mazima kandi nibwetegyereza?
answer_a: Nikimanyisa ngu omuntu aba arikumaraho obwire bw'ahaiguru munonga obw'oburwaire, ahabw'okuba IgG na IgM n'emibiri erwanisa endwaire ey'omutaano ya buri kika kya akavirusi kandi neyerugurayo omu bwire obu.
answer_b: Nikimanyisa ngu omuntu akaba ali omu kicweka kyahererera eky’oburwaire oburikwata, nk’omu kicweka eki obutoffaali bwa plasma oburikukwata aha buli kika bwa virusi nibutandika kureeta IgG na IgM.
answer_c: Nikimanyisa ngu omuntu ali omu kicweka ekya kubanza eky’oburwaire obutandika, ahabw’okuba omu kicweka eki obutofaali bwa plasma oburikukwata aha buri kika bwa virusi nibutandika kureeta IgG na IgM.
answer_d: Nikimanyisa ngu omuntu arikukira, ahabw'okuba IgG na IgM n'emibiri erwanisa endwara (antibodies) erikukwata aha buli kika ky'akavirusi, egi erugurwa omu bunaku bw'okurwaana n'endwara, okubanza IgM reero IgG, hamwe na IgG egumaho omu musaayi obwire burikurengaaho.

question: Omugyezaho w’omushomesha w’omu mwaka gwa kabiri omuishomero erikuru, omu bwiire bw’ekicweka ekirikukwata aha DNA n’okubyara kw’obutofaali, ari kutebeekanisa omurimo gw’okukora aha mugingo gw’okwega ogurikukurira: “Kwetegyereza oku bizimba bya kansa birikukura”. Ni bumanyi ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba baine kare kubaasa kukora aha mugingo ogu?
answer_a: Ebiringo by'omutendera gw'ekyanga ky'obutofaali
answer_b: Obukuru bw'okweyabiza kw'obutofaali (mitosis)
answer_c: Ebitegyerezo by'ebicweka by'omutwaro gw'akacweka k'obuto
answer_d: Emiringo y’okuhinduka kw’ebirikwa omubiri (DNA) n’okw’ebice by’omubiri (chromosome)

question: Omwegyesereza omuhwezi omu secondary aha muheru gw'ekicweka ky'entebe y'obwengye naija kutebeekanisiza ekibuuzo ky'okugyeragyeranisa ekigendereirwe ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Shoboorora oku entebe y'obwengye erikukwataganya ebikorwa by'ekintu ekiramu kwetegyereza embeera erikukikundukura omu bwengye kuraba omu bubaka oburikuhitsya obwengye omu mubiri gwona". Ni kiragiro ki aha birikukurataho ekirikushobora kwerekana ngu ekigendereirwe eki kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebishushani by’emiringo etari emwe ey’omukora gw’omubiri ogurikugarukamu amagara (reflex acts) kandi batanduuramu ebitundu ebigurikugwamu.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza eky'okugarukamu kw'omubiri okurikushushana omu muringo ogutari gumwe.
answer_c: Nibarikira aha miringo y’omubimbe by’obutofa bw’obwongo eburiho, egi erikwemerera okukora enyihura ez’emiringo etari emwe.
answer_d: Nibarikira omugisha gw'omugongo, obwongo, ebirungo by'okuhurira, n'ebikorwa omu kubumbabumba okugarukamu kw'omubiri.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu secondary ari kutebeekanisa isomo ry’ekibina kya 2 omuhanda gwa kabiri aharikwija kukuriza ekigyendererwa eki: “Kukoresa ebiragiro by’okukuumira omugufu omu nkora erugaire.” Ni enki aha mirimo egi erikukiriza abegi kukora nikibahwera kukora ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Nibarikora eby'okureeberaho by'okugongana omu mwoyo ogurikukuumirwa.
answer_b: Nibarikira oburemezi hamwe n'omuhindo gw'emotoka ezirikugongana omu rubindo orutaine obufindo obutari bwingi.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omukago oguri ahagati y'amaani agataireho, obwire obu gamazeho nigataireho, n'empiso eyakwasirwe omubiri omu mwanya gumwe.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ebiriva omu kugongana kw'ebiti bibiri ebiriho ebintu ebiringana nibishushana nibirererera hatariho kuremererwa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mwaka ogw'okubanza owa siniya ari kutebeekaniza isomo aine ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Okukoresa omuringo gw'omuyaga kworeka ngu omushana nigugaruka n'okucwekyera ku gurikukwata aha muhingo ogurikwegaanisa ebintu bibiri." Nk'omuringo gw'okukora aha kigyendererwa eki, omwegyesa acwireho kukoresa ekikoreso ky'okwegyesa ekirikwangutsya okwetegyereza ebirimu. Ni kiki aha bikoreso by'okwegyesa ebirikukurataho ekirikukora aha mugasho ogu gw'omwegyesa?
answer_a: Ekitabo ky’eshomero ekirikutwarira aha nshuraniso eziri ahagati y’omuringo gw’obutini n’omuringo gw’omuyaga gw’omushana, hamwe n’obuhabuzi obu buri omwe yataireho oburikukwata aha bwangu bw’omushana omu kwangaanisa.
answer_b: Eky'omuringo gw'omukono ogw'ekombuta ekirikworeka omuhendo gw'amaizi g'omushana ogurikukurira aha ngata y'omumaisho g'ebintu bibiri by'omubiri ahabw'okucwekyerezibwa n'okucwekyera omushana.
answer_c: Eky'okureeberaho omu kiraasi ky'omutwe gw'ekyanga ky'amasanyu (laser beam) nigukuba ahaiguru y'amaizi omu kibindi, ahu kirikubaasika kureebwa ngu omutwe gw'ekyanga gumwe nigwegyema (reflect) ogundi nigucwekyera (refract) aha mpimo ezirikushobororwa.
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okushushana ogurikukoresa kompyuta ogurikworeka ngu omushana gwaba gutaire aha mpaka z'ebintu bibiri, omwe gwagwo nigugaruka, ogundi nigucweeka, buri gumwe gwiine embeto yaagwo erikwetegyereza.

question: Omuhiga omu, omuhiga owa kabiri omu klasse y’ahaiguru, omugurusi nashoborra abegyesa ebiragiro by’amaani g’ensi yoona. Kuguha eky’okureeberaho ky’amaani, nareeta ekishushani ky’omutwe ogurugire aha muti rundi omwezi ogurikwetorora ensi. Omugurusi narora okutangara omu bamu aha begesa, abatarikubaasa kuhuura embeera ezi n’ebiragiro ebirikugambwaho. Eky’okureeberaho ki ekirikukurataho ekirikubaasa kukoresibwa omugurusi kukuza okwetegyereza kw’abegyesa ebiri omu mutwe, kucwekyereza okutangara kwabo?
answer_a: Ogyira omugo gw’omunyeeto aha kashereti kandi amworekye ngu, arikucungura omugo kuruga aha muheru gw’akashereti, nigutunga omugisha gw’okucunguruka omu muringo gw’ekizingo. Hanyuma, nashoboorora ngu amaani g’ahaagati agarikurugirira omu kuhemberwa kw’omugo nigashushana n’amaani g’omugyego omu mbeera y’Okwezi.
answer_b: Ekiraganisa ekishushani eky'omu bwengye erikwo eihangiro nirireebwa nk'ahaiguru nk'ekikamba ekirikuguruka ahu ekintu kigumire munonga, ekirikukiikirira Ensi, nikizika ahaiguru aha, nikireetera ebintu ebiirikukiraho obuto kugwa rundi kwetegyereza ekintu ekya mbere omu miringo etari emwe.
answer_c: N’okwohereza omubumbi nigwo gwaagwa; bwanyima, n’aguta omugazi kureetera kworeka ngu n’omuhindo gw’okubanza guri mwingi, nigugwa hare. Obwo, n’akora ekishushani aha bboodi n’enzira ezi omubumbi guraakuratize, okuhitsya obu gurikwetorora omunsi.
answer_d: Naaza aha bboodi ekishushani ky'okugwa kw'eibuga, narugaamu oburemezi bwaryo n'obw'ensi, oburaayo aha makkati gaabyo n'amaani g'omugyegyeeto. Bwanyima, ahindura ekishushani kyo kworeka omukoranire ogw'amaani g'omugyegyeeto hagati y'okwezi n'ensi, ahindura data eyabaireho.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu secondary omu omuri kiraasi ey’okubanza ateekanize kukora aha biteekerezo ebi birikukurataho omu mutwe gw’ebicweka n’omuranga: - Oburemu - Amaani - Okutetema - Omulingo - Obwire - Obureingwa bw’ekicweka - Okwerorera - Okutwara - Amaani - Okutabangaanisa - Omulingo gw’okusaasaana - Eihanga  Ni biteekerezo ki bibiri omugyezibwa ashemereire kubanzaho kukoraho kubaasa kuteeraho ombereho omu kwega ebiri aha lukalala orurikukira ahaiguru?
answer_a: Omugara n'amaani
answer_b: Omugisha n'obureingwa bw'omurambararo
answer_c: Okutetema n'omulingo
answer_d: Amaani n'obureingwa bw'omuraranzi

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekibiina ky’omwaka ogw’okubanza omuheesiire enteekateeka y’okukora ekizibu ky’okugyezaho aha muheru gw’eishomo erikukwata aha bintu ebirikuhurira. Ni birikukurataho ebikorwa by’omwegi ebirikworeka ngu bamanyire ebireetera embeera ya Doppler?
answer_a: Nibagyenderera omu kikube ekirikworeka omuhanda ogurikworeka omugyigyo gw'amaizi nigugyigana nari nigutaana ahabw'omuhindo gw'ekintu ekirikugyenda.
answer_b: Nibarikira omulingo ekintu ekirikukora oruyo kigendera hamu n'omulingo oruyo rurikukora, nukwo bashobole kuraganira omulingo omuntu arakuuhurira oruyo.
answer_c: Nibashobora kushoborora oku omutindo gw’okwehindura hagati y’omuhereza n’omuhairwe guhindura omuringo gw’omugisha ogu amahanga agyira aha muhairwe.
answer_d: Nibamannya embeera omuntu arikureeba enshonga y’omururu gw’ebintu kuruga aha bwangu bw’okuza haihi nari okwihaho ekintu ekirikukurugyaho omururu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa secondary, omu mutwe gw'ebintu ebirugiremu kemiko omu bwengye n'omugasho gwabyo, ari kutebeekaniza okushwijuma okwaheru kw'ekicweka ky'okwetegyereza eby'okuhindurana bya oxidation-reduction. Kandi arikukora eki, ekigyendererwa eki nikyo kishirweho: "Kwetegyereza eby'okuhindurana bya redox omu magara ga buri izooba n'omugasho gwabyo omu bantu b'omuri obu bwire". Omu mirimo ei erikukuraho, niki ekirikukwasa kwegerereza obuhame bw'okutungwa kw'ekigyendererwa eki ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Teekateeka, orikuhandiika omwandiko, aha kwangirika kw'ebintu by'ebyoma ahabw'enkuba erimu asidi
answer_b: Babaza okubara, norikukoresa emiringo y'ekibalangulo, embeera z'omulingo gw'okutangaaza ogw'ebintu by'omwiijo ebiri omu muringo gw'okutangaaza ogwa kemiko ogwa alcolest
answer_c: Kukoresa, kurugiisa omuringo gw'obumeme-ayoni, omuringo gw'ekikemiko ogw'okuhindura ekikopo ky'emiyoboro y'amaizi ag'okunywa kurugiirira omuyaga gwa okisijeni.
answer_d: Rikuumisa, kuraburikisa omuringo gw'okuhindura embeera y'omutindo gw'eby'omuringo, omuhendo gw'amasannyalaze agahindurwa omu kwikirizana kw'eby'omuringo omu batiri erimu amazzi g'omunyu.

question: Omwe omu aha migyenderero abeeshuri abari omu mwaka gw'akabiri gw'aha secondary bakakoraho n'okukora n'okushoboorora data erikukwata aha miringo y'ebintu ebiriyo omu by'omubiri n'eby'obushoboorozi bw'ebintu ebiriyo. Ni ki aha bikorwa ebi orikubaasa kucungura omugyendereero ogwo ogugambirweho?
answer_a: Ha abaana data aha bw'okutemba kw'amazzi kw'ebinyabwooya bya hydrocarbon ebirikukura omu bunini, reero obagambire bashwijume obubaire nibaba omu mbeera y'amaizi, ekintu kikuru nari omuyaga aha bwiire bw'obushuushu obutari bwingi.
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa bacuubaaze aha bwokureenga kw'amazzi kw'ebinyabwooya bya hydrocarbon ebirimu obureingwa obutari bumwe, babitebeekanise omu meza, kandi bashuuruure obuba omu mbeera y'amaishoonga, amazzi, rundi omuyaga aha bwokukara bw'ekyombeko.
answer_c: Ha abeeshuri abeeshuri data aha bw'okutemba kw'amazzi kw'ebinyabuzima eby'emiringo erikushushana erikutebeekanisibwe omu meza, reero obasabe bashoboorore emitwarize kurugiirira aha mikoranire erikwolekyerwa ebintu ebi.
answer_d: Ha abaana data aha bw'okutenta kw'ebizibiti bya haidrokarbons ez'obureingwa obutari bumwe, ebi bashemereire kutebeekanisa omu taabule nikukurata omuhendo gw'ekaaboni omu bureingwa bwazo reero bashoboorore emikorere egi nikukurata obwingi bw'omukago ogurikwolekyerwa molekyuuru.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omwaka ogw’okubanza omuishomero erikuru akakora okugyezibwa kw’okushishoora yaaba abegyendesereza nibabaasa kumanya embeera z’emihinduko y’ebintu ebirikubaho omu bwengye bwabo. Kandi, naija kushishoora oburemeezi bw’ebirikwegyesibwa aha kumanya ebintu bya sayansi. Okukora eki, akagambira abegyendesereza be kwolesa omu mitwe emihinduko y’ebintu ebirikubaho omu bwengye bwabo. Aha muheru gw’omurimo, omutwe gumwe gwayolesa emihinduko egi: omuhinduko gwa sodium hydroxide na hydrochloric acid, okureebeka kwa hydrochloric acid kuruga omu hydrogen na chlorine, n’okureebeka kwa carbon dioxide kuruga omu carbon na oxygen. Aha butumwa obu omwegyesa arakuha abegyendesereza kubahiga omu by’okwega ebirikushishoorwa?
